jobs.lever.co/matillion/324f1be5-ab7c-4c.description_excerpt:
Director, Product Management
Are you ready to shape the future of data?
Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.
In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can't keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.
We started in Manchester and now we're global - with teams across the UK, US and India and fifteen years of data expertise behind us. We have raised over $300M from some of the worlds' best investors, including General Atlantic, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Battery Ventures.
We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We're here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we're looking for people who want to be part of it.
About the Role
As Director, Product Management, you'll own the strategy and execution for a core area of Matillion's product end to end. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll carry direct product ownership for a significant area while building and leading a team of Product Managers - roughly 40% of your time in direct product work, the rest on team leadership, stakeholder management and portfolio oversight, and that balance will shift over time.
Success in this role means category-level command of the data landscape, sharp product instincts, and the ability to raise the bar in others, not just in your own output.
You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design leadership to align on technical strategy, and with GTM, Customer Success and Marketing to keep the business ahead of what's shipping and turn what you learn into what you build next.
What you will be doing
•
Own a product area end to end: define the strategy for your area, translate company and product strategy into a multi-quarter roadmap, and make the prioritisation and resourcing trade-offs across multiple workstreams - with accountability for the commercial outcome of the whole portfolio.
•
Stay hands-on: retain direct ownership of a specific product area - write specs, run discovery, and make product calls yourself, not just through your team.
•
Set and enforce the quality bar: define what “good” looks like for the product area, review your team's product decisions and outputs, and hold the line with senior stakeholders when a capability isn't ready to ship - even when it's commercially uncomfortable.
•
Understand the market and the users: maintain a view of user needs across data engineering, analytics and platform personas, and own the competitive and market view of the data and AI ecosystem.
•
Build and lead the team: hire, coach and manage the performance of a team of Product Managers, run the team's operating rhythm, and set the standard for AI-enabled ways of working across the group.
•
Drive cross-functional and executive alignment: partner with Engineering and Design leadership on technical strategy and delivery capacity, keep GTM, Customer Success and Marketing ahead of what's shipping, and present roadmap and trade-offs to stakeholders, leadership and customers.
What we are looking for
•
Typically 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years managing Product Managers directly.
•
A track record of shipping and scaling B2B products end to end, with demonstrable commercial impact.
•
People leadership experience: you've hired, coached and managed the performance of Product Managers directly.
•
Real, hands-on exposure to the data ecosystem - enough to make credible technical trade-off calls.
•
A systems thinker operating at scale, balancing craft, speed and commercial impact across multiple workstreams at once.
•
Deep data literacy, and the ability to hold your team accountable to evidence-based decision-making.
•
A demonstrable track record of using AI tools to accelerate product work, and the ability to model, teach and hold your team to that same standard.
•
Excellent communication, including credibility in front of executive leadership and senior customers.
•
Comfortable holding a line under commercial pressure - on product quality and on team standards - and operating at both strategic and hands-on altitude in the same week.
At Matillion, we are committed to providing compensation in line with market standards based on the role, job family, job level and country. This role's estimated annual salaried pay range for this position is £108,320 - £162,480. The final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.
More about Matillion
We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:
•
Company Equity
•
30 days holiday + bank holiday
•
5 days paid volunteering leave
•
Private Health Insurance
•
Life Insurance
•
Pension
•
Access to mental health support
Your Safety
Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to matillion.com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion.com.
Want to know more?
Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
Cannot find anything suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at talent@matillion.com.
Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.
Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Matillion is building the agentic data team
In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding and manual data engineering cannot keep up. Maia is our AI agent for data engineering. It builds and manages the data products teams depend on, multiplying what a whole data team can deliver. Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack already run on it.
We started in Manchester and we are now global, with teams across the UK, US and India, and fifteen years of data expertise behind us. We have raised over $300M from some of the world’s best investors, including General Atlantic, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Battery Ventures.
We move fast, hold a high bar, and sweat the details. If you want to do the best product work of your career on a genuinely hard AI problem, this is the place.
About the Role
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a significant slice of the Maia product, working at the intersection of complex user problems, AI capability, and commercial impact. We need someone who understands what a great agentic product experience looks like and holds the bar for it relentlessly.
You will be user-obsessed and data-driven in equal measure. You define what success looks like before you build, run evals to hold Maia to a high bar, and use AI in your own workflow to move faster. We're not prescriptive about your background: what matters is that you can move fast like a startup and scale with discipline like a larger company, and you know the difference. Most of all, we're looking for depth: the instinct to get to the heart of a hard problem and own it end to end.
Great product work happens through collaboration. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design to build Maia, and with GTM to take it to market and turn what you learn into what you build next.
What you will be doing:
Own a core area of Maia end to end: define the problems worth solving, prioritise ruthlessly, make the hard trade-offs with incomplete data, and drive the work through to measurable impact.
Set the quality bar for agentic behaviour: build the evals that measure how good Maia really is, interrogate the outputs, and hold the line when it isn't there yet.
Deeply understand our users: get past feature requests to the real friction in a data team's workflow, and the moments that earn trust.
Work at the frontier of the stack: reason with Engineering about models, context, tools like MCP, and orchestration, and where each one changes the product.
Accelerate your own output with AI: use AI tools actively across research, synthesis, prototyping, and analysis, always finding ways to move faster without trading away quality.
Drive cross-functional alignment: work day to day with Engineering and Design, keep GTM ahead of what's shipping, and present your roadmap and priorities clearly to stakeholders, leadership and customers.

About Us
At Splend, we're on a mission to fundamentally change the way people own and operate a vehicle. With a strategic focus on rideshare, we provide our customers with straightforward, no-strings-attached access to vehicle ownership. But we aren't just about vehicle ownership. We're also fast-tracking the transition to green mobility, leading the way globally in reducing the carbon footprint of the transportation sector by transitioning our fleet to electric vehicles.
You'll be excited to work in this role if...
You’re able to stay calm when someone else is upset. You don’t take it personally and you like helping work through a problem.
You take pride in following through on the small details. Logged notes, completed follow-ups, no loose ends.
You want a hands-on role where no two days are the same, working face-to-face with customers from all walks of life.
About the role
As an InLife Coordinator, you’ll be the friendly face of Splend for our customers after they’ve collected their vehicle.
Based at our Cricklewood hub, you’ll help drivers with everything from vehicle swaps and returns to accident damage, warranty questions and contract queries.
You’ll listen, explain what happens next in plain terms, and work with our fleet and sales teams to get things sorted. Most issues are resolved face-to-face, and you’ll have a supportive team around you.

jobs.lever.co/laminarprojects/da0d03d2-5.description_excerpt:
We are Shape.Construction !
About the job
Contractors bleed margin on every project.
Unmanaged change. Disputed claims. Missing records. When field teams don't follow processes, events go undocumented. Commercial teams scramble for evidence that doesn't exist. Disputes drag on. Recoverable profit vanishes. On high-value projects, millions of pounds disappear.
Why?
- Field teams use clunky tools that are too complex and too slow. Critical events never get recorded. The audit trail has gaps.
- Commercial teams fight disputes with weak evidence, chase missing records, and lose recoverable margin while the business faces unnecessary claims.
Shape fixes this once and for all.
Shape is the only platform simple enough for field teams to adopt instantly, yet powerful enough to drive real commercial outcomes.
Site teams capture every issue, event, and change in real time. Shape automatically builds the bulletproof evidence commercial teams need to defend and recover claims.
The result: Fewer lost disputes. Faster resolutions. Full subcontractor accountability. Commercial teams manage change proactively instead of reacting to it.
This is the problem we solve. But to really help our customers, we need experts who understand their pain first-hand. Many of our customers are Commercial Managers and Commercial Directors. Who better to consult them than other commercial professionals?
That's where you come in.
We are looking for a seasoned Commercial Manager ready not just for a change of role, but a change of industry. This is your opportunity to break away from the grind of construction and step into the fast-growing world of construction SaaS.
As our Manager of Commercial Strategy, you'll use your hard-won expertise to guide other commercial teams through the biggest challenge they face: change and claims. Instead of battling over margins on a single project, you'll be leading conversations that transform how entire companies protect their profit. This is consultative sales and customer success at the highest level - where your becomes the product and your impact scales far beyond any single contract.
_________________________________________________________________________________________
Purpose of the role
To partner with our customers' commercial teams, helping them take control of change, disputes and claims using Shape. You will use your industry expertise to show them how to protect margin, build defensible records, and prevent the losses that most projects suffer today.
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Consult with commercial leaders to uncover where they are losing profit to change and disputes, and show how Shape stops margin leakage.
2. Support customer adoption ensuring site and office teams use Shape consistently to capture changes, issues and claims.
3. Coach customers on strengthening claims and defending disputes with documented, auditable records.
4. Act as the commercial voice inside Shape, shaping product development to better match the realities of construction projects.
5. Share best practice and lessons learned across our customer base, raising standards and outcomes for the entire industry.
Your Capabilities
- Significant experience as a Commercial Manager or in a similar construction role.
- Deep understanding of how unmanaged change and poor records erode project profitability.
- Strong communication skills - able to win trust and explain complex issues simply.
- Strategic thinker who can move from diagnosing problems to implementing solutions.
- Desire to make an industry-wide impact, not just improve a single project or business.
Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now you will after joining):
- Experience advising or consulting with multiple stakeholders.
- Knowledge of SaaS platforms or digital transformation in construction.
- Comfortable leading workshops, training sessions, or customer presentations.
- Ability to link commercial pain points to practical technology solutions.
Shape isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
At Shape we value diverse experiences and perspectives, empowering each member to contribute their unique capabilities towards our collective success, so if you don’t think you meet all the criteria but still are excited about this role we encourage you to apply anyway!
_________________________________________________________________________________________
Salary and Benefits
Standard Stuff
- Extremely competitive
- Paid annual leave (varies by location) + statutory bank holidays
- Private health insurance
- In-house coaching sessions
- Discretionary bonus scheme for all team members
The Life-Changing Stuff
- 4 Day Weeks: that’s right, every week
- Flexibility: We care about outcomes, not clock-watching
- Grow your whole self: Access to a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-focused environment designed to give you 5 years of growth in 1 year
- Be surrounded by the best: We only hire the top talent; progression is fast and development is unbounded.
- Long-term impact: Shape is tackling the single biggest issue in construction delivery, with solutions designed to spread and outlast us.
*Please do not book a demo via the Shape website as part of the application.

Are you a Cost Manager that is a bit tired of the standard old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry?
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology?
Do you crave the freedom, power, and support to bring fresh ideas to how work is delivered, so client expectations are not just met, but smashed?
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction, improving the industry?
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t, it is quite real!
Read on!
____________________________________________________________
We are Laminar Projects!
If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.)
We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)
The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)
This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across data centres, major infrastructure schemes, and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it.
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)
Core values for a good life
A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
- Grow yourself - your relationship with yourself
- Care about people - your relationship with others around you
- Execute to greatness - your relationship with your team
- Build civilisation - your relationship with humanity and the world
We enshrined our values in our vision:
We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
- Connects us with meaningful relationships
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures
By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation
- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society
____________________________________________________________
The Role
Purpose of the role
- Supercharge client service: Deliver cutting-edge cost management powered by digital tools, moving beyond static reporting to dynamic project insight.
- Cradle-to-grave expertise: Oversee every cost management aspect of projects, from initial concepts through close-out.
- Champion collaboration: Facilitate cross-functional collaboration, particularly with project managers, the commercial team, planners, and design teams, to ensure timely, on-budget, and high-quality project delivery.
- Innovate fearlessly: Bring fresh ideas to the table, design new processes, and exceed industry expectations with progressive thinking.
- Embrace digital transformation: Lead the integration of project management elements through Laminar's project controls-centric delivery, streamlining workflows, and maximising control.
- Think outside spreadsheets: We aren't looking for Excel-only users. We want professionals who embrace a digitally enhanced approach to cost management.
Team
This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are.
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems.
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology.
More specifically you will be part of our Cost and Commercial Services Team. Your leader will be our Commercial Director.
Your top three objectives:
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you
Your top five responsibilities:
1. Own the cost: Manage the project costs through all stage gates, integrating QCRA and risk-adjusted forecasting to provide a "no surprises" financial environment.
2. Own the outcome: Lead pre-construction estimating (when within our scope) and post-contract live cost management. This includes managing complex change orders with deep-dive cost analysis to protect the client’s interests.
3. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project, more efficiently and effectively (Laminar’s existing infrastructure will support this).
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team, to enhance Laminar's long-term impact.
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally, whilst supporting our clients to improve as well.
Your capabilities:
You will be a seasoned Cost Manager, with extensive experience working directly with clients, ideally with some stints working for Tier 1 or 2 Contractors as well, to provide the well-rounded experience that is hugely valuable as a consultant. You understand that successful commercial management, is reliant on creating a collaborative working environment with all disciplines.
You must have:
- Mastery: Cost Management background with at least 10+ years of experience on construction projects.
- Communication: Proficient in written and spoken English communication skills. Additional language abilities are appreciated.
- Leadership: A relentless approach to dealing with people.
- Impact: A track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics.

We are Shape.Construction !
About the job
Contractors bleed margin on every project.
Unmanaged change. Disputed claims. Missing records. When field teams don't follow processes, events go undocumented. Commercial teams scramble for evidence that doesn't exist. Disputes drag on. Recoverable profit vanishes. On high-value projects, millions of pounds disappear.
Why?
- Field teams use clunky tools that are too complex and too slow. Critical events never get recorded. The audit trail has gaps.
- Commercial teams fight disputes with weak evidence, chase missing records, and lose recoverable margin while the business faces unnecessary claims.
Shape fixes this once and for all.
Shape is the only platform simple enough for field teams to adopt instantly, yet powerful enough to drive real commercial outcomes.
Site teams capture every issue, event, and change in real time. Shape automatically builds the bulletproof evidence commercial teams need to defend and recover claims.
The result: Fewer lost disputes. Faster resolutions. Full subcontractor accountability. Commercial teams manage change proactively instead of reacting to it.
This is the problem we solve. But to really help our customers, we need experts who understand their pain first-hand. Many of our customers are Quantity Surveyors. Who better to consult them than other Quantity Surveyors?
That's where you come in.
We are looking for a seasoned Managing Quantity Surveyor ready not just for a change of role, but a change of industry. This is your opportunity to break away from the grind of construction and step into the fast-growing world of construction SaaS.
As our Manager of Commercial Strategy, you'll use your hard-won expertise to guide other commercial teams through the biggest challenge they face: change and claims. Instead of battling over margins on a single project, you'll be leading conversations that transform how entire companies protect their profit. This is consultative sales and customer success at the highest level - where your becomes the product and your impact scales far beyond any single contract.
_________________________________________________________________________________________
Purpose of the role
To partner with our customers' commercial teams, helping them take control of change, disputes and claims using Shape. You will use your industry expertise to show them how to protect margin, build defensible records, and prevent the losses that most projects suffer today.
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Consult with commercial leaders to uncover where they are losing profit to change and disputes, and show how Shape stops margin leakage.
2. Support customer adoption ensuring site and office teams use Shape consistently to capture changes, issues and claims.
3. Coach customers on strengthening claims and defending disputes with documented, auditable records.
4. Act as the commercial voice inside Shape, shaping product development to better match the realities of construction projects.
5. Share best practice and lessons learned across our customer base, raising standards and outcomes for the entire industry.
Your Capabilities
- Significant experience as a Commercial Manager or in a similar construction role.
- Deep understanding of how unmanaged change and poor records erode project profitability.
- Strong communication skills - able to win trust and explain complex issues simply.
- Strategic thinker who can move from diagnosing problems to implementing solutions.
- Desire to make an industry-wide impact, not just improve a single project or business.
Nice to Have (If you don’t have it now you will after joining):
- Experience advising or consulting with multiple stakeholders.
- Knowledge of SaaS platforms or digital transformation in construction.
- Comfortable leading workshops, training sessions, or customer presentations.
- Ability to link commercial pain points to practical technology solutions.
Shape isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
At Shape we value diverse experiences and perspectives, empowering each member to contribute their unique capabilities towards our collective success, so if you don’t think you meet all the criteria but still are excited about this role we encourage you to apply anyway!
_________________________________________________________________________________________
Salary and Benefits
Standard Stuff
- Extremely competitive
- Paid annual leave (varies by location) + statutory bank holidays
- Private health insurance
- In-house coaching sessions
- Discretionary bonus scheme for all team members
The Life-Changing Stuff
- 4 Day Weeks: that’s right, every week
- Flexibility: We care about outcomes, not clock-watching
- Grow your whole self: Access to a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-focused environment designed to give you 5 years of growth in 1 year
- Be surrounded by the best: We only hire the top talent; progression is fast and development is unbounded.
- Long-term impact: Shape is tackling the single biggest issue in construction delivery, with solutions designed to spread and outlast us.
*Please do not book a demo via the Shape website as part of the application.

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer
Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed
ABOUT NIVODA
Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.
Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.
We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.
WHY THIS ROLE & WHY NOW
You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.
Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.
Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.
Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.
Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.
Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.
WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE
First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.
90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.
Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.
THE STANDARD
A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.
Three things must not fail in this role.
- Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.
- Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.
- Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.
That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.
What you bring
- A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.
- You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.
- You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.
- A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.
- You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.
- You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.
Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.
WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.
It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.
WHAT WE OFFER
Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down.…

SENIOR DATA ENGINEER
ABOUT KEYROCK
Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
Today, we partner with over 250 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from self-taught DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels, and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
We are trading on more than 80 trading venues, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.

ABOUT THE TEAM AND WHY THE ROLE EXISTS
The Central Data Team (CDT) is only a few months old, but data has been Keyrock's lifeblood since day one. We're now building the Keyrock Data Platform to give Keyrockers, and the AI agents working alongside them, the data and context they need to act fast and autonomously within agreed boundaries and aligned with our shared goals. Doing that means taking data from across the company and making sense of it in real time for all the functions that depend on it: trading desks, wealth and asset management, product, risk, finance, compliance, and research to name a few.
You'd be one of the early hires in CDT and we expect you to contribute to most of the bigger decisions and build work. The standards we settle on and the way the team ends up working are still open.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Build streaming and batch pipelines that ingest, normalise, and distribute market, trading, and portfolio data, resilient to feed and exchange failures.
- Build the self-serve tooling (SDKs, patterns, templates, AI agents) so other teams publish, consume, and build on data products without waiting on us.
- Own data contracts and schema evolution. Keep schema changes from turning into multi-team coordination events.
- Design the lakehouse and time-series layer around consumer query patterns.
- Build and evolve the Data Governance and Data Quality Framework: stale-feed detection, schema validation, range checks, idempotent writes, lineage, ownership, self-healing.
- Build the derived analytics the business runs on: cross-exchange spreads, VWAP at depth, order book microstructure for the desks; portfolio views, exposure, performance for wealth and asset management.
- Make observability, cost, and performance first-class from day one.
- Treat infrastructure as code (Docker, Terraform, CI/CD) alongside our Central Infrastructure Team.
- Work in the open: write things down, partner closely with Architecture, Infrastructure, Platform, and the rest of the teams.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Tools matter less to us than how you think about problems. That said, here's the shape of the person we have in mind.
Engineering Craft
- 8+ years of building production data systems that other people rely on.
- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL: not just being able to write a query, but being able to reason about what the engine is doing with it.
- Code that's easy for someone else to read, test, and delete later.
- Strong understanding of data modelling for both streaming and analytical workloads.
- Efficiency, quality, idempotency, and observability are taken seriously by default.
Systems Design
- You've designed and operated streaming systems on Kafka, Redpanda, MSK, or Kinesis, and you have opinions about partitioning, consumer groups, offsets, and schema registries.
- You've used a time-series store in production (ClickHouse ideally; TimescaleDB, QuestDB, or similar are fine too) and can talk about table design as a function of query patterns.
- You've worked with a lakehouse architecture and reason about table layout, partitioning, and compaction as design choices that shape query performance and storage cost.
- You build for self-healing and idempotency. Reprocessing is safe, retries don't double-write, and the system recovers without a human in the loop.
Operational Readiness
- Docker, Terraform, and CI/CD are how you work, not a separate "DevOps" thing.
- You think about cost and performance early.
- You instrument as you build: logs, metrics, and traces are part of the system from day one.
- You design for data quality and governance up front covering contracts, validation, lineage, and ownership
How You Think and Work
- You reason from first principles when a problem is new, stay pragmatic when it isn't, and update your view when you learn more.
- You treat the trading desks, wealth and asset management, product, risk, finance, compliance, and research as customers of what you build, and communicate with them that way.
- You optimise for outcomes over output. A smaller, simpler thing that ships and works beats a bigger thing that doesn't.
- You take ownership end-to-end: design, ship, operate, improve.
- You say what you think including when it's an unpopular take. You change your mind when the argument is better.
- You make the people around you better. Reviews are real, juniors grow from working with you, and peers want to work with you again.
- You're curious about how markets work. Data engineering on its own won't keep you interested here.
- You're honest about what you know and what you don't, and quick to close the gap.
- You understand financial market data: order books, trades, reference data, portfolios, exposures. Crypto, TradFi, or both are a strong plus.
NICE TO HAVE
- Lakehouse experience with Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake.
- Familiarity with DataHub or similar metadata/lineage platforms.
- Rust. Some of our performance-critical services are written in it. Interest is welcome; fluency isn't required.

- A from-scratch mandate. You'll be among the first hires in CDT, and the platform, the standards, and the team culture are yours to shape with us.

- Autonomy on how you work. Flexible hours, remote-first, business-hours on-call shared across the team.

- A team that likes each other. Regular online get-togethers and a yearly onsite where everyone's in the same room.

We are seeking a Senior Rust Engineer with deep trading systems experience and strong AWS knowledge to join our core Capital Markets division. Candidates with a passion for the Rust ecosystem and a proven track record designing, building, and operating mission-critical trading systems will be at a significant advantage.
As part of the engineering team in Capital Markets, you will take ownership of high-impact trading infrastructure, set technical direction in your domain, and drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operability. You will join a highly-profitable, fast-paced division within Keyrock, where you will be expected to make a senior individual-contributor impact while collaborating with a global, fully-remote team. This role is open to candidates located in European time zones.
JOB DESCRIPTION
- Design, develop, and optimise low-latency, mission-critical trading systems
- Own key trading stack components end-to-end — from architecture through to production operation
- Collaborate closely with quants, traders, and engineers to deliver solutions that improve trading performance and resilience
- Maintain and evolve trading infrastructure with a focus on performance, stability, observability, and operational excellence
- Troubleshoot complex production issues across exchange connectivity, execution, and market data handling
- Drive engineering standards through technical leadership, code reviews, and mentoring
- Embrace agentic engineering principles: leverage AI-assisted workflows, drive automation of operational tasks, and help evolve the team's agentic tooling
- Contribute to functional, component, and production-readiness testing for critical trading components
BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE
TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Production-grade Rust experience building high-performance, concurrent systems; proficiency with Tokio is a strong advantage
- Hands-on experience in a systematic trading environment (HFT, Market Making, Quantitative Trading, or similar), with solid understanding of execution, market data, and operational risk
- Strong AWS and Linux expertise, including cloud infrastructure trade-offs for latency-sensitive workloads, shell scripting, debugging, and production troubleshooting
- Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages for strategy development, automation, and operational tooling
- Deep familiarity with trading system protocols (FIX, REST, WebSocket), exchange connectivity, and market data feeds
- Solid grasp of low-latency networking: TCP/UDP, packet and latency path analysis, dedicated network infrastructure, and kernel bypass techniques (DPDK)
- Familiarity with agentic engineering tools and concepts: LLMs, MCP APIs, AI-First IDEs (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code), harness engineering, and workflow automation
- Ability to make sound architectural decisions, articulate trade-offs clearly, and guide implementation across complex systems
SENIORITY & COMPETENCIES
- Ownership & Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
- Initiative & Problem-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
- Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
- Technical Leadership – Influence system design, raise engineering standards, mentor other engineers, and help the team make pragmatic, high-quality technical decisions.
- Curiosity & Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
- Agentic Engineering – Embrace AI-assisted workflows and autonomous agents, pushing the boundaries of what engineering teams can achieve through intelligent automation.
- Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.
OUR RECRUITMENT PHILOSOPHY
We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A senior engineer and crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership, raises the bar for others, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
OUR OFFER
- A competitive salary package
- Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
- The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence
As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

- Web3 & Digital Asset Passion: Strong understanding of and active, deep interest in Web3.0, digital assets, blockchain primitives, and capital markets.
- Analytical & Prototyping Mindset: Ability to analyze technical documentation, work with data/on-chain telemetry, evaluate emerging technologies, and build quantitative models or prototype tools.
- Drive & Ownership: Self-starter with strong communication skills, curiosity to learn rapidly, and an owner mentality to contribute directly to strategic projects.

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You work directly with scientists to design experiments, develop new assays and generate the data they need to advance their research. You'll combine hands-on experimental work in our automated lab with close scientific collaboration with the teams we support.
In London, a large share of that work is with ARIA. Adaptyv has been selected for ARIA's second cohort of Activation Partners, and ARIA, the UK's Advanced Research + Invention Agency, is funding our new automated lab in London: the UK's first AI-native automated wet lab.
ARIA backs ambitious research across opportunity spaces such as Sculpting Innate Immunity, Manufacturing Abundance and Programmable Plants. The teams it funds, called Creators, often need experimental capabilities that do not yet exist. You'll work directly with those teams to understand their scientific challenges, design and develop the assays they need, and work hands-on with our scientists to validate and bring these workflows onto our automation platform.
Our goal is to help the next 100 UK biotechs and neopharmas get started by the end of 2028.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Lead experimental projects with ARIA Creators. Work directly with research teams to translate their biological questions into experimental plans, defining targets, success criteria, constructs, controls and assays.
- Design and execute experiments. Take an active role in the lab, designing, running and troubleshooting experiments across protein expression, binding, biophysical characterisation and other workflows.
- Develop new experimental capabilities. When an ARIA programme needs an assay that does not yet exist, work with the Creator team and our scientists to develop it, validate it and bring it onto the automation platform.
- Turn data into decisions. Analyse binding, expression, stability and other assay data with Creators, interpret results and help determine which experiments to pursue next.
- Shape future ARIA programmes. Work with ARIA Programme Directors to understand the experimental capabilities upcoming Creator cohorts are likely to need and help us prepare for them.
- Build long-term scientific partnerships. Become a trusted scientific counterpart to the teams you work with, combining hands-on experimental expertise with an understanding of their research goals. Bring what you learn back into our science and platform roadmap.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- Strong protein science foundation. A degree and/or hands-on experience in protein design, computational biology, biochemistry, structural biology or a related field.
- Biophysical characterisation experience. Deep hands-on experience with SPR, BLI, nanoDSF or related methods is required, including experimental design, data interpretation and troubleshooting.
- Experience developing and optimising assays. You know how to establish new experimental workflows, identify sources of variability, design appropriate controls and validate that an assay produces reliable data.
- Strong experimental data analysis skills. Able to interpret experimental results, assess data quality and use findings to guide subsequent experiments.
- Excellent scientific communication. Able to work closely with researchers, understand what they are trying to achieve and explain experimental approaches, results and trade-offs clearly.
- Comfort with ambiguity. You can take an underspecified scientific problem, form hypotheses, design the right experiments and iterate when things do not work.
- High ownership. You take responsibility for scientific outcomes, from initial experimental design through execution, troubleshooting and interpretation.
- Experience with lab automation, high-throughput experimentation or working with external scientific partners is a plus.
DETAILS
- Location: London, UK (on-site), with travel to customers and ARIA Creator sites, and regular time at our Lausanne lab.
- Type: Full time
- Start date: ASAP. Our London lab comes online in 2027.
Application deadline
We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Adaptyv is opening a London lab in 2026. Beyond running experiments, we want it to become an important part of the UK life-science ecosystem: giving biotech companies and researchers access to high-throughput protein production and characterisation, running work for partners such as Anthropic and Boltz, and building a strong local community around protein engineering.
You will join as one of the first UK hires, working closely with the founders, the Head of UK Operations, and the team in Lausanne.
You will own much of the customer-, partner-, and community-facing operation in the UK. That means onboarding customers, running strategic programmes, coordinating events and partnerships, and making sure the London operation is visible, organised, and easy to work with.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own UK customer operations. Support customers from onboarding through experiment submission and delivery of results, working closely with our scientific and commercial teams in Lausanne.
- Run strategic programmes and partnerships. Own milestones, reporting, partner reviews, deliverables, and the operating cadence behind our UK collaborations. Keep multiple stakeholders aligned and make sure commitments turn into action.
- Build Adaptyv's UK community presence. Organise competitions, hackathons, meetups, workshops, and conference activities together with our broader community team.
- Drive UK marketing and communications. Coordinate announcements, event content, case studies, customer stories, and other material that builds awareness around Adaptyv and the London lab.
- Build the operating systems behind your work. Create lightweight processes, automate repetitive workflows, and continuously improve how customers, partners, and internal teams work together.
- Pick up whatever else needs ownership. As one of the first people on the ground, your scope will evolve quickly as the London operation grows.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- You have a life-sciences background. A degree in biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, or a related field is strongly preferred. You will work closely with scientists and regularly discuss protein engineering experiments and assays.
- You have a track record of running complex projects. This could come from operations, programme management, partnerships, a startup, an accelerator, a VC fund, or a scientific organisation. We care more about what you have owned than your title or years of experience.
- You are exceptionally organised. You can manage customers, partners, deadlines, events, and internal stakeholders in parallel without losing track of the details.
- You communicate clearly. You can write concise partner updates, run effective meetings, and represent Adaptyv confidently with customers and at events.
- You operate with high ownership. You are comfortable with ambiguity, figure out what needs to happen, and drive it through to completion.
- You use AI as part of how you work. We use tools like Claude Code and our own software throughout Adaptyv, including for operations work. We expect you to be comfortable using AI to move faster and improve how work gets done.
- You are in London. This is an on-site role. You are already based there or ready to move.
DETAILS
- Location: London, UK — on-site
- Type: Full-time
- Start: As soon as possible
- Target lab opening: 2026
Application deadline

PRINCIPAL ENGINEER, DATA QUALITY PLATFORM
You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it.
Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does.
You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead AI-first data quality engineering
- Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement.
- Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means:
- Sequencing and gap detection
- Snapshot-to-increment consistency
- Reconnect and replay correctness
- Staleness of live subscriptions
- Agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state
- Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.
- Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.
- Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.
- When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.
- Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate.
Run data governance
- Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change.
- Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata.
Own reference and security master data
- Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs.
- Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback.
Expand coverage across the firm
- Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to:
- Trade signals
- Pre-trade analytics
- Client post-trade analysis
- PMS analytics
QUALIFICATIONS
- A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data.
- A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes.
- Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end.
- Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership.
- Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems.
- A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling.
- Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems.
- Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/basecamp-research/eaadb.description_excerpt:
About us
Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.
Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.
In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.
At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.
The Role
This role is the operational spine of the Trillion Gene Atlas. You will own the sample-to-sequence pipeline end-to-end, driving throughput, translating R&D into production, and leading the team that keeps the Atlas growing.
- Own the TGA production pipeline. Provide agile, end-to-end management of the sample processing pipeline across Phase 1 and Phase 2 - from DNA extraction through library preparation and sequencing dispatch. You set the pace and hold the targets.
- Lead technical transfer from R&D into production. Work closely with our R&D team to translate validated protocols into robust, scalable production workflows. You are the bridge between experimental and operational - ensuring new methods land cleanly and run reliably at volume.
- Drive continuous improvement. Apply Lean / Six Sigma principles to continuously improve turnaround times, reduce variability, and increase throughput. Identify bottlenecks, implement fixes, and build improvements back into the standard workflow.
- Monitor data input and pipeline health. Work with data suppliers and internal bioinformatics teams to ensure smooth, high-quality data return from sequencing partners. Track key metrics, flag issues early, and close the loop between production and downstream analysis.
- Lead and develop the production team. You will be the operational lead for the TGA lab team - managing day-to-day workflow, mentoring junior staff, and building a culture of precision, accountability, and pace as we scale through Phase 2.
- Horizon scan and deploy new technologies. Stay ahead of emergent sequencing technologies, automation platforms, and workflow innovations. Evaluate fit for TGA production targets and move and sync quickly to pilot and implement where there is clear operational value.
Required Skills and Experience
- 5+ years working in a production-based environment for high-throughput sequencing, with a confident track record running a small team to deliver high-impact work on time.
- Deep familiarity with short-read (Illumina / Ultima) and long-read (PacBio / Nanopore) platforms and library preparation workflows end-to-end.
- Demonstrable track record applying Lean / Six Sigma in a laboratory production setting - waste reduction, throughput improvement, SOP development.
- Experience with laboratory automation - developing, validating, and maintaining automated liquid handling and sample processing workflows.
- Strong team leadership capability - managing production schedules, resource allocation, and multi-person workflows under throughput pressure.
- Experience with LIMS platforms (Benchling or equivalent) for sample tracking and workflow management.
- Background in technical transfer and SOP writing for handoff between R&D and production teams.
- Comfort working across interdisciplinary teams, bioinformatics, data science, collaborations, to align production outputs with downstream analytical needs.
Advantageous Skills and Experience
- Hands-on DNA extraction experience across diverse sample types including soils, environmental, and biological matrices.
- Familiarity with multiplexed library preparation strategies for low-biomass and environmentally complex samples.
- Experience with metagenomic or environmental sequencing projects at scale.
What we offer in return
- Impactful Mission: This is a rare opportunity to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics.
- Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class scientists, engineers, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in Boston and London, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.
- High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our people and their development, we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.
- Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, pension plan, and healthcare so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own.
APPLY FOR THE JOB
Do you want to join our team as our new Production Sequencing Lead? Then we'd love to hear about you!
We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

THE ROLE
As we continue to unlock our planet's biodiversity, we are looking for ambitious people with a passion for the development of extraction and sequencing workflows to continuously improve our data generation.
You will have the opportunity to help further build out our DNA / RNA pipelines to build the most diverse database in the world. This role will take ownership of our extraction workflows, developing methods to recover usable nucleic acids from challenging, varied, and low biomass environmental samples. You will be comfortable choosing and adapting lysis strategies, binding chemistries, inhibitor removal approaches, choosing the best commercial options and adapting or building your own additions where needed.
You will also be responsible for transfer of extraction methods to our production team and Global Partner Network across more than 30 countries. You'll be comfortable with sequencing workflows from end to end, from extraction through to library preparation, and have experience with both short and long read technologies, including high molecular weight (HMW) extraction methods. Virology experience in both extraction and sequencing would also be beneficial to this role. You'll understand when good is good enough and can support handover for testing and implementation in production.
The role is laboratory based but you will have ownership over your projects. You’ll work in a data-first environment, using experimental and sequencing-quality metrics to guide development, prioritisation and handover. Your work will feed directly into Basecamp Research’s Trillion Gene Atlas, transforming diverse global samples into high-quality biological data that reveals new genes, proteins, pathways and function from nature.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Working with the R&D Lead, Director of Production and wider R&D and Production teams and collaborators, align R&D projects in order and prioritise during data pushes.
- Own the R&D extraction workflow development. Adapt and optimise metagenomic extraction methods across a broad range of sample types (e.g. water, soil, sediments, faeces, biofilms), including approaches for low-biomass and inhibitor-rich matrices.
- Develop DNA / RNA purification methods using kits / chemistries / adaptation / in-house development to recover viruses and microbes, including high molecular weight (HMW) extractions suitable for long-read sequencing.
- Design well-controlled experiments to compare extraction chemistries and processing methods, define success criteria up front and generate validation data to support them.

ABOUT THE ROLE

RESPONSIBILITIES
- Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.
- Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.
- Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.
- Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.
- Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.
- Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.
- Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.

- Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.

- Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.
- Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.
- Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.
- Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.
- Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.
- Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time
___________________________________________________________________________
HELP PUT FRONTIER AI TO WORK IN DEFENCE
Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.
We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints.
We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.
We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery.
You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability.
___________________________________________________________________________
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems
- Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases.
- Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence.
- Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems.
- Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation.
- Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints.
- Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes.
Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment
- Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects.
- Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures.
- Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders.
- Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution.
- Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities.
- Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving.
Work directly with Defence customers
- Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem.
- Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference.
- Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans.
- Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart.
- Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments.
Turn research into operational capability
- Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems.
- Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability.
- Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement.
- Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints.
- Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams.
- Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it.
___________________________________________________________________________
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work.
You should be comfortable:
- Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
- Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models.
- Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance.
- Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints.
- Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute.
- Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities.
- Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users.
- Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth.
- Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear.
- You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems.
