EMEA Revenue Operations Manager

London, UK

Sigma is expanding its footprint across EMEA, and we need a Revenue Operations Manager to turn that plan into a working operation. You will sit at the centre of the expansion, working with sales leaders across the region to build the systems, cadences and plans that let new markets scale quickly.

This role is less ops coordinator and more trusted advisor, with a bias for action and a sharp analytical mind. You have done market expansion work before, you would rather design the system than run the report, and you get uncomfortable when you are the last to see a problem coming.

What you will own

  • The operational plan for our EMEA expansion: market entry sequencing, territory and coverage design, headcount and capacity planning, and the milestones that tell us whether each new market is on track.
  • The operating rhythm of a high-growth, multi-country sales organisation, including QBRs, planning cycles, leadership offsites and the cadences that keep teams in different markets and time zones aligned.
  • Annual and half-year planning for EMEA, built from the ground up with regional sales leadership. You will own the process, the timeline and the room.
  • The health of the whole GTM engine in EMEA, from lead to upsell: lead flow, pipeline generation and coverage, conversion, forecast accuracy, renewals and expansion.
  • Strategic diagnostics: the leading indicators, structural risks and pipeline dynamics that show where each market is headed before the quarter does.
  • Regional execution detail, including multi-currency forecasting and pricing, partner and cloud marketplace deal flow, and country-specific requirements for data, contracts and hiring, in step with Finance, Legal and People.
  • AI-native workflows that remove manual work and let sales leaders spend their time on decisions, not dashboards.
  • A direct line to senior leadership, with the credibility to challenge as well as advise. You will be expected to have a view, and to defend it.

What we are looking for

  • 8 - 10 years of experience in Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations or a Chief of Staff function inside a high-growth B2B SaaS business.
  • Direct experience of launching or scaling a sales organisation in new international markets, ideally across several EMEA countries, and a clear view of what worked and what did not.
  • Deep knowledge of how a high-performance GTM engine runs end to end, from lead to upsell: lead flow and conversion, pipeline creation and hygiene, forecasting, territory management, coverage models, renewals and expansion, operating rhythms and annual planning.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can take a complex situation, translate it for the right audience and land a clear point of view in two minutes or two slides.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and speed, and the flexibility to handle shifting priorities across time zones and cultures.
  • Curiosity about AI and automation, and the ability to build them into our current systems to raise speed and efficiency while keeping operational rigour. We are rebuilding how this function works at scale, and this role will be a key part of that work.

Who you are

  • Present. You will work with experienced sales leaders and cross-functional partners who have seen every ops hire before. You build trust quickly and know how to earn a seat at the table.
  • Proactive. You look around corners, flag risks early and arrive with a point of view rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Precise. You give a sharp read and a recommended next step. No unnecessary slides and no endless dashboards.
  • A builder. You treat process as infrastructure and enjoy making things work better at scale.

Nice to have

Fluency in one or more European languages, and experience with partner or channel operations.

Why this role

This role sits where that growth needs sharper operational thinking. You will not maintain a legacy system. You will help build the operation that takes Sigma into new European markets, working with sales leaders who want a real partner and a VP of Ops who cares about how this function runs. If that sounds like the work you do best, we would like to hear from you.

A successful candidate will be able to:

  • Manage the day-to-day administration of Verifone's global portfolio of legal entities, with a focus on EMEA entities.
  • Coordinate annual corporate maintenance requirements, including director and officer appointments, board and shareholder approvals, statutory filings, powers of attorney, and corporate recordkeeping.
  • Liaise with corporate secretarial service providers and internal stakeholders regarding governance matters.
  • Maintain corporate records, minute books, organizational charts, and entity management databases.
  • Support legal entity formations, restructurings, mergers, liquidations, and other corporate transactions.
  • Review, draft, and negotiate routine commercial agreements under attorney supervision, including:
    • Non-disclosure agreements (NDAs)
    • Vendor agreements
    • Customer forms and standard commercial contracts
    • Amendments, renewals, and statements of work
  • Support implementation and administration of contract lifecycle management processes.
  • Coordinate legal requests and inquiries from internal business partners.
  • Contribute to process improvements that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the legal function.

Required Experience and Qualifications

A successful candidate will have:

  • Minimum of 10 years of paralegal, corporate governance, legal operations, or related legal experience.
  • Experience supporting corporate entities across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Strong familiarity with corporate governance requirements and entity management practices.
  • Experience reviewing and administering NDAs and other routine commercial agreements.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Proficiency with AI tools, Microsoft Office applications, and legal technology tools.
  • Experience working in a multinational or international company with operations across Europe and other regions.

Our Commitment

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Why Verifone

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide. Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. 

We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors.  

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy. 

What's Exciting About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager – Hardware. In this role you will be pivotal in translating Verifone’s global hardware strategy into strong regional commercial performance. Sitting at the intersection of Global Hardware Product, Regional Product, Sales, and Customer Success, this role ensures that EMEA markets receive the right solutions, at the right time, with the right positioning 

Key Responsibilities:

Regional Hardware Strategy & Catalogue Ownership 

  • Own and manage the EMEA hardware product catalogue — maintaining accuracy across device models, configurations, lifecycle status, and regional availability

Global ↔ Regional Hardware Liaison

  • Champion EMEA's voice in global hardware strategy — feeding market insights into the roadmap that reflect field intelligence, customer requirements, and competitive dynamics,  briefing stakeholders on updates, and sharing pipeline visibility to keep cross-functional teams aligned. 

Regulatory & Payment-Scheme Compliance: 

  • Own EMEA's regional certification roadmap (PCI PTS, EMVCo,).Pre-Production & Sample Management 
  • Control and distribute pre-production hardware samples within the region, coordinating with internal teams and external partners. 
  • Manage NPI (New Product Introduction) readiness activities within the region — ensuring internal teams are prepared ahead of commercial availability. 
  • Control and distribute pre-production hardware samples across the region, and manage NPI (New Product Introduction) readiness to ensure internal teams are prepared ahead of commercial availability. 

Hardware Lifecycle & EOL Management 

  • Own EOS/EOL planning for EMEA  

Sales Enablement & Customer Engagement 

  • Own the EMEA hardware demo/evaluation programme (device configuration, refresh, field enablement), support RFPs with technical positioning, and represent Verifone as the hardware SME in customer QBRs, pilot evaluations, and partner engagements with the credibility of a subject matter expert 

Partner Enablement 

  • Support the enablement of ISV & Acquirer channels and serve as the point of contact for strategic partner reviews and roadmap briefings. 

Competitive  Positioning 

  • Maintain current competitive hardware positioning for Sales and Product teams, and monitor market signals to identify portfolio enhancements. 

Field Quality & Reliability 

  • Escalation Support 

KPIs & Reporting 

  • Define and maintain the regional hardware scorecard — catalogue accuracy, certification cycle time, NPI readiness, time-to-market on new SKUs, and field reliability KPIs. 
  • Deliver a regular hardware operating review to EMEA Product, Sales, and CS leadership; surface risks, dependencies, and decisions needed from the global team. 
  • Define and maintain the EMEA hardware scorecard (certification NPI readiness,), and deliver regular operating reviews to Product & Sales leadership.  

Required Skills and Experience we desire

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or a related technical role within the payments or fintech industry; Senior PM level or equivalent. 
  • Hands-on expertise in card-present payment environments — POS hardware, payment terminals, EMV certification, processes. 
  • Direct familiarity with payment terminal hardware ecosystems; experience with Verifone or a competing hardware vendor strongly preferred. 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a product catalogue or portfolio across SKU lifecycle, pricing coordination, and regional availability. 
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to drive outcomes across Product, Sales, Operations, Engineering, and CS without direct authority. 
  • Customer-facing credibility: comfortable presenting hardware roadmaps and product positions to enterprise customers, partners, and senior internal stakeholders. 
  • Excellent written communication skills; able to produce clear regional POVs, competitive briefs, and executive-level summaries. 
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-moving, matrixed environment. 

Desirable Skills and Experience

  • Background in pre-production hardware evaluation, sample management, or New Product Introduction (NPI) processes. 
  • Experience supporting enterprise Sales teams with technical RFP responses, demo programmes, and hardware-level competitive positioning.

Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors.

We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management.

The role sits within our Fundamental Commodities strategy, where you will work closely with the Senior Portfolio Manager. Within our collaborative environment, you will design and build the systems and tools that underpin the firm's trading and research. 

Your focus will initially be on software development: adding functionality required for new trading strategies and maintaining the existing signal pipeline. Over time, you will become more involved in research, eventually running projects independently.

We seek a highly skilled developer with strong computer science fundamentals to join our Quantitative Platform team. This team is responsible for developing the core platforms that underpin and provide data to the research and trading of our quantitative investment strategies, alongside tools, APIs, libraries, and user interfaces to support this.

In this role you will work closely with our research and other technology teams to deliver high impact projects that improve our ability to predict and trade movements in global financial markets.

Our Technology 

Operating in a cloud-first environment, we predominantly write our backend systems in C# but otherwise make pragmatic choices for each scenario. This often means Python with C++ employed in performance-sensitive cases.

Our applications are written with containerisation in mind from the outset and deployed as a Docker image into Kubernetes on AWS where we can scale on-demand to satisfy burstable workloads. We make extensive use of Kafka for low-latency communication across applications and use a mixture of different technologies for storage, from S3 to relational databases. We utilise GitHub for source control and Jenkins for CI, though with an increasing interest in GitHub Actions.

We constantly evaluate our stack to ensure we’re using the most appropriate technologies for the needs of our business and the efficient delivery of those requirements.

  • Build and maintain a world-class platform that enables storage, transformation, and testing of data at scale by leveraging the latest open-source software, cloud, and distributed computing technologies.

  • Comfortable using agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code and are genuinely keen to use them as a natural part of daily work
  • Collaborative nature and ability to work in a team e.g., partnering with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and other technologists.
  • Strong interest in keeping abreast of latest technologies and a measured approach for adopting them.
  • Comfortable with problem solving across multiple technologies and business domains.

  • Experience engineering systems for the cloud-based storage and processing of large datasets or using frameworks such as Spark and open standards like Parquet and Arrow.

  • Experience working as a software developer in the quantitative hedge fund space.
  • Experience building web applications using front-end frameworks such as Angular.

Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Verve For Advertisers is a technology company that empowers brands and agencies to target audiences based on declared intent, following them from initial curiosity to ultimate decisioning, to drive measurable outcomes.

We've unified the company's demand-side offering under the VFA name, bringing together the largest on-site search-intent dataset outside of walled gardens — built on data partnerships with 3M+ websites, LLM chat signals, and survey data — and premium inventory grounded in our direct SDK integrations. Our technology captures both what consumers do and why they do it, delivering high-fidelity audiences, insights, and outcomes across premium omnichannel inventory.

About the team

Verve is building a Brand Direct function — a small, senior team that sells and services select brand accounts directly, alongside our existing agency relationships, rather than replacing them. The goal is to get Verve's data, formats, and capabilities into brand planning conversations earlier, and to prove that dedicated brand-side support grows accounts faster than agency coverage alone.

This is a new team and a founding hire. You'll help define what “brand direct” looks like at Verve in practice, working closely with the Global VP of Brand Partnerships from day one.

The role

As Brand Partnerships Director, UK, you'll own a portfolio of named brand accounts in the UK, working as a generalist across categories rather than a single vertical. This is a senior individual contributor role — not a people-management role in the first instance — designed for someone who wants to build something and has the option to grow into managing a local team as the function scales.

You are a hunter first: someone who can open doors at brand (not agency) level, build credibility fast, and turn a first meeting into a durable, revenue-generating relationship. Prior experience or relationships in a specific vertical (e.g. CPG/Retail, Travel, Finance, Beauty/Lux) are a strong plus, as this role has the potential to grow into leading a vertical specialist team.

Responsibilities include

  • Build senior brand relationships — Owning relationships at CMO, Global Head of Media, and VP of Brand level, along with key line-of-business leads such as Data, Creative, and Measurement within the brand.
  • Get ahead of the brief — Getting into brand planning cycles early so Verve's data, formats, and capabilities are already part of the conversation before the brief reaches the agency.
  • Represent Verve in the room — Representing Verve at brand-side (not agency-side) forums, marketing conferences, and roundtables to build Verve's profile with brand teams directly.
  • Commission insight work — Working with the insights and data teams to build brand-specific audience stories, category reports, and trend pieces that give brands a reason to meet and stay engaged.
  • Secure Joint Business Plans — Working towards annual brand frameworks that lock in investment and strategic commitment at brand level, independent of which agency holds the account.
  • Run the pilot — Building and pitching a defined target list of named accounts, with revenue tracked separately from non-brand-direct-supported business to prove the model.
  • Co-sell, don't compete — Partner with the existing agency sales team under a joint commercial framework — this role is additive to agency relationships, not competitive with them; revenue is double-counted so both sides are incentivized to collaborate.

Here are a few indicators that you're the right person

  • You have a track record of building and owning senior client relationships directly with brands or marketers, not solely through an agency or intermediary.
  • You have genuine “hunter” instincts — you're comfortable prospecting, opening new doors, and creating momentum in a newly-created role with no existing playbook.
  • You have an existing network of brand-side contacts in the UK; a specific category or vertical angle (e.g. CPG/Retail, Travel, Finance, Beauty/Lux) is a plus but not required.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and building process as you go — this is a Phase 1 hire into a function that will evolve quickly.
  • You have strong commercial instincts: you can read an account's growth potential and prioritize your time accordingly.
  • You bring experience in media, adtech, data, or a related commercial sales environment as helpful context, though the core skill this role requires is brand-side relationship building.

What We Offer

Just a few of the benefits waiting for you at Verve: 

  • Stay healthy with our Bupa HealthCare Plan with easy access to medical care
  • Support your long-term financial security with our Aviva Corporate Pension Scheme, with Verve contributing 5% of your qualifying earnings
  • Pick what matters most to you in our Personalized Benefits Platform, with a budget of  £50/month
  • Recharge with 25 paid vacation days + 3 Wellness days throughout the year, in addition to the public holidays

Boost your professional knowledge with our annual training budget & internal webinars… and even more reasons to join us!

Communications regarding your application will only come from @jungroup.com or @verve.com email addresses.

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role

Vercel's Enterprise sales team is built on people who are technically fluent, commercially sharp, and deeply curious about the companies they sell into. As a Majors AE covering some of the key EMEA markets, you will own a curated book of named enterprise accounts and be the primary driver of net-new revenue and platform expansion. You will work alongside Solutions Engineers, Partner Manager, and cross-functional Vercel stakeholders to bring Vercel's platform into some of the most digitally ambitious and transformational companies in the region.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What you'll do

  • Build and execute multi-year account plans across a curated set of named Major Accounts, with hyperscalers, SIs, and agency partners embedded in the strategy from day one
  • Drive net-new revenue through outbound ownership, rigorous discovery, executive alignment, and multi-threaded deal execution spanning engineering, product, procurement, legal, and the C-suite
  • Translate Vercel's platform into board-level narratives around developer velocity, infrastructure consolidation, and AI-driven transformation as measurable operational levers
  • Own complex commercial negotiations and establish Vercel as a long-term strategic infrastructure partner embedded in your accounts' roadmaps for web and AI transformation

What you need

  • 5–10+ years in enterprise SaaS with a demonstrated track record of closing six and seven-figure deals in major or strategic accounts
  • Experienced in partner-influenced or co-sell motions — you know how to activate a hyperscaler or SI/ISV relationship to open doors and accelerate deals, not just name-drop them
  • Fluent in English and local language requirements based on the territory you’re focused on
  • Comfortable discussing architecture with a CTO and total cost of ownership with a CFO
  • A disciplined account planner who thinks in years, builds executive relationships from scratch, and sequences complex accounts to maximise long-term revenue
  • Fluent in MEDDPICC and rigorous about forecast hygiene and CRM discipline
  • Able to hold credible, technically grounded conversations with senior engineering and product leadership — without leaning on a solutions engineer as a crutch
  • A value seller who leads with business outcomes and customer pain, not feature lists

Bonus if you

  • Have a background in web development, developer tooling, web infrastructure, cloud platforms, or AI/ML
  • Come with existing relationships at AWS, GCP, Azure, or major SI/ISV players active in the UK and Northern Europe markets
  • Have experience navigating ELAs, global framework agreements, or enterprise procurement in regulated industries
  • Have sold into media, retail, financial services, or digital-native companies — verticals where Vercel has strong traction in the UK market

Benefits & Compensation:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The London based pay range for this role is 200,000 - 270,000 GBP OTE. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

  • Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About Startups @ Vercel

The Vercel Startups org exists to help founders navigate the shift to AI-native development with confidence. Startups move faster than ever—what used to take years now happens in days—and the decisions founders make early can either unlock scale or become long-term constraints. We partner with startups at the critical moments where technical, commercial, and strategic support starts to matter most.

We’re a talent-dense team made up of former founders, engineers, and experienced go-to-market operators who bring firsthand experience building, scaling, and supporting modern software companies. Many of us have sat on the other side of the table, making architectural decisions, navigating tradeoffs, and scaling under real constraints, and we bring that perspective into every customer interaction.

We operate with a growth mindset and strong shared ownership. We dig deep to understand our customers, work closely across functions as one team, and find ways to win even when the path forward isn’t obvious. Resilience, curiosity, and a willingness to push through hard problems are table stakes here.

This is a team for people who want to operate with high trust, high agency, and high impact — alongside peers who care deeply about helping startups succeed.

About the role

You are an expert in Vercel, you have incredible pattern recognition, and are at the bleeding edge of the tech and tools defining how we live and work. In this role, you'll help startups unlock Vercel's full value from adoption through scaling—building relationships with founders and technical leaders who are making critical architectural decisions. You'll analyze usage patterns to identify expansion opportunities, coordinate cross-functional teams to drive outcomes, and guide teams as they adopt AI-native architectures. By leveraging automation and AI to maximize your impact, you'll help refine early plays into repeatable playbooks that scale across our startup portfolio.

If you’re based within commuting distance of our London office, the role includes in-office anchor days. 

What you'll do

  • Build trusted relationships with founders, developers, and technical leaders by quickly developing deep understanding of their architecture, use cases, and technical constraints
  • Landing new logos, driving early activation, and making Vercel the default choice before competitors get in
  • Driving first activation, earning trust fast, and positioning Vercel as the obvious default stack
  • Focus on pipeline generation, outbound, identifying high-potential startups early
  • Partner with founders and developers as they adopt AI-native features and architectures, helping them understand how Vercel’s Frontend Cloud fits into a rapidly evolving developer ecosystem and supports new workloads, performance requirements, and scaling patterns
  • Use automation, agents, and self-built workflows to operate at high leverage and focus time and energy on the most impactful customer work
  • Operate comfortably in an evolving environment, helping refine early motions and turn what works into repeatable playbooks

What you need

We’re looking for someone who sits at the intersection of technical curiosity, commercial excellence, and startup mindset. You identify pattern recognition, have founder empathy, and have the ability to speak credibly to pre-seed through Series D companies and beyond who are making fast decisions.

You might be a great fit if you’ve developed this skill set through a range of paths—whether as a builder, founder, engineer, or in a technical go-to-market role—and you bring strong judgment, ownership, and curiosity to how you work.

In practice, this looks like someone who:

  • Learns complex technical products quickly and enjoys reasoning about how modern web and AI-native applications are built and scaled
  • Can speak comfortably with developers and founders, using their language and earning credibility through insight rather than titles
  • Has strong sales acumen and experience owning revenue outcomes across a range of deal sizes and complexities
  • Believes that the best revenue outcomes come from deeply successful customers, not transactional selling
  • Brings a thoughtful, opinionated point of view on modern web infrastructure, frontend performance, and scaling tradeoffs
  • Thrives in ambiguity and enjoys shaping how a team and motion evolves from early to more structured
  • Is energized by ownership, accountability, and helping customers make smart decisions

What This Role Is Not

  • Not a pure Customer Success role focused on reactive support
  • Not a transactional sales role detached from customer outcomes
  • Not a highly scripted role with narrow ownership or predefined motions

This role requires judgment, curiosity, and comfort operating across technical, strategic, and commercial dimensions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Deal Desk Analyst to join the Deal Desk team within our Revenue Operations function. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the center of how we structure, price, and close business globally — partnering with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product to turn deals into signed revenue.

You will lead the quote-to-contract execution cycle for our global sales team while helping build the systems, processes, and playbooks that scale a world-class Deal Desk. As the organization continues through a period of rapid growth, we are looking for someone who wants to shape the function rather than inherit it — bringing structure to ambiguity, modernizing how deals get done, and raising the bar for commercial excellence.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Global Deal Desk, and is preferably based in a hybrid capacity out of our London office.

What you'll do

  • Deal Management — Own the day-to-day deal review and closing process end to end, including deal approvals, deal structuring, and quote configuration within Vercel CPQ, ensuring every deal is executed accurately and on time.
  • Commercialization & Execution — Drive deal execution in close partnership with Finance, Legal, GTM, Partnerships, Product, and Pricing. Design, build, and continuously optimize the sales and deal processes that bring new pricing, packaging, and product launches to market.
  • Trusted Advisor — Serve as the subject-matter expert for the Sales organization, providing deal guidance and operational support. Approach complex, non-standard deals with creativity and sound judgment, developing practical solutions in ambiguous situations.
  • Revenue Integrity — Act as the gatekeeper of data hygiene and opportunity data, partnering with GTM and Finance on audits for revenue recognition, financial reporting, and forecasting.
  • Insights & Enablement — Analyze deal performance and market trends to develop new sales motions, deal levers, and training materials that increase sales velocity and reduce business risk, in partnership with the Pricing and Field Enablement teams.
  • Operational Excellence — Identify opportunities to streamline, enhance, and automate processes. Translate needs into clear business requirements and leverage AI and automation to scale.

What you need

  • 4+ years of experience in deal desk, pricing, quote-to-cash, contract management, or a related Revenue Operations or Sales Operations function within the technology sector.
  • A proven record of partnering effectively with Sales and cross-functional teams to move complex deals forward.
  • Demonstrated experience in project management and process improvement.
  • A collaborative team member who consistently delivers excellent sales support.
  • A resourceful self-starter with strong critical-thinking and creative problem-solving skills.
  • You think naturally about operational implications and downstream impact.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments and operate effectively amid change and ambiguity.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (or a comparable CPQ platform)
  • A track record of using AI or automation to improve operational workflows.

Bonus if you

  • You’re located within London (HQ). We have offices for you to help build our office culture.

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative

About the job

This position is needed to play a key role in further growing Twilio’s social impact organization. As our Digital Inside Sales Representative, you will be responsible for lead qualification, net new customer acquisition, solution selling, and closing deals within our self-service accounts, while upholding the Twilio Magic and driving forward with the ultimate goal to help our customers do good. 

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for net new customer acquisition, managing an entire sales cycles to drive new revenue while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction for accounts across community & social services, healthcare, traditional NGO’s, Humanitarian aid, Credit Union and other miscellaneous non-profit customers.
  • Work with customers to understand their business and technical requirements. You will need to understand the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform so that, together, you can design a solution for their specific use case needs.
  • Work diligently with cross-functional internal teams (Sales, Sales Development, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Support) to address customer requirements, advise on digital communication strategies, and help customers get started on the Twilio platform.
  • Generate and maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce through proactive efforts and collaboration with your manager.
  • Execute automation strategies to serve a large quantity of customers while maintaining NPS and preventing churn 
  • Be an owner to drive deals forward, knock down obstacles for our customers and internally, think outside the box and find the best solution for each customer, and recommend process improvements to support the whole team.
  • Develop expertise in the social impact and nonprofit market to help prospective customers understand how others are leveraging Twilio’s platform to scale their reach and missions.
  • Have world-class interpersonal and communication skills to make complex technical and financial details sound simple.
  • Ability to balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

 

*Required:

  • At least 1+ years of closing sales experience or sales development/business development experience in a technical SaaS/CPaaS space, with a record of top performance.
  • An understanding of (or interest to understand) the cloud computing/communications business model and excitement for selling to a technical audience while utilizing a solution-oriented approach to selling.
  • Technical solutions selling experience and enjoys working with real customers - listening to them and solving problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and financial details sound simple.
  • Demonstrated track record of managing forecasts. 
  • Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.
  • World-class organization, prioritization, and documentation skills. 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Deep personal interest in the social impact market and dedicating your career to making a positive difference.
  • High adaptability, with comfort trying new things and building within a rapid-paced environment, comfort with ambiguity and change. 

Location

This role will be remote, and based in the UK.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

About the Opportunity
We are looking for a highly experienced Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO), who would hold the SMF17 Senior Management Function, to join MoonPay in the UK. You will own our AML/CTF and client asset protection (CASS) frameworks, act as a key voice in our regulatory relationship with the FCA, and contribute to MoonPay's application for full FSMA authorisation, all while enabling our mission to onboard the world to the decentralised economy.
You will sit within our International Compliance team, working closely with our Deputy MLRO, our EEA and international compliance colleagues, and our Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). Your work will directly protect customer funds and assets, strengthen our control environment, and help the wider authorisation effort land. As the UK entity grows, so will the scope of the role.
This is a great opportunity for an experienced compliance leader who thrives in dynamic, growing environments, is energised by building pioneering frameworks in a rapidly evolving regulatory landscape, and wants a practical, impactful role helping shape the future of crypto regulation in the UK.
What You Will Do
Serve as the appointed Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for MoonPay UK, holding the SMF17 Senior Management Function, and ensure full compliance with the Proceeds of Crime Act, the Money Laundering Regulations, and related UK legislation.
Develop, implement, and continually enhance MoonPay's AML/CTF framework, policies, and procedures in the UK.
Lead the review, investigation, and reporting of suspicious activity to the National Crime Agency (NCA) through Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).
Own and maintain MoonPay UK's client asset protection (CASS) framework, ensuring robust controls around the safeguarding of client funds and assets, and be capable of holding the CASS Prescribed Responsibility.
Deliver AML/CTF and CASS training across the business and champion a strong culture of compliance.
Partner closely with global compliance, legal, and risk teams to ensure consistency across jurisdictions while meeting requirements specific to the UK.
Play a key role in MoonPay's engagement with the FCA and external auditors on AML/CTF and CASS matters, working alongside senior compliance leadership.
Contribute to MoonPay's FSMA authorisation programme, including regulatory submissions and supporting documentation within your areas of responsibility.
Take on additional compliance responsibilities as the UK business and its regulatory obligations develop.
About You
You are a seasoned compliance professional who combines deep regulatory expertise with genuine curiosity about crypto and digital assets. You bring structure and rigour to ambiguous, fast moving environments, and you know how to turn complex regulation into practical, workable controls rather than getting stuck in theory. You build trust easily, whether with regulators, auditors, or colleagues across functions and geographies, and you take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do. You are comfortable operating beyond the boundaries of your formal remit, and you see a growing regulatory perimeter as an opportunity rather than a burden. You are just as comfortable getting into the detail as you are advising senior stakeholders on strategy, and you are always looking for ways to do things better.
Must-have experience and skills
Significant experience in compliance/AML roles, including at least 5 years in a registered MLRO or senior compliance officer role within financial services, fintech, or crypto, with the ability to be approved by the FCA under SMF17.
Deep understanding of UK AML/CTF regulations, the wider regulatory landscape, and CASS rules.
Proven experience engaging with regulators, drafting reports, and leading AML/CTF audits.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies.
Experience working across a breadth of compliance disciplines, with the appetite to take on more over time.
Passion for crypto, fintech, and the mission of financial inclusion.
Nice-to-have experience
Experience within a cryptoasset or payments firm going through FCA registration or authorisation.
Exposure to FCA regulatory requirements beyond financial crime, such as conduct, governance, or prudential.
Familiarity with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs and Elliptic.
Experience managing compliance across multiple jurisdictions, particularly EEA MiCA, Jersey, or other VASP regimes.
Background in a fast growing fintech or scale up environment.
Bonus Points
Professional qualifications such as the ICA Diploma in Anti Money Laundering, ACAMS, or an equivalent certification.
Prior experience holding an SMF designation with the FCA.
Familiarity with Travel Rule compliance and related tooling.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.
This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.
MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.
AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.
You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.
The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.
About MoonPay Enterprise
MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.
KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.
What You'll Own
KYB product strategy & roadmap
Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.
Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.
MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.
Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.
Onboarding funnel & conversion
The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.
Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.
Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.
KYB API & partner experience
The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).
Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.
Compliance as product
Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.
EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.
Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.
Vendor & provider orchestration
The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it.
Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place.
Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk.
Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone.
Who You Are
A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature.
High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it.
Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction.
AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team.
Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy.
You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification.
At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers.
You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build.
A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped.
Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for.

ABOUT THE ROLE

jobs.ashbyhq.com/artsy/c8dd591a-c3e0-4dc.description_excerpt:
ABOUT ARTSY AND ARTNET
Artsy and Artnet have combined to create the world’s largest online art marketplace and information platform. Together, we connect collectors, galleries, auction houses, and institutions across a global market valued at over $60 billion. Our products serve both the art world’s largest institutions and individual collectors – supporting art discovery, research and transactions.
We are at a pivotal moment. The combined company brings together the broadest customer base in the online art market, uniquely valuable proprietary data, a proven team, and new velocity as a combined organization. We believe the rapid evolution of AI will reshape not just how we build our products, but how our users interact with them. We want a technology leader who is as excited about that future as we are.
THE ROLE
We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the combined engineering organization through a period of ambitious growth and technological transformation. This is not a maintenance role. It’s a mandate to retool how an entire organization builds software, to mentor a talented team through that transition, and to ensure that what we’re building today is designed for the world our users will inhabit tomorrow.
The right person is energized by a set of hard questions: Which parts of our platform are durable advantages, and which will be commoditized by AI? How should we build for an agentic user who discovers and transacts through AI intermediaries rather than browsing a website? Where are we underinvested? What does a world-class engineering team look like when AI fundamentally changes how software is written?
Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll own the full technology function: engineering, infrastructure, and technical architecture. You’ll be the company’s eyes on the technology frontier, constantly scanning what’s emerging, and pressure-testing our assumptions about what’s feasible. As a key member of the senior leadership team, you’ll surface information and opportunities to help shape company direction and make the best possible strategic decisions.
Just as importantly, you’ll be a mentor and teacher to the entire organization. The transition to AI-augmented workflows isn’t just a tooling change, it’s a cultural one. We need a leader who can bring the team along, raise everyone’s capabilities, and create an environment where engineers, product managers, designers, and business operators are all fluent in what’s now possible.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Retool How We Build
- Lead the adoption of AI-augmented development workflows across the engineering organization, fundamentally increasing what the team can ship and how fast they can ship it
- Mentor engineers, product managers, designers, and business operators in new ways of working, making AI fluency a core competency across the org, not just a tooling layer for a few
- Build on the team’s existing foundation of modern tooling, agile practices, and continuous delivery to foster a culture of continuous experimentation where the team is always testing what’s newly possible and incorporating it into how they work
- Establish the org as an industry reference point for how modern technology teams operate at the intersection of AI and product development
Build for Tomorrow
- Assess which elements of our platform represent durable competitive advantages and which are at risk of being commoditized or disrupted by AI
- In close partnership with the CPO, develop a technical strategy for the agentic future: how our platform should work when users discover, research, and transact through AI agents and intermediaries rather than traditional interfaces
- Identify where we are underinvested, in data, infrastructure, APIs, or capabilities, and build the roadmap to close those gaps
- Ensure our architecture is modular and adaptable, designed to evolve quickly as both the business and the underlying technology landscape change
Drive the Technical Side of the Post-Merger Integration
- Unify two legacy technology platforms into a coherent, modern architecture that serves both brands and all customer segments
- Make pragmatic, high-conviction decisions about what to consolidate, what to rebuild, and what to retire
- Bring together engineers from both organizations into integrated, mission-driven teams
Own Security and Infrastructure
- Own the company’s security and infrastructure posture as AI tooling and agentic product surfaces introduce new categories of risk and complexity
- Maintain rigorous standards for data integrity, system resilience, and platform trust as the business scales and the technology landscape evolves

About Level Zero
Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we're pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.
Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.
We're seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we're assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.
About the role
We’re looking for a technician with hands-on experience running label-free biophysical instruments (SPR, GCI, BLI or ITC) to assist with characterising how receptors bind to hormone targets. You’ll focus on ligand kinetics screening, and your results will directly help us select and refine the receptors that go into our real-time, continuous biosensors.
Our targets are challenging small molecules that are hard to handle and tend to stick to surfaces, so careful experimental technique and attention to detail are central to the role. You’ll run established screening methods, troubleshoot day-to-day issues, and work closely with our scientists as methods continue to improve.

Moreover, they should have sound knowledge and experience in assay development, small molecule detection, and electrode surface modifications. - Translate bio-element–target interactions into measurable and reproducible sensor outputs through novel assay design.
- Apply a range of electrochemical methods (voltammetry, impedimetry, chronoamperometry, etc.) to characterize and evaluate biosensor function.
- Apply data-driven approaches including Python-based analysis and Design of Experiments (DoE) to streamline workflows.
- Troubleshoot technical and conceptual challenges systematically and propose innovative solutions to improve performance.
- Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensure experimental reproducibility and compliance with quality standards.
- Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (chemists, biologists, engineers, and data scientists) to advance biosensor prototypes from concept to application.
- Present results clearly through written reports, oral presentations, and scientific publications.
- Attend R&D-related trainings and seminars for continuous updates on the latest trend in hormone sensing technologies.

At Technimove, we’re passionate about transforming the way the world’s leading IT service providers manage their data centres. As the market leader in Data Centre Transformations, we deliver high-quality Professional Services and Data Centre Migrations for global clients, from ambitious start-ups to some of the most recognisable names in tech.
Our secret weapon? Our people. Known as our TechniPeople, we’ve built a diverse, supportive, and ambitious team that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and passion. Some of our colleagues have been with us for over a decade, while many others are just starting their journey — but all share the same energy, drive, and love for what we do.
The Role:
The HR Manager is responsible for the overall people experience at Technimove. This is a hands-on, 360° HR role, covering recruitment, onboarding, training and development, reward, employee relations and HR administration. The role will work closely with the People & Talent Partner and SLT to deliver an effective and engaging employee experience.
Recruitment & Onboarding
- Work closely with the People & Talent Partner to support the end-to-end recruitment process.
- Take a hands-on role in CV screening, telephone/video screening, interviews and candidate assessment, providing feedback and recommendations to hiring managers.
- Support interview coordination, candidate communication, references, pre-employment checks and offers.
- Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
- Support and coordinate onboarding, including inductions, mandatory training and H&S requirements.
- Support probation processes and ensure new starters are set up for success.
HR Operations & Employee Relations
- Act as a key point of contact for employee and management HR queries, providing practical and commercially appropriate advice.
- Support the SLT with disciplinary, grievance, performance, absence and other employee relations matters.
- Maintain accurate HR records, systems, security clearances and employment documentation.
- Regularly review HR policies and the employee handbook to ensure compliance with UK legislation.
Learning, Reward & Engagement
- Support training and development initiatives, including external courses and e-learning.
- Administer and review compensation and benefits to remain competitive.
- Gather and analyse HR data and metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
- Work with the SLT on team-building activities, employee engagement and company events.
- Promote Technimove's values of Purpose, People and Passion.
Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement
- Hold fortnightly 1-2-1s with the SLT to discuss people matters and team requirements.
- Work collaboratively with the People & Talent Partner and SLT on people projects and initiatives.
- Take ownership of HR tasks and projects from start to finish, identifying and implementing improvements.
- Be a proactive, hands-on HR professional who is comfortable getting involved in the detail and doing the work, rather than operating purely in an advisory capacity.
- Ensure compliance with Technimove's BMS and data security requirements, raising opportunities for improvement where appropriate.
Personal Specification:
Essential
- Level 5 CIPD qualification.
- Strong knowledge of UK employment legislation.
- Experience using HiBob and Ashby.
- Experience within an SME and/or broad standalone HR role.
- Hands-on experience across recruitment, onboarding, employee relations and HR operations.
- Experience screening candidates and conducting interviews.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
- Proactive, practical and solutions-focused approach.
- A genuine "doer" who takes ownership and enjoys getting involved.
- Strong organisation, attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
Desirable
- Level 7 CIPD qualification.
- Experience within the IT industry.
- Experience supporting technical recruitment.
- Experience with HR and recruitment systems.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/build/f93af3ad-316b-4c3.description_excerpt:
ABOUT BUILD
AI for the Built World: Build has created the agentic AI stack for institutional real estate, automating complex development and acquisitions workflows 90% faster than humans to accelerate the world’s most important built projects - digital infrastructure, energy, industrial - from concept to completion.
Our mission is to accelerate and amplify the world's most important built projects - inventing a better way to build through a collaboration between human experts and agentic AI.
We envision a future where the world's buildings are driven from concept to completion, autonomously. Without delays, cost, and complexity. Enabling people to deliver a magnitude more deals. To make decisions, build relationships and create.
To start, we're partnering with the world's biggest built world institutions from $T alternative assets investors, prolific developers and even governments to push the frontier of what's possible. We’re backed by c-suite from Blackstone and OpenAI alongside the world’s best venture capital firms.
Join us in shaping the future of the Built World and exponentially accelerate your career in the process. We welcome you to do your life's work here.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You own the foundational systems that make Build’s agentic AI real in production. This role is responsible for the infrastructure that orchestrates autonomous agents, manages long-running, high-stakes workflows, and guarantees reliability at institutional scale. Your work sets the hard limits of speed, autonomy, and trust across the entire product;
- Build and operate the core primitives: agent orchestration, workflow engines, state management, eventing, and execution reliability.
- Design systems that survive real-world failure modes: partial data, human handoffs, long timelines, regulatory constraints, and zero tolerance for silent errors.
- Make architectural decisions that directly determine product capability, velocity, and customer trust.
- Own infrastructure end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and ongoing evolution.
- Work tightly with product, applied AI, and domain experts to translate abstract workflows into durable, production-grade systems.
- Set the technical bar for robustness and clarity; other engineers build on what you create.
Security and compliance responsibilities
This role carries direct responsibility for the security posture of Build's production infrastructure. In practice, that means:
• Owning security oversight across the infrastructure layer, including risk assessments, tooling, and incident response readiness.
• Ensuring systems meet and maintain compliance requirements - including SOC 2 and, where applicable, PCI DSS - and that evidence is collected, documented, and audit-ready.
• Maintaining up-to-date documentation of security-relevant responsibilities across the engineering team, stored in a shared repository and updated as roles evolve.
• Acting as the primary point of contact for infrastructure security during audits, customer due diligence, and compliance reviews.
• Collaborating with any privacy or data protection function to ensure PII handling, data residency, and regulatory obligations are reflected in system design from day one.
HOW TO WIN AT BUILD
Growing Build requires a radically different approach to company building. As a company we’re focused on one outcome: winning. That means we move fast, work with intensity, and demand excellence from ourselves. We operate with intensity but create an environment that allows for a lot of fun together. The result is that we're one of the fastest shipping teams in vertical AI, partnering with the best to automate the world around us.
Performance and teamwork are the core of Build’s operation. We look for those who are able to do both, who often exhibit a particular ability for;
- Velocity: You are relentless in asking the right questions to set direction. Once you find the right direction you go all-in.
- Excellence: You obsess with being the best. For you, excellence is a non-negotiable standard rather than an aspiration.
- Long time horizons: You choose to be in something for the long run, because that’s where most of the returns are realized.
- Ownership: You take full ownership of the outcomes. You’re meticulous in your pursuits and believe you can actively shape your environment rather than adapt to it.
- Customers: You have a passion for the built world and those who shape it. You probably have a quirky hobby or story that relates to your love for building.
- Integrity: You chose to do the right thing even when it isn’t easy.
- Trust: You only work with people you can trust because it’s the only way to do truly extraordinary things.
- Yield: You have a burning need to see a result on every action you take and you’re always looking for routes to do more with less.
WHAT WE OFFER
- Radical autonomy, real ownership: High standards. Minimal bureaucracy. You own problems end-to-end, choose how the work gets done, and are accountable for exceptional outcomes. Ownership is matched with meaningful, generous equity.
- An accelerated founder’s track: Build is for builders. If you want to learn what it actually takes to create a generational company – Product judgment, execution speed, and accountability – there is no faster path than building from zero when everything is for grabs.
- Elite teammates, uncompromising bar: You work with people who think clearly, execute relentlessly, and take full ownership. The team you build becomes the company you build. Growth here is not just professional; it reshapes how you operate and in return how Build operates.
- Perpetual adventure: We attract the strongest of the strange. Extraordinary experiences are part of the culture - from the food we eat together to the space we occupy. Intensity is intentional.
- Shape the built world: We are rebuilding how the physical world gets made. Our software doesn’t live in the abstract - it turns into real projects breaking ground because we exist. We work with the largest institutions, push the frontier of AI, and watch our decisions translate directly into the world around us.

ABOUT BUILD
AI for the Built World: Build helps the world's largest real estate and infrastructure institutions find, test and plan sites a magnitude faster than the market. ABOUT THE ROLE
The Computational Design Engineer owns how Build looks, feels and works, and ships it in production code.
This is a design role and an engineering role in equal measure. You'll design the product and the 3D and site design tools behind it, then build them yourself: production React and TypeScript on the front end, and Rhino, Grasshopper and Python for the geometry underneath.
Our clients make big decisions about land, power and buildings. What they see from us has to be clear enough to act on and good enough to defend in an investment committee. You'll design and build the product they use every day, the tools that lay out a site in minutes and the deliverables that land on their desk.
There's no handoff. You sketch it, model it, build it, ship it and watch how clients use it. You'll be the design lead on a small team that ships fast, working directly with James SE and alongside our engineers and domain experts.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
- Spatial and 3D design tools: the parametric logic, site layouts, 3D views and CAD outputs behind the test fits clients use to decide what a site can hold
- Product design end to end: user flows, interfaces and the details inside them, from first concept to shipped feature
- The front end: building what you design in React and TypeScript, reviewed and shipped to the same standard as our engineers
- The design system: one set of components, type, motion and rules that keeps every surface consistent and lets the whole team ship good work without you in the room
- Making complex work clear: turning maps, site data and multi-step workflows into screens and reports a client can read in a minute and trust
- Everything around the product: flagship demos, the website and the deliverables clients actually receive
- Time with clients: seeing how decisions get made and approved on real projects, and feeding that straight back into what we build
EXAMPLE PROJECTS
- Taking a site layout tool from a working prototype to something a client runs on their own, from the rules that place each block to the screen they adjust it on
- Building a single design package and moving the product onto it
- Redesigning the map so every type of site data reads at a glance
- Turning a complex workflow into an interface a client can follow and defend internally
- Redesigning the decks and drawings we deliver so they read like they came from the best firm in the market
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
A designer who engineers. You've trained in architecture, product or computational design, and somewhere along the way you started writing production code yourself. You see systems, not one-off screens, and you'd rather make a tool that produces a hundred good answers than draw one by hand. You have real taste and you're unreasonable about quality, but you ship.
YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF
- You work in 3D and geometry: Rhino and Grasshopper, Python or C#, Three.js or similar, and you've built tools, not just used them
- You've shipped production front end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) as well as designing it
- You have a few years at a leading architecture, design or engineering practice, or at a product company building design or spatial tools, or your own practice with this at its core
- You've made complex tools simple enough for people who aren't technical to use
- Your portfolio shows both the thinking and the working thing that shipped
- You hold your own with engineers and want to be held to an engineering standard
- You care about AI, software and how the physical world gets built
THIS PROBABLY ISN'T YOU IF
- You can design but not build, or build but have no taste
- You need tightly scoped specs before you can start
- You see polish as optional or the small details as someone else's job
BONUS POINTS
- Experience with masterplanning, site planning or massing studies
- Experience with CAD and drawing output (DXF, layered drawings)
- Experience designing data-heavy, map-based or AI products
- An eye for brand as well as product
- Experience as a founder or the first designer at an early-stage company
