📈 Who We Are:
We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.
We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.
We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.
We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.
The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards https://www.gpbullhound.com/articles/allstars-awards-2026-winners-announced/, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2026-20-uk-companies-rise-linkedin-news-uk-xoffc in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 https://scalingeurope.co.uk/ of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100 https://lnkd.in/p/ehxWgJyc.
Learn more about us on our website https://www.tem.energy/.
THE ROLE:
We’re hiring a Staff Product Manager to own the portfolio side of Rosso, a hands-on role built around financial outcomes.
Rosso is deeply technical, built on ML-led models and complex engineering covering forecasting, pricing optimisation and portfolio balancing. The portfolio is where the live financial risk sits: fulfilling and balancing a growing two-sided portfolio, managing imbalance, controlling portfolio costs, and finding the revenue and margin in every position we hold. It’s still forming, and it needs someone who wants to own the outcome and win in it.
This is a lead role, but not a head-of-product role. You’ll be building, not running a product practice. You’ll work day to day with engineers and ML specialists to build an automated portfolio management system that handles balancing, forecasting and counterparty placement, and that could be exposed to third parties in future.
You will:
- Own financial outcomes for the portfolio, including the cost of balancing and managing positions, and be accountable for margin found and risk managed.
- Work hands-on with engineers and ML/data science to build automated, quantitative systems that run at scale and under live financial risk.
- Drive open product decisions to a close, with a clear Now, Next and Future for the portfolio area.
🚀 RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the portfolio outcome
- Take full ownership of financial outcomes in the portfolio area: balancing, imbalance, forecasting and counterparty placement.
- Treat hedging, imbalance and trading decisions as product decisions: when to hold a position, when to trade it out, when to reprice to close a gap.
- Find the most pressing problems worth solving, such as whether to buy or build a new forecasting capability, or how to make Rosso react at scale to any event in the system.
- Chase the commercial outcome, not just the shipped feature. The measure of this role is margin found and risk managed, at pace.
Turn needs into shipped product
- Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible product execution, balancing them against nascent ML and forecasting innovations that push the frontier of what’s possible.
- Take initiatives from discovery through to regularly released product.
- Drive open product decisions to a close, yours and the team’s, so work keeps moving.
- Decide what to formalise, what stays a prototype and what to drop. Be the editor and builder, not just the instigator.
Own the technical-product detail
- Work embedded in full-stack teams of ML/data science and software engineers, close enough to the systems to make good calls.
- Set clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform for the product to work, and design for the edge cases and operational reality of a system carrying live financial risk.
- Pull and interrogate your own and others’ data to inform decisions, and reason about model performance and error as business indicators.
- Get close to the people who use what you build, from internal commercial teams to generators and businesses externally.
Lead by doing
- Set the pace for the product team and raise the standard of product work around you, through your own work and example rather than by managing a function.
- Work alongside the other PM on Rosso and the Product Lead, with clear ownership of the portfolio area.
🎯 REQUIREMENTS:
Must haves
- Senior, hands-on product management experience. You’ve owned a complex, financially significant product area end to end, with a track record of moving real business outcomes, not just shipping features.
- Domain knowledge in energy trading and markets: positions, hedging, balancing and imbalance, and what it means for a system to carry live financial risk. Strong adjacent experience (financial trading, fintech, battery or EV trading) will be considered, but real depth of understanding is needed.
- Experience building automated, quantitative systems, or working in pods that do, alongside engineers.
- Commercial drive. You push decisions to a close and go after revenue and margin. You want to win, and it shows in how you work.
- Comfortable working with ML specialists. You don’t need hands-on ML experience, but you know how to work with data scientists and can reason about model performance and error as business indicators.
- Uses data analysis throughout the product process, to validate ideas, progress work and measure success.
- Built product in a startup, scaleup or other high-growth environment, with high personal ownership.
- A strong instinct for failure points, edge cases and the operational reality of a live system.
- AI-native, AI-literate and AI-critical: you know where it helps and where it hurts.
- A clear, structured communicator, especially in writing.
Bonus points
- Hands-on energy trading experience: intraday, day-ahead, imbalance or battery optimisation.

Alongside Jim Hays, Neil set out to create a different kind of Lloyd’s platform, focused, agile and built around people.

Since launch in 2009, we have grown into a diversified insurance group offering products across Property, Casualty, Marine, Energy and Transportation, Specialty and Reinsurance, alongside Smart Follow and digital and embedded risk programmes. Our experience and unique ecosystem give Platform Partners the best chance of success, from navigating the Lloyd’s new entrant process through to the delivery of their long-term strategy.

With a team of more than 300 professionals, we continue to grow with purpose, combining underwriting excellence, innovation and collaboration to enable a more resilient and sustainable world.

Your Role

We are looking for a Ceded Reinsurance Specialist to join Apollo's Ceded Reinsurance Team, overseeing and supporting ceded reinsurance activity across our managed Platform Partner Syndicates (PPS).

You will act as a key contact for our partner syndicates, helping to ensure ceded reinsurance arrangements are administered effectively and operated in line with Apollo processes, Lloyd's Principles and wider regulatory requirements. Supporting the full lifecycle of reinsurance activity, you will coordinate contract administration, reporting, settlements and governance activities across a growing portfolio of syndicates.

Working closely with Finance, Claims, brokers, partner syndicates, external counterparties and outsourced service providers, you will help maintain high standards of service, operational control and stakeholder support.

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative team where you will support multiple syndicates and partner businesses while developing your expertise across the ceded reinsurance lifecycle.

What you’ll do

  • Act as a key day-to-day contact for Platform Partner Syndicates, providing oversight and support across ceded reinsurance activities and queries.
  • Support the placement, administration and ongoing management of proportional and non-proportional reinsurance arrangements, including contract processing, premium and claims settlements through LORS.
  • Coordinate outsourced reinsurance support where used, reviewing outputs, monitoring activity and helping to ensure accurate processing.
  • Prepare management information and reporting for syndicate governance meetings, Lloyd's reporting and regulatory submissions.
  • Attending syndicate governance meetings to support the ceded reinsurance function
  • Maintain accurate contract and reinsurance data, working with internal teams, brokers and external counterparties to resolve queries and support effective execution.
  • Support the onboarding of additional Platform Partner Syndicates and contribute to improvements in processes, controls and service delivery.

What we are looking for

  • Experience working within a London Market ceded, outward or reinsurance operations environment.
  • An understanding of proportional and non-proportional reinsurance arrangements and the associated administration, reporting, premium and claims processes.
  • Experience using reinsurance systems and knowledge of Lloyd's market systems, including LORS.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage data accurately across multiple workstreams and deadlines.
  • Confidence working with a range of stakeholders, including underwriters, finance teams, claims teams, brokers and external partners.
  • A collaborative and organised approach, with a willingness to take ownership, solve problems and continuously improve processes.
  • Experience preparing management information, governance reporting or regulatory submissions would be beneficial.

What you’ll get in return

We offer a competitive and thoughtfully designed reward package that reflects the value of our people. This includes a fair and attractive salary, discretionary bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package - including 31 days’ annual leave, a non-contributory pension and private medical insurance.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Apollo, people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a diverse, growing team of empowered experts who bring collaboration, innovation and data-driven thinking to every relationship and every risk.

We believe diversity and inclusion go far beyond targets. They are essential to understanding the global communities we serve and to making better decisions. That’s why we are committed to developing diverse talent at every level and creating an environment where different perspectives are genuinely valued, supported and celebrated.

We also run a programme of events, training and initiatives designed to recognise both the challenges and opportunities that come with building an inclusive workplace.

Flexible and hybrid working are fully embraced at Apollo. We do not believe in presenteeism. Instead, we trust our people to work in ways that allow them to perform at their best, balancing professional responsibilities with personal commitments.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/apolloio/jobs/6.description_excerpt:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As a Mid Market Account Executive (200 - 1000+ employees) at Apollo.io, your primary focus will drive new business revenue across Apollo’s mid-market businesses. When leads come in from these companies, you will be the main point of contact to guide founders, Sales, and Operations professionals through their evaluation of Apollo’s all-in-one Sales platform, while offering consultative guidance to help them develop their pipeline generation strategy.

A day in the life…

Pipeline & Sales Process Execution 

  • Manage the entire sales process from initial conversation, trial management, negotiation, legal, and close with an average deal cycle of 60 days or less. 
  • Manage a pipeline of primarily inbound prospects to identify, engage, and develop relationships with potential buyers
  • Responsible for taking 4 net new meetings per day, running 20 meetings per week. 
  • Consistently create 3x pipeline coverage 
  • Achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly quotas 
  • Capable of time management and accountable to own your schedule to structure your day and accomplish - running initial meetings, showing a demo of our platform, salesforce.com hygiene and admin work, customer escalations, follow up meetings, pricing calls and various company calls and meetings.

Sales Strategy & Deal Management

  • Proficient in the sales process, and specifically the Discovery step. Asking questions to quantify the pain in a consultative way and actively listening to tie back to value and business driven outcomes.
  • Collaborate with businesses that have a minimum of 200 employees.
  • Communicate directly with Director and above level contacts primarily within the sales, marketing, and RevOps departments.
  • Clearly articulate and overview of your pipeline and deals in your funnel at each stage
  • Accurately predicting your most likely outcome within a 10% margin.

Mindset and Behaviors 

  • Bring your thinking, strategies, and ideas to advance our company’s values, unique culture, and vision for the future.
  • Engage as your unique self in a diverse, inclusive and high-performing team
  • Thrive in a competitive environment, embracing challenges, enjoying objection handling, and using setbacks as fuel to improve and win.
  • Have a positive outlook, a strong ability to take responsibility for successes and failures, and a relentless drive to keep improving.
  • Maintain a sharp focus on your goals and a belief that your daily, weekly and monthly activities will help achieve them
  • Possess a competitive spark, a hunger to win, and a determination to outperform in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
  • Be a self-starter who proactively identifies opportunities, takes initiative, and stays motivated in the face of multiple objections and “no’s.”
  • Embody a team selling approach. Proactively engaging with leadership to support selling. 

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2-3 years of quota-carrying direct Account Executive experience 
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting targets, min of 3 trailing quarters
  • Use strong consultative selling skills to identify pain points and align Apollo use cases to solve customer challenges. Versed in Sandler, Command of the Message, MEDDPIC or similar. 
  • Ability to articulate Apollo’s value proposition with C-level executives, revenue teams, and decision makers
  • Ability to communicate, present to, and influence key stakeholders across both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Adaptable with the ability to pick up new technologies, assess situations quickly, and find smarter ways to achieve goals.
  • Coachable— loves to learn, receive feedback, and improve their skills.

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

 

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact opportunity to work directly alongside one of Banyan’s seasoned Operating Leaders, each overseeing a portfolio of software businesses in a buy, hold and grow investment model. As Chief of Staff, you become a trusted right hand to your Operating Leader and a close working partner to the CEOs and functional leaders across their companies.

The role is deliberately broad. Rather than a fixed rotation, you will move across multiple operating companies and business problems: shaping a go-to-market plan for one company, improving customer onboarding at another, or standing up the first 100 days of a newly acquired business. You will gain exposure to software M&A, but the core of the job is hands-on value creation and operating work. You own initiatives end to end.

The Executive Leadership Program (ELP) runs two years. Development is intentional. You will work through a range of experiences spanning go-to-market, M&A, customer, and finance priorities portfolio-wide, plus gain hands-on leadership reps, with regular check-ins and development opportunities to ready you for your next role. High performers move from the ELP program into a CEO or C-suite role within a Banyan operating company, or into a leadership role at Banyan Software HQ.

For those who want to learn how great vertical software businesses are built and run, and who want the fastest path available to running one themselves, this is the job.

What You’ll Gain

  • A cohort of high-calibre peers. You grow and learn alongside other ELPs at Banyan, building a long-term network of future operators.
  • Direct apprenticeship with senior operators. You will work very closely with an Operating Leader and see first-hand how experienced leaders make decisions across different software businesses.
  • Dedicated development support. External executive coaching in Year 2, plus mentorship from Operating Leaders with decades of software experience.
  • The fastest track we offer to running a business. High performers move directly from this program into a C-suite seat inside a Banyan operating company or a leadership role at HQ. It is not guaranteed, performance decides placement, but it is the first place Banyan looks when those seats open and we have a strong track record of placing CEOs through our ELP.
  • Real operating reps, not case reps. You carry a genuine initiative inside a live business and leadership-level stretch assignments, decisions that show up in a P&L.

What You Will Own

Portfolio Value Creation

  • Partner with CEOs and functional leaders across multiple operating companies to identify priorities and implement the Banyan Operating System, turning strategy into measurable operational improvements.
  • Lead high-impact, cross-functional projects across product, go-to-market, sales, marketing, pricing, and customer success as the right hand to Leader.

M&A and Integration

  • Gain exposure to Banyan’s acquisition process, including value-creation plan framing during diligence.
  • Support integration planning and onboarding for newly acquired businesses, helping establish operating rhythms and priorities while respecting what already makes each business work.
  • Help execute the value-creation plan once a deal closes, turning the diligence thesis into the specific operating bets a business needs to win in year one.

Executive Partnership

  • Support your Operating Leader on critical initiatives, executive decision-making, and cross-company collaboration, frequently influencing outcomes without formal authority or direct reports.
  • Build the judgment, breadth, and pattern recognition required for future general management by working different business problems across a portfolio of vertical software companies.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Recently graduated from a top MBA program. This cycle is not open to first-year MBA students.
  • 2–5 years of pre-MBA experience in an operating role (product, business operations, portfolio operations, or value creation), management consulting, private equity, or investment banking, with a demonstrated record of owning measurable outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal judgment, with the ability to synthesize complex information and influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • High learning agility and comfort with ambiguity. You get smart quickly in unfamiliar areas, prioritize what matters, and move from analysis to action.
  • Low ego and high ownership. You are ambitious but humble, seek feedback, build trust quickly, and are motivated by the work of operating a business rather than by title.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in software, SaaS, or another recurring revenue business. Familiarity with vertical software economics is an advantage.
  • Experience leading a team. Direct people management is not required; this role initially relies on leadership through influence.

Berkeley Myles Group, builds on-premise ERP/MIS software for SME manufacturers — covering MRP, job costing, stock control, works orders and labour tracking, with integrations into Sage, Xero and Pegasus. We work with 700+ customers across motorsport, aerospace, defence and electronics.

Berkeley Myles Group has recently brought Javelin into the business, bringing together two established manufacturing software providers under one roof. We are part of the Banyan Software portfolio and are investing in a cloud relaunch of the platform, landing in Q4 2026 — a genuine growth phase for the business, not a maintenance one.

The Role:

This is a new role for Berkeley Myles — created to build a dedicated Account Management function from the ground up. As Key Account Manager, you’ll own and grow our entire existing customer base (700+ SME manufacturers) once integrated, focused on retention, licence expansion and module growth.

You’ll work with production, operations, finance and IT stakeholders inside SME manufacturing businesses — helping them get more value from the system they already run, and identifying where additional modules, users or capability can support their growth.

You report directly to the Commercial Director, and will play a central role in shaping how Berkeley Myles does account management going forward. In our own GTM model, this role owns three stages end to end: Adoption, Expansion, and Advocacy & Referral. Everything before that (Awareness, Nurture, Sales, Close) sits with Marketing and the BDR team — your world starts once a customer is live.

You’ll carry clear commercial targets across retention, renewal and expansion revenue, set by the Commercial Director and reviewed regularly. We’re not looking for someone who manages relationships and waits for renewals to happen; we’re looking for someone who goes after the number. You will:

  • Own and grow the full customer base (700+ SME manufacturers) across
  • motorsport, aerospace, defence, electronics and beyond
  • Build trusted relationships with production, operations, finance and IT stakeholders within existing accounts
  • Develop and execute account plans focused on retention, licence expansion and module growth
  • Lead commercial conversations on renewals, upsell and expansion — owning the numbers behind them
  • Consistently meet or exceed the quarterly and annual retention and expansion revenue targets set for
  • the role
  • Identify growth opportunities within accounts, working with Support, Implementation and Product to drive adoption and uncover expansion potential
  • Spot accounts missing key modules — accounts link, quality, shop floor, debt collection, labour, and time; attendance — and build the case for adding them
  • Understand our subscription vs. perpetual licensing options well enough to guide customers to the right commercial fit as we transition toward subscription
  • Maintain disciplined CRM and forecasting hygiene in HubSpot, giving clear visibility of account health and pipeline
  • Build the structure and processes for account management across a couple of products.
  • Support customers through the Javelin integration and the move to our new cloud platform, keeping confidence high through change
  • Travel to customer sites across the UK (and occasionally further afield) to build relationships face to face

Qualifications for success: 

  • 3+ years’; experience in software/SaaS account management, customer success or a commercial growth role, with a proven track record of consistently hitting or exceeding revenue/retention targets
  • Manufacturing sector experience strongly preferred — you understand production environments, or you’re quick to learn how they operate
  • Proven experience managing renewal and expansion conversations, ideally against named commercial targets
  • Comfortable building trust with senior stakeholders (ops, production, finance) inside SME businesses
  • Confident, organised and structured — you bring discipline to CRM and account planning
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM is a plus
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, results-driven, firm-but-fair environment — happy to be measured on outcomes
  • Comfortable operating independently and building something new, rather than following an established process

What's on offer?

  • The chance to build and own a brand-new function, with real influence over how it’s shaped
  • Direct reporting line to the Commercial Director
  • A defined book of 700+ existing customers to grow into — no cold prospecting
  • £45,000 base salary + commission on expansion/upsell revenue, £75,000 OTE
  • Part of a business backed by Banyan Software and going through a genuine growth phase (Javelin integration, cloud relaunch in 2026)
  • Flexible working with Hybrid model - travel to customer sites and the office in Glasgow is required at times.

About WIZE

WIZE is the leading all-in-one Portfolio Management System for Swiss boutique wealth managers, External Asset Managers, and family offices. Founded in Geneva in 2010, WIZE has earned a trusted position in a relationship-driven market through deep product capability and a differentiated back-office outsourcing service that competitors have not replicated. The company operates on a highly recurring subscription model, holds a strong position within its vertical, and is in excellent operating shape. WIZE is now entering its first chapter of international ownership under Banyan Software, combining more than fifteen years of product depth and client trust with the operational and AI expertise of a global software group.

The Opportunity

You will join WIZE directly as Managing Director,  United Kingdom, reporting to the CEO of WIZE, with responsibility for establishing and growing the UK business. This is a value-creation mandate, not a turnaround. . You will take the business into a new market, with the United Kingdom as the primary prize. The product has to remain the primary competitive advantage, the recurring revenue base has to be protected, and the opportunity to create structural distance through AI is real.

You will own the UK client and partner relationships, build the commercial motion from the ground up, and partner with the CEO and product and technology leader to ensure the platform addresses the needs of the UK market.

You will have substantial authority over the execution of the agreed UK strategy. Key commercial development decisions, including market positioning, target segments, pricing, partnerships, resource allocation, and major commercial commitments, will be decided jointly with the CEO.

You will do this with the long-term backing of a permanent-capital owner, free from the pressure to flip the business.


What You Will Own

Commercial & Revenue Growth

  • Build the foundation of the UK subsidiary and work closely with the CEO to define WIZE's expansion into the UK market.
  • Own the execution of WIZE's UK strategy, market positioning, and competitive response in the wealth management software market.
  • Drive UK revenue and ARR growth with direct accountability across new customer acquisition, expansion, pricing execution, and the development of recurring revenue.
  • Build and execute the UK go-to-market motion from the ground up: local presence, bank and partner relationships, and a repeatable pipeline where little exists today.
  • Serve as the primary executive relationship owner for key UK clients, bank partners, and influencers, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, retention, and contract renewal.
  • Develop and deepen strategic partnerships across private banks, discretionary fund managers, and the wider UK wealth management ecosystem.
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's footprint within existing UK 
  • Identify AI-driven opportunities to reposition the product and create durable competitive distance within the WealthTech vertical, working with the CEO and product and technology leader to assess and prioritise them.

Product & Technology

  • Represent the needs of the UK market in product roadmap discussions, ensuring that market feedback reflects the needs of boutique wealth managers and the competitive dynamics of the Portfolio Management Systems market.
  • Contribute to a credible AI roadmap. AI must be embedded as a genuine operational and product advantage, not a roadmap line item.
  • Champion AI-first product thinking, identifying where automation, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows create durable differentiation for UK clients.
  • Partner closely with the CEO and CPTO so that the roadmap, packaging, and pricing tiers align tightly with UK commercial needs.
  • Gather structured feedback from UK prospects, clients, and partners and translate it into clear commercial and product recommendations.

Team & Operations

  • Define and implement the UK commercial development strategy jointly with the CEO.
  • Oversee the UK financial performance, budgeting, and resource allocation to ensure sustainable profitability. Prepare and manage the UK commercial budget and resource plan, subject to approval by the CEO and Chief Revenue Officer, to ensure sustainable growth.
  • Manage risk across operations, contracts, and market dynamics; respond decisively to changes in the competitive or regulatory landscape 
  • Build and lead a high-performing UK sales team, elevating talent density and making hard calls on underperformance with speed and directness, while protecting the trust-based culture that makes WIZE what it is.
  • Establish decision rights, execution cadences, and accountability frameworks that enable the business to sustain higher growth.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with the CEO on business performance, strategic priorities, pipeline development, and market conditions.
  • Coordinate closely with WIZE's Geneva-based product, technology, implementation, client service, compliance, and operational teams.

What We Are Looking For

The Managing Director we are looking for is a commercially-led WealthTech operator with deep roots in the UK wealth management software market who leads with an AI-first mindset and is energised by the opportunity to create real, lasting business value.

You have personally owned a revenue number, built a commercial motion where none existed, and opened a new geography from scratch.

You have held senior commercial responsibility at a software company serving wealth managers, private banks, or asset managers, with a track record of treating product as a primary strategic lever, closing complex, relationship-driven deals at a senior level, and leading your organisation through at least one meaningful inflexion…

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build reliable application features and services that customers use in real environments.
  • Analyze production data to find system limits, product issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with the embedded platform team on model optimization and inference performance, and with the applications team on how tracking data becomes product features.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 4+ years of software engineering experience in production systems.
  • Strong skill in Python and backend engineering.
  • Working knowledge of C++ or a strong reason to be effective in performance-critical code.

  • Exposure to ML, ML infrastructure, signal processing, real-time systems, computer vision, or related applied technical areas.

You will sit within the Education vertical and work to ensure that every builder has the resources they need to successfully build on Canton.

Responsibilities:

  • You will go beyond simple editing and actively manage the documentation strategy to deflect support tickets and accelerate developer onboarding. Your success will be defined by the content's digestibility and discoverability, ensuring developers can find answers quickly and independently. You will collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to keep documentation synchronized with rapid release cycles while also leveraging ecosystem partners to scale content production.
  • Own, maintain, and evolve world-class documentation that serves as the single source of truth for the Canton ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to drive feedback loops to ensure documentation stays synchronized with the latest software release cycles.
  • Produce and maintain Canton’s developer docs, including conceptual docs, tutorials, guides, upgrade notes, SDK/API documentation, etc.
  • Monitor and improve documentation SEO and searchability to minimize "no result" queries and close content gaps.

  • Support the Evangelism team by providing accurate technical content to inform outreach and advocacy efforts.
  • Maintain the documentation repository architecture, including automated deployments via GitHub Actions and a single source of truth.

What We're Looking For:

  • You are obsessed with clarity and know that good documentation is the difference between a developer adopting a tool or abandoning it.
  • You have proven experience as a technical writer or technical writing lead, including managing writers and driving documentation strategy.
  • You have experience treating documentation as a product by tracking usage, sentiment, and success metrics like ticket deflection to prove ROI.
  • You have a strong technical aptitude and can read code and work closely with engineers to translate complex technical concepts into accessible guides.
  • You are data-driven and comfortable using tools like Google Analytics or heatmaps to identify where developers are getting stuck.
  • You have experience working in a fast-paced environment where software updates are frequent and you know how to keep docs from going stale.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.

This position may be based in New York, Budapest, Zurich, or London. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate's location and experience.

About Digital Asset & the Canton Network

Digital Asset builds the technologies that are reshaping the foundations of financial markets. Our mission is to create the world’s most trusted, privacy-enabled, and interoperable digital infrastructure for global finance.

At the heart of this mission is the Canton Network - the blockchain purpose-built for institutional finance. About the role:

Canton Network is delivering what others promised but couldn’t: a blockchain for finance that actually works. As the only open layer 1 blockchain network with configurable privacy and controls sufficient for regulatory compliance, it is the venue where DeFi and TradFi are converging.

We are looking for a visionary Principal Product Manager to lead our Stablecoins & Onchain Payments product activation program. This is not just a "feature-owner" role, but rather you will be the architect of how stablecoins & payments move across the Canton Network.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, the demand for stable, regulatory-compliant and programmable units of value has never been higher. You will define and own the strategy for Digital Asset stablecoin & payments activation on the network, ensuring that stablecoin implementations and payment rails are not only technically superior but commercially dominant in contrast to other networks.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and validate sustainable stablecoin and payment use cases on the Canton network, that can be activated together with institutional partners.
  • Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for stablecoins (fiat-backed, RWA-backed) and payments activation on the Canton Network, involving a cross-functional team of stakeholders and network participants (e.g. Tier 1 Stablecoin & RWA asset issuers). 
  • Work with institutional partners to design workflows that connect legacy payment & PoS systems with Canton’s privacy-enabled ledger.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure payment initiatives meet global standards (e.g. MiCA, Basel III) while maintaining the privacy benefits of the Canton Network.
  • Ensure that the scaling of stablecoin and payment use cases focuses on high-availability, security and low-latency settlement.
  • Define and track Key Value Indicators (KVIs) for the use case activation on the network such as Mint/Burn volumes and Transaction Volume/Numbers.
  • Act as the primary product subject matter expert for stablecoins and payments use cases and activation within Digital Asset. 

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 3 years focused on stablecoins and payments .
  • Proven track record of shipping products related to stablecoins use case intersecting with aspects of treasury management, cross-border payments, PoS provision or automated clearing houses (ACH)
  • Deep understanding of the stablecoin and payments stack.
  • Understanding of blockchain technology  is required and it would be great to have a familiarity with payments focussed layer 1/2 ecosystems
  • While not a developer, you can confidently discuss application architecture, smart contract logic, and settlement workflows with engineers.
  • Experience building for B2B or B2B2C environments where security, compliance and "five-nines" reliability are non-negotiable.
  • You are comfortable discussing business models, pricing strategies and tokenomics. 
  • BIG BONUS: Direct experience with the Canton Network, Daml, or building institutional-grade Stablecoin payment applications.
  • We are a hybrid workplace company, so you need to be willing to work at least 3 days per week from one of our offices (New York, Zürich, London or Budapest).

About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

As Associate Legal Counsel (5 to 8 years of PQE), you will focus on a number of legal areas and advise UK teams across the business. You will take a consultative approach and work closely with the business - never working alone, or able to concentrate on purely legal issues. As a member of a busy legal team you will also be expected to contribute to team-wide initiatives. 

For people with more senior experience, we are open to look into a Sr. Legal Counsel title.

The key responsibilities of this role include:

    • Support and advise the Partner team and negotiate strategic Partner deals 
    • Support and advise the Go-To-Market teams in the UK on the most strategic and/or highest value deals
    • Work closely with your manager to support on strategic projects
    • Work on specific projects, for example when we roll out new templates/launch new products
    • Review and negotiate customer, partnership and supplier contracts by providing pragmatic and commercial support
    • Supervise more junior lawyers on negotiations or on specific files
    • Instruct and manage external legal counsel
    • Build out and maintain self-help tools, playbooks and guides for the legal team and for the wider business 
    • Focus on constant process improvement related to high volume work - for example by iterating our contracting automation and management workflows
    • Be prepared to deal with any legal issue, at any time.

Desired skills

We’re looking for a lawyer with private practice training and/or in-house experience in a fast-paced environment. You will be driven, able to work independently and able to apply your existing knowledge and approach across a very wide range of legal (and quasi-legal) areas. As a technology business, it helps if you have had experience in a similar area, or perhaps you have a keen interest in tech outside of your day to day work.

Candidates must be qualified in the UK.

 

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have experience negotiating complex contracts with sophisticated counterparties
  • You have experience reviewing marketing materials in accordance with applicable laws and regulations
  • You grasp new legal concepts quickly, and are not afraid to use your common sense.
  • You are able to appropriately challenge ways of working and not be afraid to ask why.
  • You are a self-starter who is proactive and you are willing to roll up your sleeves to get the job done. 
  • Your communication skills are first class, and you are able to distil complex and cumbersome legalese into understandable English.
  • You love tech and tools, and love exploring how they can contribute to efficiency and customer experience.  
  • You enjoy project management and thrive on operational efficiency.
  • You are easy to work with, do not take yourself seriously and want to work in a fun, fast-growing and challenging environment.

 

Bonus points if:

  • You have knowledge of FCA requirements or payment services.
  • You have experience in IP management and handling IP related issues.
  • You have experience with selling and supporting SaaS solutions.
  • You can explain what an API is.

 

Base salary range: £64,000  - £96,000 

 

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff

  • Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
  • Lunch- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office
  • Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period
  • Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
  • Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
  • Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
  • Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house

Life at GoCardless  

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior or Lead Gameplay Animator with strong AAA FPS experience to help shape responsive, compelling character movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.
With a focus on Character, Controls, and Camera (3C), you will combine animation craft with practical implementation skills to develop features from early prototypes through final in-game polish. Working closely with gameplay designers, programmers, and technical animators, you will help ensure that character animation, player input, and camera behavior work together to deliver a cohesive player experience.
This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership of gameplay animation features and opportunities to influence the systems and workflows behind them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own gameplay animation features from concept to completion, including reference gathering, prototyping, asset creation, engine integration, debugging, and polish.
  • Create high-quality character movement and action animations, covering locomotion, directional changes, stance transitions, traversal, and combat interactions.
  • Contribute to first-person animation and its relationship with full-body movement, weapon handling, and camera feedback.
  • Partner with designers and programmers to refine movement responsiveness, action timing, transitions, and interruption behavior while preserving believable weight and physicality.
  • Build and refine animation graphs, state machines, blend setups, and animation layers within the project’s engine and tools.

About ROLLER

ROLLER is not your average software-as-a-service company. With a global presence in over 30 countries, we're here to bring some excitement to the leisure and attractions industry and make a difference! Our mission is to help businesses operate smoothly and create fun and memorable guest experiences by providing seamless ticketing, point-of-sale, self-serve kiosks, memberships and digital waiver processes.

But here's the best part: our team. We're a group of 300+ highly passionate, enthusiastic, and down-to-earth professionals located all around the world who are all working together to build something truly remarkable. We're aiming high and believe that the possibilities are endless. As we continue to grow globally, we're excited to write our success story and have fun along the way.

We genuinely love what we do, and we're looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team and make a real impact, come aboard, and let's create some unforgettable experiences together at ROLLER!

 

About the Role

We’re on the lookout for a Business Development Representative (BDR) who is fluent in French and has an interest in working both inbound and outbound leads to help grow our sales pipeline. Reporting to the Director of Business Development, you’ll be the front-line connection with prospects, mastering the sales process and qualification and setting our Account Executives up for success. This role is a hybrid (in-office/remote) position that involves researching, initiating and maintaining relationships, and capitalizing on every opportunity to foster growth. 

 

What You'll Do

Inbound and Outbound Prospecting:

  • Swiftly respond to inbound inquiries, reducing initial response time
  • Generate new business leads through outbound opportunities via calls and emails

Lead Qualification:

  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads through effective discovery calls
  • Understand prospect needs and pain points, articulating our product's value proposition

Pipeline Generation:

  • Drive urgency to progress prospects through the sales funnel
  • Collaborate with the sales team to meet company goals and targets

Relationship Building and Event Representation:

  • Initiate meetings between prospects and Account Executives
  • Drive engagement and seize new business opportunities from events

 

About You

  • You are based in London, and excel in a hybrid work environment, balancing in-office collaboration and remote productivity.
  • You are fluent in both French and English.
  • While 1-2 years of BDR experience in the B2B SaaS industry is a plus, we welcome candidates who show potential, drive, and a passion for sales even if they are new to the role.
  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding quotas, with a solid grasp of qualification frameworks like MEDDICC or BANT. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms is a big plus, as is proven success running outbound sales strategies.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are second nature to you—you know how to build strong relationships and communicate clearly with both clients and team members.

 

Perks!

  • Attractive compensation package.
  • We offer visa sponsorship support for qualified candidates, where required. 
  • You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry! Check our Capterra and G2 reviews.
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO), 10 sick days, and local paid Bank Holidays.
  • 16 weeks paid Parental leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental leave for secondary carers.
  • Employee-only Private Medical and Dental Insurance.
  • Company Pension with The People's Pension.
  • Life Insurance – Group Life Cover from day one.
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – Access to 24/7 GP and mental health support, physiotherapy, wellbeing resources, long-term condition support, and specialist services.
  • Engage in our ‘Vibe Tribe’ - led by our team members; you can contribute to company-wide initiatives directly. Regular events and social activities, fundraising & cause-related campaigns... you name it. We're willing to make it happen!
  • Team member Assistance Program to proactively support our team's health and well-being, access to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.
  • Highly flexible work environment with an All Access pass to WeWork, depending on your location.
  • Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.
  • Individual learning and development budget plus genuine career growth opportunities as we continue to expand!

 

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check (including criminal history) prior to commencement of employment

ROLLER isn't your average SaaS company. We operate globally across 30+ countries, powering millions of real-world experiences in the leisure and attractions industry. What we build doesn't just live on a screen. It shows up in busy venues, peak weekends, and unforgettable moments for guests.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: help operators run better businesses while creating great guest experiences. That means solving complex, real-world problems across ticketing, point of sale, self-service, memberships, kiosks, and digital waivers, all at meaningful scale.

Just as importantly, it's the people. We're a team of 300+ smart, grounded, and genuinely passionate humans working across the globe. We care about quality, ownership, and doing work we're proud of, without taking ourselves too seriously.

We're growing fast, aiming high, and building something that matters. If you want to work on real problems, with real customers, alongside people who care deeply about their craft and impact, ROLLER is a great place to do it.

 

Why You’ll Enjoy This Role!

🎯 Own the Full Deal And Outcome - You’ll run discovery, deliver demos, manage objections, negotiate pricing, and close deals end-to-end. This is a true closing role - not just qualification or handoff. The French market is pretty much greenfield! 

💻 A Product The Sells on Value, Not Hype - ROLLER is a category-leading platform in a complex, operationally critical space. Customers feel the impact immediately - on revenue, efficiency, and guest experience. That makes conversations deeper, more consultative, and far more satisfying than feature-led selling.

🎡 Fun Industry With Real-World Energy - We power go-kart tracks, trampoline parks, waterparks and other attractions around the world. Our customers are passionate operators creating memorable experiences, and you’ll see ROLLER in action firsthand. Site visits aren’t sterile office tours - they’re energetic, hands-on and genuinely a blast!

🏆 A Sales Org Reps Actually Rate Highly - ROLLER is ranked in the top 5% of companies on RepVue, based on feedback from real sales professionals. That reflects strong leadership, fair quotas, clear processes, and an environment where early-career sellers are supported to learn and grow. Don’t take our word for it - check out our RepVue page and see what reps say about working here.

 

Why You Want To Work With Us!

🩷 Loved by Customers - ROLLER is consistently highly rated on Capterra and G2, and trusted by leading operators worldwide. That doesn’t happen by accident. Customer obsession isn’t a value on a wall here, it’s embedded in how we prioritise, build, and measure success.

🏆 A Great Place People Choose to Stay - We’ve been Great Place to Work certified across multiple regions for several years running. That reflects a culture that values trust, autonomy, and growth, and an environment where high standards and psychological safety coexist.

💸 Competitive Package & Real Career Growth - We offer competitive compensation and benefits aligned to the level of ownership we expect. As ROLLER scales, so do the opportunities. People grow here by taking on bigger problems, broader scope, and greater responsibility. Progression is driven by impact and capability, not tenure, and strong performance is recognised and rewarded.

  • As an SMB Account Executive, you will play a key role in driving new customer acquisition across small and growing operators within the leisure and attractions industry.

  • Develop and execute territory and account plans to drive consistent pipeline generation and quota attainment.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/roller/jobs/526.description_excerpt:
About ROLLER

ROLLER isn’t your average SaaS company. We operate globally across 30+ countries, powering millions of real-world experiences in the leisure and attractions industry. What we build doesn’t just live on a screen. It shows up in busy venues, peak weekends, and unforgettable moments for guests.

Our mission is simple but ambitious: help operators run better businesses while creating great guest experiences. That means solving complex, real-world problems across ticketing, point of sale, self-service, memberships, kiosks, and digital waivers, all at meaningful scale.

Just as importantly, it’s the people. We’re a team of 300+ smart, grounded, and genuinely passionate humans working across the globe. We care about quality, ownership, and doing work we’re proud of, without taking ourselves too seriously.

We’re growing fast, aiming high, and building something that matters. If you want to work on real problems, with real customers, alongside people who care deeply about their craft and impact, ROLLER is a great place to do it.

 

Why You’ll Enjoy This Role!

🚀  Work that keeps venues trading - You’ll own fiscal and regulatory compliance across Europe. If it’s wrong, a venue can’t legally trade, so getting it right matters.

🤝  Your squad owns it - Squads are self-managing. The London squad owns localisation and compliance for Europe end to end, and you’ll work with your PM to decide what gets built, how it’s built and when it ships.

🌍  Real scale, real consequences - Thousands of requests per second across hundreds of containers, powering over 100 million guest experiences in 2025 alone.

✨  Help shape a growing team - Be one of the first engineers in London, set how the squad works, and help new engineers get up to speed.

 

Why This Role Matters

ROLLER is growing fast across Europe, and every new market brings its own rules on tax, invoicing, receipts and language. Our London squad makes sure venues in those markets can trade legally and run in their own language. Recent work includes fiscal compliance for markets like France, Germany and Austria, and AI-assisted translations across the platform.

You’ll join a small London squad reporting to a London based Tech Lead. Our HQ is in Australia, so most of your work with the wider team is async, with live time together every week or two. You’ll be comfortable owning your work, unblocking yourself and finding your own ways to stay connected.

Our backend runs on C#, .NET, T-SQL and AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, SES and SQS. On the front end, we use Angular alongside our own design system and component library.

 

What You’ll Do

Build

  • Design, build and ship changes across backend services, APIs and the Angular interfaces venues use every day
  • Build patterns for regional rules and compliance that we can extend to new markets

Own integrations

  • Lead integration-heavy work with third-party providers, like fiscal and certification partners: define the contract, handle the edge cases and plan for failure
  • Work directly with those providers when something needs chasing or clarifying

Own production

  • Collaborate closely with the SRE team to monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues
  • Triage compliance alerts and fix the root cause

Raise the bar

  • Share what you know through code reviews, pairing and honest feedback
  • Work with your PM to break vague regulatory requirements into small, shippable pieces

 

About You

  • You have a high appetite for Technology and AI and a natural curiosity for how it can transform your work. You’re comfortable using AI tools to automate repetitive 'busy work,' freeing you up to focus on high-impact work.
  • Solid mid-level or senior experience building and shipping full-stack software in a SaaS product company
  • Deep backend experience in C# and .NET, and enough Angular or TypeScript to work across the stack
  • Deep knowledge of cloud patterns, application and database performance, with experience applying them to varying workflows and workloads
  • You’ve built integrations with third-party systems where the details matter: payments, tax, invoicing, compliance or similar
  • You can take a vague requirement, like a new country’s tax rules, and turn it into something shipped
  • You do your best work async: you write things down clearly, unblock yourself and don’t need constant check-ins

Bonus points for experience with European fiscal rules, or for speaking French or German. You don’t need to match every point.

We believe AI is a career-defining inflection point. ROLLER is a fast adopter of new technology like AI, and every team member is empowered to own their learning and use the latest tools to supercharge their impact. We’re looking for candidates with the proficiency and curiosity to embrace AI and technology, not just as a technical skill, but as a core competency to help us achieve big goals. Our engineers use Claude and other AI coding tools day to day.

 

Perks!

🚀  You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry - check our Capterra and G2 reviews.

🏥  Private medical insurance through Vitality, plus dental cover.

💷  Company pension.

🛡️  Life insurance at 4x your base salary.

💙  Team member Assistance Program to proactively support our team’s health and wellbeing - access to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.

🍼  16 weeks paid Parental Leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental Leave for secondary carers

🎉  Engage in our ‘Vibe Tribe’ - led by our team members; you can contribute to company-wide initiatives directly. Regular events and social activities, fundraising & cause-related campaigns... you name it. We’re willing to make it happen!

💡  Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.

Go on, hit apply. Let’s build great tech together. If you’ve got questions, don’t be afraid to reach out to Reuben at reuben.jamieson@rollerdigital.com.

About ROLLER

ROLLER is not your average software-as-a-service company. With a global presence in over 30 countries, we're here to bring some excitement to the leisure and attractions industry and make a difference! Our mission is to help businesses operate smoothly and create fun and memorable guest experiences by providing seamless ticketing, point-of-sale, self-serve kiosks, memberships and digital waiver processes.

But here's the best part: our team. We're a group of 300+ highly passionate, enthusiastic, and down-to-earth professionals located all around the world who are all working together to build something truly remarkable. We're aiming high and believe that the possibilities are endless. As we continue to grow globally, we're excited to write our success story and have fun along the way.

We genuinely love what we do, and we're looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team and make a real impact, come aboard, and let's create some unforgettable experiences together at ROLLER!


About the Role

The Solution Engineer owns the end-to-end pre-sales process at ROLLER, commercial and technical. You partner with Account Executives to qualify, progress, and earn new business, while simultaneously running the technical validation that gives prospects the confidence to buy.

What sets a ROLLER SE apart is the combination. You carry the commercial rigour of a quota-carrying rep; MEDDICC discipline, value-based discovery, and business case ownership alongside the technical credibility to design and deliver compelling solutions. On the most complex deals, you'll have access to a Solution Architect as a force multiplier, which frees you to stay focused on the commercial motion where you create the most value.

In this role you will support ROLLER's growth across the French market, engaging prospects and customers in French while collaborating with our wider EMEA and global teams in English.

What You’ll Do

  • Champion MEDDICC qualification across your pipeline: identifying Economic Buyers, mapping Decision Criteria and Process, surfacing Implicated Pain, and maintaining a clear, honest view of deal health at all times
  • Lead technical & value based discovery with prospects, diagnosing operational and revenue pain points and connecting them explicitly to the value ROLLER delivers
  • Own the technical pre-sales process: running tailored product demonstrations, managing technical validation, and handling integration and configuration questions across the standard deal motion
  • In support with the AE, and our Business Value Consultant, present ROI-led business cases framed in the language of the Economic Buyer; revenue growth, cost reduction, and operational efficiency, not feature lists
  • Own competitive positioning in live deals, handling objections and neutralising competitor narratives with confidence and evidence
  • Partner closely with Account Executives on deal strategy, account planning, and executive engagement — presenting alongside them to C-suite stakeholders when the deal calls for it
  • Engage Solution Architects on your most complex, high-value opportunities. You'll brief them in, stay close to the commercial thread, and ensure technical depth doesn't slow the deal down
  • Respond to RFPs and RFIs, owning the commercial and functional positioning while leveraging SA support on technically deep sections
  • Collaborate with Customer Success on expansion and upsell motions with existing customers, applying the same qualification and value-selling approach to growth as to new logo.
  • Maintain clean pipeline and activity data in Salesforce, contributing to forecast accuracy and deal visibility
  • Feed commercial insights; win patterns, loss reasons, and competitive intelligence back to Sales leadership to sharpen the overall motion

 

About You

  • Must be a C1 fluent French speaker.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate confidently with internal teams and stakeholders across EMEA and globally.
  • Travel may be required up to 30%.
  • 3+ years in a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, or commercial pre-sales role within a SaaS company
  • Deep, practised familiarity with MEDDICC or an equivalent qualification methodology. You use it as a daily operating lens, not an occasional reference
  • Genuine commercial instinct: you think in business outcomes and ROI, and you can articulate ROLLER's value in terms that resonate with a CFO or Head of Operations
  • Technical confidence to run demos, handle product and integration questions, and manage a standard technical evaluation.
  • Proven ability to build and present business cases to economic buyers, including at the executive level.
  • Strong discovery skills. You ask the questions that open up a deal, surface real pain, and expose the risks that could kill it later
  • Competitive and driven. You want to win, and you know how to build a case that does
  • Strong executive presence and communication: credible in a boardroom, compelling on a screen
  • Experience with Salesforce as your CRM of record
  • Familiarity with value or solution selling frameworks (Command of the Message, Challenger, SCIPAB) is a strong advantage
  • Experience in leisure, attractions, hospitality, or entertainment is a plus, but commercial instinct and methodology matter most

Nice to have:

  • Experience with API concepts and standard integration patterns, enough to have an informed conversation without an SA in the room
  • Exposure to ROLLER's product categories: ticketing, POS, memberships, waivers, self-serve kiosks, payments
  • Experience working with API integrations and API development tools such as Postman and Swagger
  • Experience in pre-sale (Solution Architecture, Solution Engineering, Sales) is a plus
  • Experience in the leisure and attractions industry is a plus.
  • You’re tech-savvy and quick to learn new systems.
  • Your time and resource management skills, combined with a sharp attention to detail, set you up for success.

  • You know how to take ownership, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and effectively prioritize day-to-day tasks.

Application deadline:  22 November 2026 (applications may close earlier due to demand)

Programme start date:   September 2027

Eligibility:  Final year students graduating in 2027

Who we are:

Rothesay is the UK’s largest pensions insurance specialist, purpose-built to protect pension schemes and their members’ pensions. With over £74 billion of assets under management, we secure the pensions of more than one million people and pay out, on average, approximately £350 million in pension payments each month.

Rothesay is dedicated to providing excellence in customer service alongside prudent underwriting, a conservative investment strategy and the careful management of risk. We are trusted by the pension schemes of some of the UK’s best known companies to provide pension solutions, including British Airways, Cadbury, the Civil Aviation Authority, the Co-Operative, Morrisons, Smiths Industries and Telent. At Rothesay, we are striving to transform our industry. We believe deeply in creating real security for the future and our leadership in finding new and better ways to do that is the key to our success. To do that, we need the very brightest original thinkers to bring creativity as well as rigour. Rothesay is a rewarding place to work, where quality people can thrive and prosper. We pride ourselves on the connections our people build, many of whom have been with us for over ten years.

Graduate Programme:

Our UK graduate programme is designed to kick-start careers for ambitious and analytical graduates who want to make an impact. Rothesay is built on a multi-talented, multi-disciplined model, collaborating directly and with singular focus to shape the future. Rothesay’s inclusive and collaborative working environment allows our graduates to build a broad skill-set and shape a strong internal network. We support your development journey, growth in your career, in addition to offering a competitive salary and tailored benefits.

Our 2 year* programme starts with a fundamentals week for the entire graduate cohort, where you will have in depth networking and insight sessions on Rothesay as a whole. From week two, you will join your team for professional integrated learning and start to make meaningful contributions. Throughout your first year, alongside your permanent role, you will be part of an on-site graduate development programme with both technical and business skills training.  Our teams run lean, giving you excellent visibility and exposure throughout the business, and we will provide continuous training and upskilling for your future.  Rothesay is a rewarding place to work, where quality people can thrive and prosper.  Regular reviews will take place to support your learning and development with a formal assessment towards the end of the programme.

This opportunity is open to summer 2027 graduates who are looking to launch into their career within an entrepreneurial environment where talent can thrive and excel.

What you’ll do:

We are seeking an enthusiastic, self-motivated, and hardworking graduate to join Rothesay’s Financial Reporting team as a trainee Accountant. The successful candidate will learn a wide variety of accounting skills on-the-job, whilst studying towards a funded accounting qualification.

  • Assisting with the preparation and analysis of monthly management accounts under IFRS
  • Assisting in the preparation of the monthly balance sheet substantiations
  • Assisting with the preparation and review of financial statements under IFRS including liaison with auditors
  • Assisting in the preparation of annual regulatory returns
  • Aiding in the preparation of quarterly and annual ONS returns
  • Understanding the business and keeping up-to-speed with business developments
  • Proactively seeking opportunities to improve manual processes and enhance reporting through process reviews, automation, standardisation, and improved data analysis
  • Involvement in a broad range of department–wide projects and initiatives as well as cross-business initiatives

What we offer

  • A meritocratic, driven and stimulating environment where success and achievement are rewarded
  • Work with support from leaders in the industry and excellent on-the-job training supplemented with class-based business training where best applied
  • A competitive starting salary with a performance related bonus

What we are looking for

  • Graduate intending to study for a professional qualification such as ACA or ACCA qualification,
  • Interested in pursuing a career in finance
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail,
  • Willing to work in a highly driven team environment,
  • Ability to work under pressure,
  • Highly motivated individual with strong interpersonal skills,
  • Proficient PC Skills (Word, Excel),

job-boards.greenhouse.io/tripadvisor/job.description_excerpt:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator.  

Who are we looking for? 

As a CX Advisor, you will ensure our tour operators strictly adhere to established procedures—specifically regarding the traveler experience and platform content guidelines. Operating with a dedicated, traveler-first mindset, you will help resolve daily operational challenges and maintain service standards to safeguard the operator ecosystem. Beyond driving operational efficiency, you will provide hands-on support to tour operators worldwide, guiding them via email, chat, and phone to maintain accurate and high-performing product listings on Viator and Tripadvisor.

Operating in our fast-paced, evolving environment, you will bring Tripadvisor's "Traveler First" philosophy to life by advocating for both our travelers and operators in every decision. If you have a genuine love for travel, exceptional B2B customer service skills, and a proactive "can-do" attitude, you will thrive here. In this role, you will not only support and scale our growing online business but also play a vital role in the development, training, and collective success of your colleagues.  

 

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week in our Oxford Office.

 

Role Scope & Focus

  • Execution to Escalations: Maintains primary oversight of high-volume onshore and Tier-2 queue management while utilizing content management systems to review, refine, and optimize tour and activity listings across Viator. 

  • Technical & Strategic Scope: Focus on executing standard workflows and applying established best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Operator Support & Issue Resolution

  • Support: Provide high-quality, real-time assistance to tour operators via email, live chat, and phone.

  • Support & Resolution: Assist with resolving operational questions and identifying issues, escalating complex concerns to senior team members when needed.

  • Account & Booking Care: Assist operators with account management, product inquiries, and booking resolutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal support teams to swiftly resolve overlapping traveler and operator issues.

Product Optimization & Connectivity

  • Listing Enhancement: Utilize content management systems to review, refine, and optimize tour and activity listings on Viator.

  • Accurate Distribution: Ensure precise categorization of products across all sales channels, including Viator, Tripadvisor, and distribution partners.

  • Technical Connectivity: Facilitate and troubleshoot seamless integration between operator booking systems and Viator/Tripadvisor platforms.

  • Product Guidance: Share established best practices with operators to help improve their product listings and visibility.

Team Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Self-Service Advocacy: Train operators to effectively utilize self-service tools for managing bookings, updating account details, and maintaining accurate profiles. 

  • Team Support: Participate in team discussions, contribute to group goals, and support new departmental initiatives.

  • Relationship Building: Establish and maintain trusted relationships with internal business units, external vendors, and global partners.

  • Agility: Handle other duties and projects as assigned to support business growth.

Qualifications & Experience

Professional Experience & Skills

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Prior customer support or partner-facing experience is a plus, but not required.

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English (bilingual proficiency is a plus).

  • Technical Savvy: Proficient with Google Workspace, online platforms, and CRM systems (experience with Salesforce is highly preferred).

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to learn quickly, follow established processes, and work effectively as part of a team to solve routine challenges.
