About Yondr

Yondr is a disruptor. We challenge convention and simplify complexity. A global developer, owner operator and service provider of data centers, we deliver complex data center capacity needs for the world’s largest tech companies. Our exponential growth sees us looking for extraordinary people to help accelerate us towards our vision: a tomorrow without constraints. 

 

But we can’t do this without you.

About the Role 

With continued growth across our business, we are actively seeking to have a new member join our team. This is an exciting role to join an existing group of skilled development and investment professionals, enhancing the team capabilities and becoming an integral part of a rapidly growing business. We are searching for someone who has excellent quantitative and analytical skills, is comfortable building financial models and has experience with communicating with internal and external stakeholders. You will be a highly valued and trusted member of our ambitious and hardworking team, in a business that continues to scale to new heights.

 

 

Main Responsibilities 

/ Take responsibility for development and management of financial models and valuation analysis in support of potential transactions and investment opportunities

/  Support in all aspects of financing processes included due diligence, project management, data room management, financial analysis, legal negotiations and preparation of materials

/  Work closely with the Development and Finance teams to perform detailed financial analysis on new developments as well as existing portfolio assets

/  Production of presentation material for senior management, board members, investors, lenders and joint venture partners

/  Assist with commercial negotiation of legal contracts for transactions

/  Research and analysis of market trends and sector / asset valuations

/  Support in business strategy and individual project delivery

/  Provide analysis for commercial negotiations with strategic partners or customers

 

 

Qualifications and experience 

/  At least 2 years of experience for Analyst or 3 years of experience for Associate in Banking, Finance, Accounting or Real Estate with a focus on investments / transactions

/  Degree in areas such as Finance / Accounting / Economics / Engineering / Maths

/  Knowledge of data centers / infrastructure / real estate investment process preferred but not mandatory

/  Excellent quantitative and analytical skills, proficient with Microsoft excel

/  Experience in financial modelling and investment appraisals. Ability to present results internally to team members.

/ Strong presentation skills and the ability to articulate support for strategic recommendations

/  Desire to learn about the dynamics and trends of digital infrastructure

/  Flexible & dynamic - self-motivated, results driven, ability to deal with change

/  Highly organised and structured, logical and lateral thinker

/  Team player, with exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to influence and add value

/  Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

 

At Yondr, we want to enhance the diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging of our workforce to reflect the world we live in. Our roles are potential opportunities for everyone; all interested parties, regardless of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender, are welcome to apply. We ensure all candidates have equitable access and consideration throughout the hiring process.

 

Yondr is committed to fostering a welcoming, safe and inclusive work environment. We provide support through our benefits, which are inclusive of all backgrounds.

About Yondr

Yondr is a disruptor. We challenge convention and simplify complexity. A global developer, owner operator and service provider of data centers, we deliver complex data center capacity needs for the world’s largest tech companies. Our exponential growth sees us looking for extraordinary people to help accelerate us towards our vision: a tomorrow without constraints. 

 

But we can’t do this without you.

About the Role 

The Global Estimating Director will play a critical leadership role in developing and managing Yondr’s end-to-end cost estimating and benchmarking strategy. Focused on large-scale data center construction, this role ensures financial predictability, enhances commercial decision-making, and supports global project delivery.

 

Main Responsibilities 

/   Strategy: Define, develop and lead the cost estimating strategy for datacenter construction projects from conceptual design to final construction documents.

/    Benchmarking: Establish and maintain a comprehensive database of construction cost benchmarks to aid in accurate project cost forecasts.

/    Cost Estimation: Provide early cost estimates to establish the feasibility of new markets and sites

/    Central resources: Manage, Maintain and develop a central pool of resources to support in the development of cost estimates to improve accuracy and consistency globally

/    Global Experience: Leverage your global construction expertise to provide insights and best practices for projects in various geographic locations.

/    Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations, using data visualization techniques, to communicate cost estimations, benchmarks, and recommendations to senior management.

/    Continuously improve cost estimation and benchmarking processes, leveraging technological advancements and best practices.

/    Provide strategic insights to optimize project costs and improve cost-efficiency.

/    Utilise data analytics and reporting tools to establish meaningful insights from project data while implementing data-driven strategies to optimize project costs, identify cost-saving opportunities, and improve overall cost-efficiency.

·        Minimal software and network overhead
·        Direct interaction with market data feeds and order gateways

·        Networking

·        Exchange simulators and market data replay tools

Essential

·        Proven background in HFT or ultra-low latency trading environments
·        Deep understanding of CPU architecture, caches and memory models
·        Strong knowledge of concurrency, memory ordering and Linux internals
·        Experience working close to hardware and network layers
·        Strong production mindset and sense of ownership

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

DeepL runs product-led growth alongside our sales-led motion, with media translation as the strategic wedge. This role is responsible for turning DeepL into the default platform for translation worldwide driving adoption through product usage, and converting that usage into strong Product Qualified Leads (PQLs) tha convert into revenues and strengthen our sales pipeline. This role drives adoption of our core DeepL Translate features (e.g. Customization Hub, TQE) and cross-sell into adjacent products like DeepL Voice. You will start with a focus on Media Translation.
Your Mission: Put DeepL Translate in the hands of everyone, everywhere and use that reach to grow adoption across DeepL's broader product surface, turning usage into a reliable, high-quality source of PQLs for the business.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
- Use case strategy: prioritize the highest-value use cases for media translation, and and build the growth loops and product surface to drive adoption of them.
- Distribution on the DeepL platform (main channel): drive media translation adoption directly within web, browser extension, and apps. Work closely with the API/MCP track.
- PLG/PQL engine: define what qualifies as a strong PQL for media translation (usage signals, account characteristics, intent signals) , build the instrumentation to detect it, and design a clean handoff into sales.
- Growth plays for feature/product discovery: design and run growth loops that help users discover and adopt more features and products beyond their initial media translation use case, expanding usage depth and breadth.
- Cross-functional coordination:
- Close collaboration with the Marketing team on funnel design, messaging, and PQL feedback loop.
- Coordination with Sales/Sales Ops on PQL definition and handoff.
- Iterate with Pricing & Packaging team on P&P strategy and optoimization
- Metrics ownership: define and report on leading indicators (platform usage, feature adoption, cross-sell conversion, open-source adoption), and rigorously attribute product usage and these metrics to business outcomes (pipeline, revenue, retention) not just track activity, but prove and quantify its impact.
QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
- A builder, first and foremost someone who can build with AI, prototype fast, test with real users, and scale what works. This is a hands-on role, not a strategy-only one.
- Track record building or scaling a PLG motion that feeds a sales organization ideally with direct experience owning PQL definition and handoff.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management this role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering, and needs to align each of them without owning their roadmaps.
- Experience growing adoption within a core consumer/prosumer product (web, extension, or app), not just developer-facing surfaces.
- Experience designing growth loops for feature/product discovery and expansion, not just top-of-funnel acquisition.
- Experience with open-source community strategy has shipped or grown an OSS project, ideally in ML/AI.
- Comfortable working in a hybrid PLG + SLG model and operating cross-functionally with teams whose roadmaps this role doesn't own.
WHAT WE OFFER
- Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
- Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
- Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
- Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
- Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
Astronomer’s products run on a complex, multi-cloud platform — and the scalability, and operational maturity of that platform is what we’re actively investing in. The work ahead on our Platform team isn’t about managing data or curating pipelines; it’s about building the foundational systems that everything else runs on — the kind of systems where the failure modes matter, the latency budgets are real, and getting it wrong has visible consequences for hundreds of enterprise customers.
We’re looking for a Staff-level engineer who has built production platform systems at scale before — not just consumed them. You’ve designed systems under load, reasoned carefully about failure, and made your colleagues’ lives better by giving them something solid and well-understood to build on top of. You write strategy documents and then write the code that proves them out. You’ve driven a decision through, and lived with the consequences.
This is a foundational role at a consequential moment: your work will directly shape what Astronomer’s products — Astro, Observe, and our IDE — are capable of over the next several years.
WHAT YOU GET TO DO
Astronomer has a healthy and complex infrastructure estate spanning multiple cloud providers, a mix of managed and self-hosted systems, and an increasingly ambitious set of requirements as our products evolve. We have a clear sense of where we need to go; we need the right person to figure out how to get there and then go build it.
This is a deeply technical role with a high bar for code, so you’re an experienced developer, ideally in Go. A substantial part of your impact also comes from setting direction: design docs, proposals, and bringing along teams you don’t manage. Prefer heads-down coding most of the week? This role may not be the best fit.
- Blaze a Trail: Own and develop our platform infrastructure strategy, with the sponsorship and responsibility to match. Map out what we need, build the case, bring the affected teams along, and own the outcomes.
- Be an Owner: Be directly involved in deciding what we work on and how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.
- Do Sensible Things: Make principled build vs. buy assessments and advocate for the right tools for the right job — not the fashionable ones, not the ones already in the estate just because they’re there.
- Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation and decision records for systems and processes. Participate in architectural forums and make principled, open decisions that the rest of the organization can learn from and hold us to.
IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?
- A small, senior team. No direct reports; you lead through influence, not management.
- Broad scope. Our control plane, CI/CD, builds and releases, observability, secrets and networking, with internal teams as your customers.
- Buy-in, not authority. You’ll often need agreement from teams you don’t manage.
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE
- Distributed systems depth, grounded in practice. You have a solid working model of how production systems fail — consistency and availability tradeoffs, failure cascades, backpressure, graceful degradation. You can draw the diagram, explain the failure modes at each node, and make a reasoned argument for which ones actually matter in a given context. NALSD https://sre.google/workbook/non-abstract-design/ thinking is how you naturally approach a new system design.

As the Marketing Manager, Europe, you will be responsible for designing and executing the programs that build pipeline, strengthen brand presence, and accelerate revenue across the region. You will own end-to-end regional marketing strategy with a heavy emphasis on field events, account-based marketing (ABM), and pipeline generating campaigns that directly support the European sales team.
You will operate as a collaborative partner to specialized marketers across Andela's global team — including growth, content, design, PR, and client marketing— bringing their capabilities to bear in the European market context. This role reports into the Senior Director of Marketing GTM Strategy and is based in the UK within a commutable distance to London.
Exceptional Leadership
As an Andelan, you'll serve as a role model for the rest of the company — you do not need to manage people to be a leader at Andela! Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.
- Low ego, low drama: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.
- Onedela mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.
- Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.
- Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.
- Cultivator: You enrich, you push, you make others grow. It comes from the heart, because you care.
Key Responsibilities
Regional Event Strategy & Execution
- Own the end-to-end planning and execution of European field events — including owned events, sponsored industry conferences, roundtables, and executive dinners — aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.
- Build and maintain a European events calendar, managing logistics, vendor relationships, budget, and post-event follow-up to ensure measurable ROI.
- Partner with the sales team to ensure event audiences reflect target account lists, and that every event ties to a clear pipeline outcome.
- Track and report on event performance including attendee quality, influenced pipeline, and cost-per-opportunity.
Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
- Partner with the Growth Marketing team to design and execute ABM programs targeting high-priority European accounts in collaboration with sales leadership.
- Use account intelligence to both inform campaigns and support the regional sellers.
- Measure ABM effectiveness at the account level, reporting on account engagement, pipeline created, and influenced revenue.
Pipeline Generation & Demand Generation
- Own regional pipeline contribution targets, developing programs that generate qualified opportunities for the European sales team.
- Build and execute integrated campaigns — across email, paid, content, and events — that move target accounts through the funnel.
- Partner with the global Growth Marketing team to localize and adapt global campaigns for the European market, including messaging, channels, and timing.
- Maintain a consistent drumbeat of regional campaigns, adapting quickly based on performance data and sales feedback.
Sales & Cross-Functional Partnership
- Act as the primary marketing partner to the European sales team, building a close working relationship with sales leadership to align on pipeline goals, target accounts, and priorities.
- Collaborate with content, digital, and brand teams to pull global resources into regional execution — you are a multiplier, not a solo function.
- Provide European market insights, competitive intelligence, and buyer feedback to inform global marketing strategy and messaging.
- Work with the Revenue Operations team to develop regionally relevant sales enablement materials and outreach.
Reporting & Optimization
- Track, analyze, and report on regional marketing performance against brand awareness, pipeline, engagement.
- Continuously test and iterate on program approaches, applying data-driven insights to improve outcomes over time.
Qualifications
Experience
- 4-6 years of B2B marketing experience, with a strong track record in field marketing, events, or demand generation roles, ideally within a high-growth technology company.
- Demonstrated experience running field events end-to-end — from strategy and planning through to execution and post-event reporting.
- Hands-on experience building and executing ABM programs, including target account selection, campaign orchestration, and measurement.
- Experience working closely with sales teams and an understanding of how marketing contributes to the revenue funnel.
- Prior experience in the European market.
- Experience working across time zones as part of a global team.
Skills & Capabilities
- Strong project management skills — able to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously with a high degree of organization and attention to detail.
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign data, draw actionable insights, and present results clearly to stakeholders.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences and channels.
Location
- While Andela is a fully remote organization, this role should be based in the United Kingdom within a commutable distance to London to accommodate regular team in-person working sessions.
- Some travel across Europe required for events and meetings.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/ben/77a0e08a-1061-4b70-.description_excerpt:
OUR MISSION
We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.
Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.
YOUR MISSION
As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.
You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.
WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON
- Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.
- Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.
- Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.
- Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.
- Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.
- Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.
- Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
BEHIND THE SCENES
Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.
Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.
We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.
YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- Strong experience with Python and SQL.
- A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.
- Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.
- A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.
- Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.
- Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.
- You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.
NICE TO HAVE, NOT ESSENTIAL:
- Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format
- Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.
We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.
WHY JOIN US?
Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.
At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.
You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.
OUR COMPENSATION & BENEFITS
It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here https://www.thanksben.com/benefits-at-ben.
💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build
⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance
💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250
🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!
🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 2 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!
🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones.
🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting
❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance
💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check
DIVERSITY AND CULTURE AT BEN
We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying, but all applications are very much welcome. If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just let us know by emailing jobs@thanksben.com.

Through all of it, you own how our largest customers experience Ben, from the enterprise sales conversation through to a confident go-live.
THINGS YOU WILL BE WORKING ON
- Transform how we implement enterprise customers: today we deliver well on the strength of the people doing it, and that ceiling is now the thing holding us back. Rebuild the operating model, the standards and the reusable components so we can take on far more without adding a person for every customer, and collapse the time it takes a customer to reach value.
- Make implementation AI-native: our builds are technically complex (integrations, eligibility logic, huge volumes of data). At Body & Soul, we create luxury intimate portrait experiences for everyday women – most of whom have never done a shoot before. By the time a guest meets you, she’s already had her session, felt the transformation, and is seeing her images for the first time on Zoom.
We’ve already guided over 2,600 guests through this experience. For many, it’s been the most important, confidence‑shifting thing they did that year. From going for (and getting) dream jobs… leaving unfulfilling relationships… to finally travelling the world solo… all after seeing themselves through new eyes.
This is the power of Intimate Portraiture. As our remote Art Curator, you’ll be a direct source of that change every single day – not just “selling photos,” but helping guests choose artwork that changes how they see themselves for life.
If you want to use your sales craft to guide high‑trust, emotionally rich conversations – and you’re confident asking for several thousand pounds on a call – keep reading. If you’re looking for a side‑gig where you can dabble, this won’t be the right home.
ROLE AT A GLANCE
- Location: Remote, UK Timezone (or very close)
- Schedule: 5 days per week, including regular evenings and weekends
- Typical day: 3–4 x 60–90 minute Zoom reveals + prep, notes and light follow‑up
- Compensation: ~£28,000 base salary + uncapped commission
- Realistic OTE: ~£70,000–£85,000/year for consistent performers; top performers earning up to ~£110,000–£115,000/year at our present pricing
- Reports to: Sales Manager
YOUR MISSION
Help guests make clear, confident decisions about artwork that reflects how they now see themselves – and lead those decisions into clean, joyful payments on a single Zoom call.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Run 3–4 pre‑booked Zoom reveal sessions per day with guests who have already completed their shoot (no cold calling, no prospecting)
- Guide each guest through her gallery, help her narrow down favourites, and design artwork collections and wall pieces that fit her space, style and budget
- Confidently present pricing, explain our collections and payment options, and take payment on the call using our proven structure
- Use our call framework, scripts and tools while still bringing your own warmth and personality
- Capture clear notes in our system so production, framing and delivery teams can fulfil flawlessly
- Manage focused follow‑up for guests who genuinely need to confirm details with a partner or adjust an order, within clear guardrails (no endless chasing)
- Participate in regular call reviews and coaching to keep improving your communication and results
- Collaborate with photographers, Guest Experience and ops so the whole journey feels seamless for the guest
HOW WE’LL KNOW YOU’RE WINNING
- Most of your reveals end in a clear, confident “yes” or “no” and a completed artwork order, not vague maybes
- Your average artwork order sits around £2,000+ with many guests happily investing £3,000–£4,000+
- You consistently meet or exceed your monthly artwork revenue targets while protecting guest experience and boundaries
- Guests leave calls feeling seen, respected and excited – not pressured, shamed or confused
- You’re a calm, grounding presence on emotional calls, even when money, body image or relationships come up
COMPENSATION & EARNINGS
This is a base‑plus‑commission role with uncapped upside.
- Base salary: around £28,000 per year (paid monthly)
- Typical artwork orders currently range from ~£2,000–£4,000+
- Realistic total earnings for consistent performers: ~£70,000–£85,000 per year (base + commission)
- Top performers, running a fuller calendar and maintaining strong average order values, can earn up to ~£110,000–£115,000 per year at current pricing
- Your income grows directly with your results.

- You see sales as service: helping guests make clear decisions that honour both their finances and their transformation, not arm‑twisting them into the biggest package
- You’re comfortable talking about money calmly and directly, including asking for several thousand pounds on a single call
- You genuinely care about women feeling powerful in their own skin and can hold emotional space without losing commercial clarity
- You like following a proven process, being coached, and being held to clear standards and targets
- You’re happy working some evenings and regular weekends to match when guests are available
- You’re self‑managed in a remote setting: you show up prepared, on time, every day, without someone looking over your shoulder
- You’re looking for a primary home to go all‑in on, not just another offer to plug into your calendar
THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…
- You feel uncomfortable being seen as “the salesperson” and you avoid direct conversations about money, commitment or boundaries
- You want cosy, open‑ended “coaching” conversations more than structured calls with a clear decision and next step
- You need strict 9–5 weekdays only
- You’re looking for a side gig while you build your own coaching/creative business
- You see every call as a “win at all costs” competition rather than a space for calm, grounded decisions
- You resist feedback on your calls or don’t want your performance tied to outcomes
- You’re juggling multiple high‑ticket closing gigs and just want to “plug in” here for extra commission
REQUIREMENTS
- You have 1+ years of higher‑investment, consultative B2C sales experience (e.g. luxury services, premium memberships, jewellery, interiors, art, coaching, or similar)
- Exceptional emotional intelligence and listening skills
- Clear, confident spoken English and professional communication
- A quiet, private workspace suitable for sensitive video calls
- Stable internet (50 Mbps+ up/down)
- UK working rights and ability to work UK‑aligned hours, including some evenings/weekends
TRAINING, GROWTH & CULTURE
- Structured onboarding with call shadowing, scripts, objection handling and product training
- Ongoing call reviews, coaching and development from a high‑performing, heart‑led sales team
- Clear scorecards so you always know where you stand and what to improve
- Female‑founded company with a mission‑driven brand guests are proud to invest in
- Museum‑quality, handcrafted artwork that genuinely matches the investment you’re asking for
HOW TO APPLY
Please do not message us on Instagram or call the studio to apply – we run all hiring through our application process so we can review everyone fairly.
To apply:

- If it looks like a potential fit, we’ll invite you to record a short video about your experience and why this role is right for you.
- From there, shortlisted candidates will be invited into our interview process and a live call audition.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/bodysoul/6ead27c3-0c1c-.description_excerpt:
YOUR MISSION
You are the beating heart of the guest experience. Your job is to make sure no woman gets lost or feels left behind, and that our guests, our team and our studio all have a brilliant experience.
By the time a guest reaches you she has spoken to our front-end team, had her onboarding call and joined a community call. From there you are her point of contact. You support her by phone before her shoot, look after her in person on the day, and take her through our artwork in the studio before her reveal.
To do that well, you become the person who understands all of it: our art, how a guest should prepare, how to steady her nerves, and how to see a problem before it arrives. Our photographers, makeup artists and art curators walk in knowing who they are meeting and what she needs, because you have already read her notes and passed them on.
You are the dream weaver behind each woman's day.
WHAT THE ROLE ENTAILS
- Call guests before their shoot to answer questions, settle nerves and confirm the practical details. We pick up the phone far more often than we send emails
- Review the week ahead and spot guests at risk of cancelling, for example someone who has not opened an email in two weeks
- Fill last-minute gaps when a guest reschedules, so the studio stays full
- Read each guest's notes in advance and find ways to personalise her day, such as marking a birthday
- Welcome guests in person and look after them through the day: drinks, belongings, timings and comfort
- After the shoot, show guests our artwork in person and prepare them for their reveal
- Keep our CRM accurate and make sure guest notes are handed over properly between departments
- Work with the production team on artwork orders and on guest satisfaction at every stage
- Keep reception and the guest areas immaculate
HOW WE’LL KNOW YOU’RE WINNING
Your work is measured. Show rate, seated capacity and guest experience scores are yours to move, and when they rise, revenue rises with them.
- More sessions filled, a higher show rate and fewer late cancellations
- Guest experience scores go up, and guests mention you by name in their feedback
- Problems are caught early. The team is rarely surprised, and the guests are the ones who get the surprises
- Guests arrive at their reveal prepared and familiar with the artwork
- The CRM is clean, and notes are complete when another department picks them up
- You consistently ask for feedback rather than waiting to be given it
- You work well with every member of the team
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF…
- You are driven by the mission. You care about what this work does for women
- You are charismatic and personable, and you get your energy from being around people
- You are extraordinarily confident on camera, on the phone and in person. This role uses all three every day
- You write well. Your emails and messages represent the brand
- Clear metrics and KPIs motivate you, and you have worked to them before
- You are calm and steady, and not easily flustered
- You are accountable. You own an outcome and see it through without being chased
- You are solution-orientated and detail-orientated, and you notice what others miss
- You see opportunities to make a guest's day better, and you take them
- You read people quickly and know when a guest wants company and when she wants quiet
- You present extraordinarily well and you enjoy being the face of something
- You have been one of the strongest performers wherever you have worked, and you want your results to be visible
WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
This is not a lead generation role and it is not a sales job. You work with guests who have already booked, not with leads, and you will not carry a sales target the way our sales team does. What you carry instead is the energy and the values of Body & Soul, in person, all day.
REQUIREMENTS
- A customer experience background at the premium end: luxury retail, a five-star hotel, a private members’ club, premium airline cabin crew, luxury beauty or somewhere comparable. General hospitality or retail experience on its own is unlikely to be enough
- Experience in a role with clear targets and KPIs
- Very comfortable on the phone and on video calls. Much of this role is calls
- Excellent written English
- Comfortable discussing prices and collections
- Competent with a CRM and on a computer
- You will work weekends consistently, and evenings as those sessions open. These are not occasional shifts, they are the standard working pattern for this role
Sales experience is a significant plus. So is a background in art.
GROWTH & PERKS
- Therapy, fully covered. Up to 30 sessions a year from day one. Independent, confidential and entirely yours
- Healthcare cash-back. Everyday costs like dental, optical and physiotherapy come back to you, up to £2,500
- Weekly 1:1 and coaching
- Gathered often. Team huddles, dinners, outings and community events through the year
- A team and community behind you. People who genuinely want you to be your best
We do not employ part-time or freelance creatives.
HOW TO APPLY
Click Apply on this page and complete the short application form. It takes about five minutes.
Above everything, unimpeachable character.
Sincere Candour.
Radical Accountability.
Uncompromising Excellence.
Craft sits on top of that. We can teach craft. We cannot teach character, which is why your life experience counts here as much as your portfolio.

You will have up to two pages of notes on her beforehand, covering why she is here, what she is hoping for, her insecurities, the kind of art she responds to, her creative profile and how she normally presents herself.

- Complete each look within the allocated time and keep sessions running to schedule

- Stay on set for the entire shoot, topping up / adjusting hair and makeup where needed. Supporting in the lighting and occasionally guest posing (where extra hands are needed) Noticing when a guest is tense and help her settle
- Handle the small details that make her day easier: a drink, a lipstick touch-up, packing her bag before she needs it
- Capture high-quality behind-the-scenes video for our use. Training is provided
- Keep an immaculate, organised station and follow strict hygiene and sanitation standards
HOW WE’LL KNOW YOU’RE WINNING
- You arrive able to brief the team in detail on every guest in your chair that day: who she is, why she is here and what she is looking for. You have read her consultation before you walk in
- Guests are ready for the photographer on time, without rushing
- Guests leave positive feedback naming you, and often mention the conversation as well as the makeup
- You run full styling days independently on our busiest days while maintaining guest experience standards
- You work well with every member of the team. There are no cliques here. You support others and allow yourself to be supported
- Your station is clean, stocked and organised at all times
- You capture usable behind-the-scenes footage on most shoots without slowing the day down
- You finish your days feeling empowered rather than drained. This work is demanding, but it should not leave you depleted
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF…
- You love being busy, moving and on your feet all day
- You get genuine satisfaction from hitting tight timings and following checklists
- You care deeply about women feeling powerful and beautiful in their own skin
- You want to go all‑in on your craft, even if that means long, intense days rather than “perfect balance”
- You like clear standards, honest feedback and being held to numbers on timing, quality and guest experience
- You thrive in a high‑standard, direct, team‑first environment
REQUIREMENTS
1. At least two years working in the industry. Time spent studying does not count
2. Complete confidence working across all skin tones, ages and ethnicities. We teach a great deal here, but we do not teach colour matching or the fundamentals of working with diverse skin
3. Comfortable styling and supporting three guests per day, on your feet most of the time
4. Strong hygiene standards and kit and product care
5. You will work evenings and weekends consistently. These are not occasional shifts, they are the standard working pattern for this role
YOUR KIT IS PROVIDED
You do not need to bring hair tools, makeup or products of any kind. Our kit is extensive and built from the best products on the market, curated by our Studio Manager, who is an industry expert in makeup artistry and body painting.
Growth & Perks
- Therapy, fully covered. Up to 30 sessions a year from day one. Independent, confidential and entirely yours
- Healthcare cash-back. Everyday costs like dental, optical and physiotherapy come back to you (up to £2,500)
- Your artistry, championed. Real encouragement and support to push your own artistry, and the artistry of Body & Soul
- Gathered often. Team huddles, dinners, outings and community events through the year
- A team and community behind you. People who genuinely want you to be your best, and who help you grow
- A defined HMUA ladder, with pay rises tied to your results, behaviour and craft level rather than tenure
- Weekly 1:1 & coaching from your Studio Manager
We do not currently employ, and are not looking for, part-time or freelance creatives.

YOUR MISSION
As our Sales Consultant, you are the front door to Body & Soul. You are the first person a woman speaks to, and you represent the brand and our ethos.
Body & Soul is application-only. Nobody can book an experience online. Every woman has a discovery call with you first, and she comes to the studio only if you invite her.
This is a remote, phone-based role. She has seen our work and got in touch, so every lead is warm and inbound, and there is no cold calling. You invite her to the studio and help her past fear and doubt.
You also make sure we invite the right women. We do not sell to vulnerable women. You qualify that she is emotionally, financially and mentally in the right place, and that she values the art and shares our values. You are judged on the women you turn away as well as the women you book.
Our sales are ethical and built on empathy, and that standard holds through every part of the process. When you qualify a woman and welcome her into our community, you fill the studio, and that creates the work for everyone else in the company.
THE TEAM YOU'RE JOINING
You join a sales team of two Art Curators and two Sales Consultants, led by our CEO, who is also acting Sales Director.
There is a sales huddle every morning. Clear data, dashboards and KPIs show you where you stand, and you get a 30, 60 and 90 day ramp plan from day one.
Our sales process has been built over six years and it is thorough. The expectations are extraordinarily high.
WHAT THE ROLE ENTAILS
- Run 20 to 25 minute phone consultations with women who have enquired
- Follow our sales process and scripts
- Take payment on the call and get her session in the diary
- Follow up no-shows, "thinking about it" and past enquiries when your calendar is light
- Keep your pipeline and CRM notes clean so the next person can pick up without asking
HOW YOU'RE MEASURED
We are a target-based company. We work from metrics, data and KPIs, and your income reflects the impact you make.
You own your numbers and bring them to Huddle every morning. Once you are ramped, the minimum is 15 paid bookings a week. The standard is 20. Our best performers reach 25.
Qualifying is a big part of this role: who you invite and who you turn away. Our close rate is around 40%, because we turn away most of the other 60%.
THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF
- You are a top performer where you are now, or you know you should be
- You are happy being on the phone all day
- You like being measured and want to see your numbers every morning
- You take coaching and use it on the next call
- You can talk with women about confidence, body image, fine art nudity and money in the same conversation
- You want a career in sales with somewhere to go
REQUIREMENTS
- Sales experience over the phone or video, selling to individuals
- You have worked on commission before
- Your experience is in a service or premium business: a studio, clinic, salon, gallery, members’ club, events, travel or premium retail. Selling art, or selling for another studio, is ideal
- Experience selling phones, software, courses or information products on its own is unlikely to be enough
- Ideally you have worked remotely before
- You live within two hours of central London, ideally within 90 minutes
- You have the right to work in the UK
- You can work five days a week, with weekends as part of your normal schedule
- You are comfortable that our studio specialises in fine art nudity, and that you will talk with women about it
YOUR HOME OFFICE
This is a remote role and guests hear everything behind you, so your set-up matters.
- A private room with a door, where nobody else comes in while you work. We strongly favour a dedicated office over a bedroom
- Fast, reliable internet: at least 100 Mbps download and 100 Mbps upload
- Your own laptop and monitor for your first 60 days. The company supplies equipment after 60 to 90 days
WHERE IT LEADS
There is a lot of support and a lot of growth in this seat: daily sales training, one-to-one coaching and a clear scorecard.
As you prove yourself you can be cross-trained to sell our artwork and collections on onboarding calls, and progress to an Art Curator role. We promote from within.
PAY
This is a base salary plus uncapped commission role. On-target earnings are £50,000 to £70,000.
HOW TO APPLY
Complete the short application form. If it’s a fit, the next step is three short video answers.
Above everything, unimpeachable character.
Sincere Candour.
Radical Accountability.
Uncompromising Excellence.
Craft sits on top of that. We can teach craft. We cannot teach character, which is why your life experience counts here as much as your portfolio.

- Scope
- Partner with customer executive sponsors to scope FDE projects — translating ambiguous business problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI
- Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints to validate that every engagement is technically feasible
Deliver

- Own technical enablement and adoption: run hands-on training, build playbooks and reference workflows, and coach the customer's team until they're self-sufficient. Adoption is measured by what their users do without you in the room
- Monitor technical feasibility throughout delivery, adjusting scope with the sponsor when constraints emerge rather than letting engagements drift
- Identify and scope expansion opportunities as they surface during delivery, in partnership with the account team
- Escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions
- Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time
Own the executive relationship
- Establish and maintain the executive relationship on your engagements, serving as the primary point of contact from kickoff through handoff
- Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it
- Translate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions — for the sponsor and for the build team

- You understand agentic coding and LLMs well enough to hold your own with senior eng: how they behave in production, where they fail, and what a resilient workflow looks like (you don't need to be the person writing the production code)

- You have the executive presence to own the C-suite relationship and the technical credibility to earn trust with their eng leads
- Domain depth in FSI, insurance, telecom, high-tech, healthcare/life sciences, or semiconductor is a strong plus

jobs.ashbyhq.com/capsa/85cf7677-bc9a-4fa.description_excerpt:
The AI Operating System for Private Capital.
Capsa
Private capital funds have to find potential investments, research and analyse them thoroughly, monitor them over time, drive improvements, and decide when to buy and sell. They've got to see through the marketing. They've got to outbid the competition. And they've got to learn from every deal they do. Historically, these processes have run on people, we are building the AI Operating System that will run them in the future.
We're focused, ambitious, and obsessed with building a category-defining company. In the last 12 months we've grown ARR 15x, achieved product–market fit with leading multi-billion-dollar PE firms, and expanded across the US, UK, and Europe. Now we're doubling down: we've raised a large Series A from top-tier VC investors to scale the team. We're hiring hyper-talented people who want to work at the forefront of AI and revolutionise an industry.
At a glance
- Role: Senior Backend Engineer
- Location: London, UK (Hybrid, in-person 4 days per week)
- Team: Engineering
- Compensation: Top of market. Competitive base + OTE
The role
Own the systems behind an AI platform that the world's leading PE firms run their investment processes on. You'll design and build the backend that makes it all work: agentic workflows, document ingestion and search at scale, streaming execution, and the APIs and data models that power the product. You'll take features from ideation to production, measure their impact, and own them in operation.
The opportunity
- Ownership: You'll own whole systems end to end. You'll make the architecture calls, ship them, and operate them.
- Growth: You'll work across the entire stack, alongside a team of startup veterans, and take on real responsibility.
- Upside: You'll receive meaningful equity in a company that grew 15x last year.
- Impact: You'll leave an indelible mark on an industry responsible for ~7% of US GDP.
Recent projects include
- Agent Harness: Our own agent harness built on a custom, streaming-first graph execution framework.
- Code Execution Framework: Our own code execution framework that can be interrupted and resumed mid-execution for programmatic tool calling.
- Document Ingestion, Indexing, and Search: A VLM-based OCR pipeline, a self-hosted search cluster, and domain-aware search strategies.
- Citations: An end-to-end approach to citation, enabling users to quickly review supporting documentation for any AI generated statement.
- Document Authoring: Agent tooling and a document editor supporting advanced collaborative authoring across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email.
Track record
- You’ve worked in a high performance environment. Five or more years building production backend systems at a venture-backed startup or top tech firm, owning services and systems end-to-end.
- You've shipped things that mattered. Distributed systems, data pipelines, or platform services taken from design to production at scale, with impact you can speak to.
- Expertise with our stack. Python, FastAPI, Postgres, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Kafka, LLMs, Agents.
- Domain curiosity. You go deep on the problem. You care about what the product does for the person using it, and that shows in how you build.
- Comfortable at pace. Fast-moving environments are where you do your best work.
How you operate
- Accountable: You take responsibility for what you build and make sure it has a positive impact on our customers and the team.
- Thoughtful: You think deeply about the problems you're solving and the code you're submitting. You use AI to enhance your thinking, not to outsource it.
- Pragmatic: You accept that time is limited and information is incomplete. You make progress regardless, and adjust as we learn more.
If this opportunity excites you
We'd like to meet you. Initial conversations are direct and substantive, going deep on the work, the team, and what you'd own in the first six months.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
Capsa is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. jobs.ashbyhq.com/duvo/e2156092-50f1-4181.description_excerpt:
Forward Deployed Engineer
About the role
FDEs are how Duvo brings AI to life inside our customers. You sit at the front line, map their workflows on the Duvo platform, improve the underlying processes, and turn the result into running agents that deliver tangible business impact. Scoping, build, debug, handover, expansion. You own the customer outcome end to end and you own the relationship that goes with it.
You won't write the core product. You will write the glue: integration scripts, agent configurations, data transformations, prototypes, whatever it takes to get an agent running against a customer's actual systems. You'll spend real time inside their stack and inside their team.
If you like the messy middle between AI, process, and customer, this is the role.
You will be deployed directly with our clients, mostly in onsite/hybrid mode of work, you will travel a lot.
Location. This role is UK-based. You'll need to be living in the UK, or relocating there before you start, and able to travel to client sites from there.
What you'll do
- Embed with customers from kickoff through go-live and beyond
- Map customer workflows directly on the Duvo platform and decide what's worth automating, what's worth fixing first, and what's blocked
- Improve the underlying processes where it matters. Don't automate broken flows, redesign them
- Translate business logic into agent behavior: actions, decision rules, exception paths, fallbacks
- Configure and ship agents against real customer systems (ERPs, portals, spreadsheets, email, custom tools)
- Write integration code, scripts, and prototypes when the situation calls for it
- Debug live agents in production environments and iterate quickly
- Build and own the working relationship with customer stakeholders, from operators to sponsors
- Run working sessions, hold your own with technical counterparts, and earn the right to push back
- Make AI real for the customer. Move them from pilot energy to measurable business outcomes
- Capture reusable patterns, templates, and runbooks so the next deployment is faster
- Send recurring workflow patterns back to Product and Engineering as real signal
What success looks like
- Multiple agents in production across clients, with measurable business impact
- Customers point to specific KPIs that moved because of your work
- Customers treat you as a trusted operator and want you in the room
- Process improvements you drove are visible in the customer's day-to-day, not just in the agent
- Transformation Managers want you on their hardest accounts
- Accounts you own expand because the relationship and the results are both there
- Each deployment is faster than the last because you've left behind reusable assets
Who you are
Experience
5+ years in roles where you've shipped against real customer environments. We're prioritizing AI-native candidates: people who have been building, deploying, or operating AI and agentic systems in customer-facing settings, not adjacent to them.
Likely backgrounds:
- Forward-deployed engineering or solutions engineering at an AI-first company
- Applied AI / ML engineering with direct customer exposure
- Technical consulting on AI or automation projects where you owned delivery and the client relationship
- Operations or product roles where you've built and shipped AI-powered tooling against messy real-world systems
Retail, e-commerce, or CPG background is a strong plus. Fluency in any operational domain (supply chain, procurement, category management, merchandising, finance ops, supplier management, warehousing) helps you ramp faster on customer accounts. What matters most is that you can pick up a new business quickly, see how to improve it, and build something with AI that actually works.
Skills
- Hands-on with modern AI tooling: LLMs, agent frameworks, prompt engineering, evals, MCP, retrieval
- Strong systems thinking and engineering judgment
- Process design instinct. You can spot waste, redundancy, and bad handoffs and propose something better
- Comfortable in code-adjacent territory: SQL, Python or JS scripting, APIs, JSON, webhooks, light data work
- Familiarity with ERPs and enterprise stacks is a plus
- Able to lead a working session, manage a stakeholder, push back on bad scope, and explain trade-offs without hiding behind jargon
- Fluent English. Additional European languages are a plus
Mindset
- Bias to ship
- Comfortable with ambiguity, half-built systems, and changing requirements
- Low ego, high standards
- Customer-obsessed. You build trust by being useful, not by being polished
- Commercially aware and able to help customers believe in what you're building
- Honest about what's working and what isn't
What we offer
- A small, sharp team that values ownership and candor
- Real product and culture leverage from day one
- Customer-facing impact: your work ships and moves the business
- Competitive comp including equity
- Option to trade cash for equity
HOW WE HIRE
We respect your time and aim to move fast:
1. Screening call.
2. Hiring Manager call (online, 30 min). We'll talk about you, how you think and whether there's mutual fit.
3. Case study ( ~4 hours). Ship something small to production with us and see how we work together. Fully compensated
4. Final interview (online, 30min)
We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who can walk into a customer's operation, figure out what matters, fix the process, ship the agent, and turn AI into outcomes the business can feel.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/duvo/4774da6e-473c-423b.description_excerpt:
ABOUT DUVO
Before Duvo, our founders built and ran a $2 billion retailer. They saw how much critical work still depended on spreadsheets, inboxes, supplier portals and the memory of experienced operators. The real process rarely lived in one system. People held the last mile together.
Duvo is building the Enterprise Execution OS: the shared layer that understands how work really runs, carries it across existing systems and measures the business result.
Our agents do the work, not just suggest the next step. They gather evidence, make decisions within agreed rules, route exceptions to the right person and update the source system. People keep control wherever judgment or approval is needed. Every action leaves an audit trail.
We start with one recurring process and a clear outcome.
THE ROLE
As a Transformation Strategist, you will own the day-to-day momentum of an enterprise transformation.
You will partner with a Senior Transformation Strategist and Forward Deployed Engineers on a small number of live enterprise accounts. You will be the person who is consistently present with the customer: close to how work happens, accountable for the workstream cadence and able to turn a senior steer into analysis, decisions, materials and change that move the work forward.
The Senior Transformation Strategist owns the executive relationship, overall transformation direction and commercial outcome. You own the operating rhythm and quality of execution, escalating early when a senior decision or intervention is required.
This is a hands-on consulting role for someone early enough in their career to enjoy getting deep into the work, but strong enough to earn trust in a customer room. We are particularly interested in people currently operating from Consultant/Associate through Project Leader/Engagement Manager level at McKinsey, BCG or Bain, typically with around 3–5 years of client-facing consulting experience. You do not need prior operator experience.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
1. OWN THE WORKSTREAM FACT BASE
Get close to the process: interviews, data, handoffs, exceptions and the workarounds people use to keep things running. Build a fact base that shows where cost, cash, service, cycle time or control is being lost.
Turn that work into sharp analyses, decision documents and slides that make the important choices obvious. Be exact about the baseline, assumptions and evidence; do not use presentation polish to hide uncertainty. The materials are a means to a decision and an action, not the output in themselves.
2. RUN THE DAY-TO-DAY DELIVERY RHYTHM
Work with the Senior Transformation Strategist to turn a diagnostic into a practical roadmap: what starts now, what waits, which decisions an agent can make, which controls stay and who needs to own each step.
Run the weekly operating cadence with customer teams: prepare working sessions, maintain actions and decisions, follow commitments through and surface blockers early. Make sure the new process is clear enough for people to use. Work side by side with Forward Deployed Engineers as the solution moves into the live operation, keeping business needs, technical delivery and customer adoption joined up.
3. BUILD THE EVIDENCE FOR IMPACT
Help lock the baseline, target and measurement window before implementation. Track progress, investigate misses and turn the result into evidence a CFO and an operating team can trust.
You will not be asked to own commercial negotiations or the most senior stakeholder relationship alone. You will be expected to build the analysis, materials and follow-through that make those conversations productive—and to own relationships with the customer team at the working level.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
We are looking for a capable, client-facing consultant who wants to do more than recommend a change. We will assess five things:
- Strong consulting foundations. You are currently operating from Consultant/Associate through Project Leader/Engagement Manager level at McKinsey, BCG or Bain, typically with around 3–5 years of core, client-facing consulting experience. You can structure an unfamiliar problem, find the critical question and make a clear recommendation.
- Excellent analytical and communication craft. You are comfortable working from messy data and incomplete information. You build analyses and slides that are concise, numerate and decision-ready.
- Bias for delivery and ownership. You want to stay close to the work after the deck is finished. You can run a reliable customer cadence, follow through on actions, notice what is not working and help fix it.
- Customer judgment. You can listen well, ask a direct question and communicate clearly with people at different levels of an organisation. You know when to ask for help rather than bluff.
- Early-stage working style. You work well without a large team or a polished playbook. You use AI seriously in your own work, write clearly and take responsibility for the quality of what you put in front of a customer.
Early-stage company experience is helpful, whether through a role, internship, founding project or close work with a startup. It is not required. Experience in retail, CPG, supply chain, logistics, inventory or finance operations is also helpful, but not required.
WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE AFTER 12 MONTHS
- You are the trusted day-to-day owner of defined workstreams across several enterprise accounts, with a clear view of each account’s transformation hypothesis, evidence base, risks and next decision.
- Your analyses and customer materials help teams make better decisions quickly, and your cadence means commitments do not disappear between meetings.
- You have helped take at least one process from diagnosis through live delivery, with a measured view of whether it is working.
- You have made Duvo’s playbook more reusable through better templates, diagnostics, measurement methods or delivery habits.
THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF
- You only enjoy the framing phase and lose interest once the work becomes detailed.
- You need perfectly clean data, a large analyst team or complete instructions before you can make progress.
- You see slides as the final product rather than a tool to help a customer make and execute a decision.
- You want only internal analysis work and do not want visible, day-to-day accountability with a customer team.
- You prefer to stay far from the day-to-day work of the people whose process is changing.
- You want a narrow role with little customer exposure or visible accountability.
HOW WE WORK
- Own it. The bar is not “I flagged it.” It is “I moved it forward.” An 80% fix today often beats a perfect answer next week.
- Stay close to the customer. Know their real day better than the process document. If they ask us to automate something broken, show them a better way.
- Prove it and say it straight. Measure before you propose. Share bad news when you have it. Strong opinions are welcome; defending them after the evidence changes is not.
- Use AI and work…

About Foundation Health
Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.
We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.
THE MISSION: FIXING HEALTHCARE WITH CODE
Healthcare is full of complex, frustrating workflows that haven’t changed in decades. We believe that thoughtfully applied AI can finally simplify these systems, improving both the provider's workday and the patient's experience.
Specifically, we are revolutionizing the pharmacy space. We’re led by a technical leadership team with deep roots in high-scale engineering, including our VP of Engineering (ex-DeepMind/Google). Together, we’re fostering an "AI-native" culture where we don’t just build AI; we use it.
We want engineers who lean on AI tools to maximize their output and automate the mundane parts of their day-to-day work. We’re creating an environment where using the latest tools isn't just allowed - it’s encouraged and championed by leadership.
LOCATION & CULTURE
We have an office in Manchester City Centre, and while we aren't a "mandatory X days in the office" company, we believe in the power of getting together. We’re looking for engineers who are excited to head into Manchester when needed to whiteboard, jam on ideas, and build rapport in person.
WHY YOU’D LEAVE YOUR CURRENT ROLE
- The AI Playground: You’ll get hands-on with OpenAI, Langfuse, and Vertex AI to ship real-world features. We aren't just "researching" AI; we are shipping it into production environments where it actually impacts patient care.
- True Feature Ownership: You won’t just be handed well-scoped tickets. You will own full features end-to-end, driving them from initial ambiguity and architectural design all the way to production.
- Influence the Technical Direction: As an early senior hire, you will have a direct seat at the table. You will collaborate closely with our VP of Engineering to shape our technical stack, establish engineering standards, and influence the product roadmap.
- Pure Product Engineering: We are looking for people who thrive when the path isn't fully paved. If you love the feeling of architecting a feature, shipping it, and seeing it in a customer's hands 48 hours later, you’ll fit in.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
We are about to hire the people who will define the next phase of this company. Not backfill a plan someone else wrote — define it. The quality of who joins Dust over the next eighteen months is the single highest-leverage variable in whether we build the category or watch someone else do it.
That work needs a recruiter who treats hiring as a craft rather than a queue. Someone who can hold a real point of view on what "great" looks like for a role, defend it with a hiring manager who disagrees, and then go find that person themselves — from a cold start, without a lead gen team, a sourcing pod, or a playbook waiting for them.
You'll be an early member of a small Talent team. That means you own roles end to end, and you also help build the thing itself: the assessment design, the interview loops, the calibration, the data we use to know whether any of it is working.
We're looking for someone who cares about the candidate experience for all parties internal and external. And prioritizes protecting Dust's culture by being thoughtful, thorough and leading by example in being a true team player.
WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Full-cycle hiring, end to end. You run your own searches from role kickoff to close. Sourcing, outreach, screening, interviewing, offer strategy, negotiation. You are the owner of the outcome, not a coordinator of other people's opinions.
Assessment design, not just assessment delivery. For every role you open, you help define what evidence would actually predict success — then you build the loop that surfaces it. You'll push back on interview stages that exist out of habit and replace them with ones that test something real.
Hiring manager partnership with a spine. You'll spend as much time calibrating hiring managers as you do talking to candidates. When a manager says "not quite the right feel," you'll ask what they mean until there's a defensible answer, and you'll say so when there isn't one.
Market intelligence. You'll know your talent market better than anyone else in the building — who's good, where they are, what moves them, what compensation actually looks like right now — and you'll bring that back into how we scope roles and design offers.
The candidate experience. Our hiring process is the first honest sample of what working here feels like. You'll make it expedient, direct, well-communicated, and worth a candidate's time whether or not they get an offer.
Building the function. Process, tooling, structured scorecards, funnel data, quality-of-hire signal. You'll leave the system better than you found it, and you'll be trusted to change it without asking permission first.
TWO TRACKS — TELL US WHICH ONE IS YOURS
We're hiring for depth in one of two areas. You should have a genuine centre of gravity in one; interest in the other is a bonus, not a requirement.
GTM. Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Marketing, and the leaders above them, across Europe and the US. You know how to assess commercial talent on evidence rather than swagger, and you can tell the difference between a rep who carried a territory and a rep who inherited one.
Technical. Software engineers, infrastructure, product, and design, in a market where the best people are not looking and the second-best are drowning in outreach. You can hold a credible conversation about what someone actually built, and you know why that matters more than where they built it.
HOW WE THINK ABOUT HIRING
We're telling you this up front because if you disagree with it, this will be a frustrating job.
- We don't hire based on pedigree. Logos and school names are weak evidence. What someone has actually done, and what they can demonstrate now, is strong evidence. We design our loops accordingly.
- We hire for evidence, not affinity. "Culture fit" that means "reminds me of me" is how companies get homogeneous and slow. We assess against explicit behaviours tied to how we work, and we write down what we saw.
- Speed and rigour are not in tension. Slow processes are usually a symptom of unclear thinking about the role, not of high standards.
- A no should be as clear as a yes. To the candidate, and internally.
- Some of us came from well-known companies. That's context, not criteria. It isn't why we're here and it won't be why you are. We celebrate everyone's achievements and want to create an environment where diversity of thought and experience of a collective whole makes this place exceptional and lasting.
- Recruiters are operators, not order-takers. If you think a role is wrongly scoped, badly levelled, or shouldn't be open at all, you're expected to say so.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- 5+ years in full-cycle recruiting, with meaningful time in-house at a high-growth company. You've hired in an environment with real ambiguity, not just real volume.
- Demonstrable depth in either GTM or technical hiring — you can talk through searches you've run, what made them hard, and what you'd do differently.
- Genuinely strong sourcing. Not "I partner with a sourcing team." You find people yourself, and you write outreach that people reply to because it's obviously written by a human who read something.
- Comfort operating without infrastructure. No playbook, no SDR equivalent, limited tooling to start.
- The judgement and directness to challenge senior stakeholders, and the credibility to be listened to when you do.
- A bias to start. You see the gap and close it before anyone asks you to.
- Excellent written English and a real feel for language. Everything you write is a piece of our employer brand.
- Low ego, high ownership. No job is too big or too small — you'll design an assessment framework in the morning and chase a scheduling conflict in the afternoon.
- Based in Paris, London or New York.
Ideal, but not…

OWN OUTBOUND PIPELINE GENERATION

DRIVE EVENT PRESENCE AND FOLLOW-UP
- Represent Dust at UK-based events and convert conversations into pipeline
- Own follow-up from events with speed and precision — no leads left to go cold
- Feed event insights back into outbound messaging
SUPPORT AES AND HELP CLOSE THE LOOP
- Partner with AEs on follow-up for warm conversations that need a nudge
- Help keep deals moving in the early stages without taking over the sales cycle
- Be the connective tissue between early interest and a qualified meeting
BUILD MARKET AND PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE
- Develop genuine fluency in Dust's product and how it maps to UK buyer problems
- Stay close to what's happening in the UK AI and enterprise software landscape
- Use that knowledge to personalise outreach and earn credibility with buyers fast
ITERATE AND IMPROVE THE PLAYBOOK
- Track what's working and what isn't — bring data and hypotheses, not just activity
- Contribute to a BDR playbook that doesn't exist yet; you're building it

- You give and receive direct feedback, and you're honest about what's working and what isn't
- You're scrappy — you find a way when the playbook doesn't exist, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to perform
- You show up prepared, energised, and ready to represent Dust well in every interaction with a prospect
AGENCY
- You don't wait for a territory or a sequence to be handed to you — you build your own approach and take ownership of the UK market from day one
- You're on track to be an AE and you act like it — you understand the full sales motion and you're already thinking about what comes after the meeting is booked
- You iterate on your messaging independently: you test, analyse, and improve without being asked
- You spot gaps in coverage — an untouched segment, a weak follow-up cadence, a missed event — and you act on them before anyone else notices
- You treat 30 meetings/month as a floor, not a ceiling

- You have deep hands-on experience building and shipping AI models - not just fine-tuning, but understanding what's under the hood
- You've worked on problems that are genuinely hard - real-time processing, speech, translation, or low-latency inference would be a strong signal

- You can work independently at a senior level while staying closely aligned with a small, fast-moving team
Compensation
- Salary: a competitive salary, benchmarked to the role and your experience. We're happy to discuss specifics early on.
- Equity: meaningful equity as an early employee.
- Pension: workplace pension with employer contributions.

- 🗓️ All the boring stuff everywhere else provides - 25 days off, pension, the lot.

- 🎛️ You shape your own environment. Lighting, a desk away from the noise, headphones, a setup that works for you. Just ask.
- ⏱️ Flexible hours around a small set of shared core hours, plus focus time we actually protect, so you can work when you think best.

- 🧭 A clear first-month plan and someone you can ask anything, so you're never left guessing what's expected.
- 🤝 A team that takes the mission seriously, but not itself - we love socials, passion, and building something we believe in.
- ✨ Benefits are still being shaped - tell us what would make a real difference to your quality of life, and we'll consider it. We mean that.
