We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.
THE ROLE
We are hiring a Product Psychologist to sit inside our machine learning team to elaborate on and help further build processes that answer: what does a great Ash conversation look like, and how do you measure it?
Reporting to our Clinical R&D Lead and partnering closely our ML conversation team lead, you'll own the definition of quality for Ash's conversations and turn it into something the ML team can train and evaluate against through benchmarks, evals, and a distributed team of expert human reviewers.
We think optimizing for clinical protocols is the wrong lever. We believe the core driver of outcomes in mental health support, AI or human, is more amorphous: the things that set individual practitioners, rather than individual practices, apart. This role exists to build a science of that belief into something iterable.
This is not a role about designing conversations turn-by-turn. Ash is more grown than built. It's not a management role, though you'll coach a growing team of reviewers. And it's not a research role in the traditional sense. While you'll draw heavily on the literature, your aim is product outcomes, not papers published (though some of your work may become a paper in collaboration with our research team).
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
- Own the definition of "great" for Ash conversations, and make it measurable.
- Make hypothesis-driven calls on how Ash should behave, globally and in specific situations. Change your mind quickly and openly when the evidence tells you to.
- Partner with the Safety team to define Ash's constraints and how it should handle difficult edge-case conversations.
- Recruit, scale, and coach a distributed team of human reviewers: set the bar, teach people what "great" looks like, and keep the group calibrated with each other.
- Be a source of clarity for the conversation and ML teams when the path forward is ambiguous.
ABOUT YOU
- You have a PhD in Clinical or Counseling Psychology, or related field, or a license-eligible Masters degree with clinical training and supervision
- You’re an experienced clinician with a history of working with systems, technological and otherwise, to scale up engaging and effective health products
- You have deep, hands-on experience with interpersonal skills. You can personally facilitate emotional expression well, and you can also see it in someone else's work: flexibility, warmth, honesty, confidence, and attunement, not just credentials.
- You're pragmatic and decisive under real uncertainty. You can make a call with incomplete information, defend it, and drop it fast when new evidence shows up.
- You're oriented toward the user, not toward an external clinical ideal. You won't push an agenda that matters more to you than it does to the people using the product.
- You've worked on measurement before, ideally in digital mental health, and you know how to build a rating system and keep a team of raters calibrated.
- You have some comfort operating close to an ML team. You don't need to train the models, but you should be curious about how evals and benchmarks actually get used to change model behavior.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/slingshotai/029c1d63-71.description_excerpt:
Slingshot AI
Slingshot AI is the team behind Ash, the first AI designed for mental health. Our mission is to make support more accessible and help people change their lives in the ways they want.
We’re building a world-class team by empowering individuals with the autonomy, flexibility, and support they need to do their best work. We dream big, iterate fast, and care deeply. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.
Our team spans machine learning, product, engineering, conversational design, clinical, growth, and operations, with offices in both New York City and London.
We're a well-funded Series A company, having raised $93M from Andreessen Horowitz, Radical Ventures, Forerunner Ventures, plus top-tier tech investors involved in ElevenLabs, Captions, Shopify, Plaid, Notion, Canva, Twitch, Airtable, and many others.
The Role
Ash is a wellness app that gives people a place to talk through stress, anxiety, relationships or a bad day. It isn’t a replacement for therapy. People find it useful for everyday issues.
People bring deeply personal things to Ash, so new safety questions come up all the time, from user conversations, customer support, researchers and partners. We build our safety policy from what’s actually happening with our users and keep adding to it. We’re hiring someone to own this work full time: researching each issue, getting input from the right experts and deciding what Ash should do.
Safety work at Slingshot runs across teams. You’ll report to our General Counsel, who leads our regulatory work, and work closely with our machine learning, engineering, clinical and research teams to put our policies into practice.
Key responsibilities
- Build and grow our policy book. Take each new issue and turn it into a clear working policy. Pull together the relevant regulation, professional guidance, clinical practice, ethics and research, then make a reasoned judgment call.
- Bring in the right experts. Work with lawyers, psychiatrists, psychologists, therapists, philosophers and researchers, including our own clinical and research team and our advisors, and use their input to make practical decisions.
- Work through hard trade-offs. Many safety questions pose conflicting goals, such as protecting other people against a user’s privacy, or steering someone toward a safer choice against respecting their autonomy. Help decide where we come down and set the process for making those calls.
- Turn ambiguous issues into clear decisions. Investigate user reports, emerging risks and new requirements. Establish what we know, what remains uncertain and what we should do next.
- Set priorities. Help the team decide which safety issues to tackle first, and give the people building safety features clear answers.
- Turn policy into how Ash behaves. Each policy defines when it applies and what Ash should and shouldn’t do. Policies will feed directly into model training and into the guardrails, safe modes and banners that shape Ash’s responses, so they need to be clear and concrete, with examples of good and bad responses.
- Make the response work in practice. Build clear processes for triage, investigation, escalation and follow-through. Define who does what, create the tools and documentation they need, and handle the operational details yourself.
- Turn learning into product improvements. Work with engineering, machine learning, clinical and legal colleagues to translate findings into changes to Ash and the systems around it.
- Build, test and improve quickly. For new systems, put a useful first version in place, learn from real cases and refine it. Match the pace and level of review to the consequences of the decision.
- Keep policy in step with the law. Work with our General Counsel to update our policies and practices as new laws and requirements come in.
- Write clearly, internally and externally. Produce policies, practical guidance and public explanations of our safety approach, and help communicate our findings, including their limitations. Over time, build initiatives or benchmarks we can share to help the industry do better.
- Represent our thinking. Explain and defend our approach with partners, clinicians and other audiences. Engage seriously with criticism and bring what you learn back into the work.
About you
- You understand AI. You know how people talk to AI, what might go wrong, and what controls a company does and doesn’t have (and should build). You don’t need to be a programmer. You might come from law, bioethics, philosophy, medicine, psychology, product management, engineering or another field.
- You enjoy writing policy. You like pulling together many sources, from research and regulation to expert opinion, and deciding what our position should be.
- You’ve worked professionally, ideally at a startup, where people build and do things, sometimes without a lot of guidance.
- You have strong judgment. You can reason through a difficult question, weigh competing considerations and reach a decision without pretending every answer is certain.
- You’re open-minded. You don’t assume you already know the answers, and you can describe a time when evidence changed your approach.
- You can handle a lot at once. You’ll work on many problems with many inputs, often at the same time.
- You learn fast and seek input. You can get up to speed on an unfamiliar subject quickly. Your instinct is to get input from others before deciding, and then you make the call.
- You’re an excellent researcher, writer and communicator. You use AI research tools well, and you can write clearly about complex questions, whether for a policy document or a public audience. You present well.
- You’ve built something and made it better. It could be a product, an operational process, a program or an independent project. You can show how you moved from an unclear problem to something people used, then improved it through feedback.
- You’re resourceful and hands-on. You’re willing to investigate individual cases, coordinate people, write the checklist and follow up until the work is done.
- You handle sensitive information with care and stay thoughtful under pressure.
- You care about people’s mental health and want more people to have access to good support.
What we offer:
- A chance to join a passionate tight-knit team working on something to change the world
- Competitive compensation (top of personal market)
- Travel between our NYC / London offices
- Usual startup perks like free lunch and coffee in office + generous learning budget
- We cover your personal therapy

jobs.ashbyhq.com/epistemix/5577f373-38c4.description_excerpt:
Our software engineers at Epistemix show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. You are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter.

ABOUT EPISTEMIX
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. - From initial requirements gathering to deployment and ongoing maintenance, take full ownership of the software development lifecycle, ensuring seamless delivery and operation.
- Design, build, test and deploy a highly scalable and resilient system architecture that supports current needs and future growth.
- Define the technical direction for engineering solutions, actively collaborating with internal teams to ensure technological advancements are perfectly aligned with the company's strategic goals.

- Demonstrated experience or strong understanding of data science orchestration platforms, such as Prefect.io http://Prefect.io.
- Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including advanced querying, optimization, and data modeling.
- Experience with API design principles (RESTful, GraphQL) and security best practices (OAuth2, JWT).
- Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, asynchronous processing, and message queues.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, agile environment.
WHY JOIN EPISTEMIX?
By joining Epistemix, you will become part of a collaborative and rapidly growing team that values curiosity and creativity. We are fully remote, with team members in the United States and Europe. Benefits include:

About Antithesis
We've been quietly reinventing how the world thinks about software reliability, and we're just getting started! At Antithesis, we start at the foundations – we run entire software systems inside a deterministic simulation and break them in every way imaginable. Every issue then comes with a perfect reproduction, so you can identify root causes fast instead of spending days trying to recreate what went wrong.
The rise of AI-generated code has made this work more urgent than ever. Agents can write code faster than any human, but speed doesn't matter much when the output is buggy, stuck in review, or slipping through undetected. The verification bottleneck is real, it's growing, and solving it is one of the most consequential problems in software right now. That's what you'd be working on.
We're well-funded and deeply technical, the kind of place where the hardest problems get the most attention and the best ideas win regardless of who has them. If you want to do work that actually moves the needle on how reliable software can be, keep reading.
About the Role
We're looking for engineers in the Senior to Staff levels to build the future of autonomous testing. No matter your particular field of experience, if you've been ambitiously building complex software and think you could be a fit; drop us a note.
In this role you will be part of the team that maintains our open-source project Bombadil (https://github.com/antithesishq/bombadil). This includes working with the specification language and verifier, Chromium automation, advanced property-based testing, frontend development, and much more.
Must have for this role:
- Proficient in Rust development
- Experience with property-based testing or fuzzing
- Comfortable with web technology (browsers, HTTP, HTML, Javascript, CSS)
Experience that would be a plus:
- Chrome Devtools Protocol, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium
- Formal specification languages (e.g. TLA+ or some LTL)
- Implementing parsers, type systems, and interpreters
About Our Team
Our team spans CS degrees, philosophy, mathematics, and everything in between, or nothing formal at all. What everyone shares is a high bar for engineering quality. We work in-person because it's how we build trust and tackle hard problems together.
Location: This position is full time in the office in London, UK.

- You’ve done multiple rodeos. You’ve worked fraud at more than one fintech or high-velocity regulated platform across the UK, EU or US. That could be a neobank, payments company, gambling operator, gaming platform or crypto exchange. You know how attacks, rails and rules differ in each.
- You’ve built controls from scratch. At a B2C fintech, you built fraud controls that didn’t exist before, while protecting consumer money at scale.
- You’ve worked the floor. You started as an investigator and worked alerts and cases by hand. You spot a pattern before it shows on a dashboard.
- You’ve been baptised by fire. You’ve handled a real fraud attack or loss spike and made fast calls under pressure. You stayed on it until the fix held, and learned from every case.
- You own the approach. You decide how to tackle a problem and see it through end to end, without waiting to be told.
- You see every launch as a new door. You map where fraud can get in before go-live, not after the first losses land.
- You protect good customers too. You stop fraud without adding friction for the people we serve, and you can show the numbers behind it.
Most importantly, you’d rather build the right controls once, on our own decisioning platform, than tune vendor defaults forever.
WHAT YOU’LL OWN
This is a role with a mandate across every rail, product and geo we operate in.
- See the exposure, everywhere. Map where fraud can hit us on every rail, product and geo, and own the observability layer that lets us watch it live.
- Build rules that hold. Stand up rule building and governance on our decisioning platform, with every change back-tested before it ships.
- Tier exposure by risk. Design progressive access to payment rails by risk tier, so trusted customers move freely and limits grow with trust.
- Measure every trade-off. Track each control change in fraud caught against friction added, and retire the rules that no longer earn their place.
- Protect customers in the moment. Put vulnerable-customer education and in-the-moment verification on every rail, without slowing good customers down.
- Launch with controls from day one. Make sure every new product, geo or rail has a signed-off exposure map before it goes live.
Your calls will shape how fast Aspora can open new corridors, and how safely customers move money once we’re there.
WHY ASPORA
- Define how Aspora detects and deters fraud across every rail and geo, and set the playbook every launch follows.
- Work directly with our Head of Financial Crime, and partner with Product, Payments and Engineering on every launch.
- Build controls on our own decisioning platform, across high-volume cross-border flows at significant scale.
- Own fraud strategy from day one, from exposure mapping through to customer protection.
- Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora’s long-term vision.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.
Are you up for the challenge?
Position Overview
As a Senior/Staff Software Engineer in the Model Enablement team, you will build our model enablement platform and decide how each model runs across the Metis or Europa AIPU, the host CPU and the host's accelerators. How this work is split and scheduled determines most of the end-to-end performance a customer sees in the Voyager SDK.
The role combines architecture and hands-on work across the model frontend, the graph compiler, the runtime and the application pipeline. During model bring-up, you cover the frontend and graph side, and a device-side engineer covers the backend.
Our team uses AI coding agents in daily work, and you will use them to build, test and verify your own work. We also welcome experienced field application engineers, technical leads and engineering managers who want to return to hands-on engineering. Experience in planning, delegating and reviewing work transfers well to working with AI agents.
Key responsibilities:
- Model enablement platform and agent harness: Build the platform that engineers and AI agents use to bring up models: reusable tools to partition, compile, run and profile; environments with access to real hardware; closed-loop runs that apply a change, measure it against the reference and repeat; and verification (differential testing, regression detection) integrated into CI.
- Model ingestion: Own how a PyTorch or ONNX model is captured, analysed and split across the AIPU's matrix and RISC-V vector units, the host CPU and the host's accelerators (GPU, NPU, video decoder), with placement tags that users can read and override. Build this with the graph compiler team so it works for every model.
- Heterogeneous execution: Extend that split to large models, cascades and multi-model pipelines, for example with expert offloading and caching across device and host memory. Agree the plan with the graph compiler team.
- End-to-end performance: With the application team (pipeline builder) and the runtime team, bring each model to its best end-to-end performance: overlap of host and device work, zero-copy buffers, batching, multi-core scheduling, and models with several inputs. Profile device time, host time and data movement, and confirm each speedup in the full pipeline.
- Critical models: Study the models that matter most to customers, on Metis today and on Europa, and turn each lesson into a platform improvement.
Qualifications:
Essential
- 8+ years of engineering experience in systems, compilers, runtimes or performance, including system-level design ownership.
- Hands-on experience with heterogeneous computing across CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU or FPGA, including reasoning about compute, memory bandwidth, latency and data movement.
- Solid fundamentals in computer architecture, operating systems and parallel programming.
- Familiarity with ML graph representations and compiler concepts: graph capture (torch.export, FX, ONNX), lowering, operator fusion, partitioning, memory planning.
- Strong C++ and Python.
- Daily use of AI coding agents on real engineering work, with the judgment to review and test their output.
Preferred
- Hands-on experience with MLIR or another compiler framework (TVM, XLA, TorchInductor, IREE).
- Experience with an inference runtime or execution engine (ONNX Runtime execution providers, a custom NPU or DSP runtime).
- Experience with GPU compute (CUDA, OpenCL, Vulkan) or SIMD optimization on Arm or x86.
- Experience with large-model execution techniques such as offloading, expert caching, speculative decoding, pipelining across devices.
- Experience building agent environments, evaluation harnesses or verification frameworks (differential testing, regression detection), or MCP-based tooling.
Location
We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to:
- Work from one of our Axelera AI offices (Leuven in Belgium, Amsterdam and Eindhoven in the Netherlands, Zurich in Switzerland, Florence and Milan in Italy or Bristol in the United Kingdom) if you're already based in the vicinity.
- Work fully remotely from any European country (incl. the UK) you are already in.
- Relocate with us and work from Italy (Florence or Milan) or the Netherlands (Amsterdam or Eindhoven).
Kindly note that priority will be given to candidates who are [interested in being] based in Belgium or Italy.
What we offer
This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.
An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team.
At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.
Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. If you have been approached by someone on our behalf and want to confirm it’s legitimate, please contact us directly at careers@axelera.ai.

About Aibidia
Aibidia is a fast-growing SaaS company transforming how multinational businesses manage transfer pricing. We're building intelligent, scalable software that simplifies complex tax and compliance processes, helping some of the world's largest organisations work more efficiently and confidently.
We're a team that values curiosity, ownership and pragmatic problem-solving. As we continue to evolve our products and embrace AI-native ways of working, we're looking for a Design Engineer to help shape the next generation of our platform.
The Role
We're looking for an AI-first Design Engineer who combines strong technical capabilities with a solid understanding of product design, UX and usability.
This is a hybrid role at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll work on complex, data-rich enterprise software, using modern AI tools to rapidly prototype, iterate and deliver intuitive product experiences.
We're not looking for someone who simply creates beautiful interfaces or follows traditional, lengthy design processes. We want someone who thinks systematically, understands how software is built and knows how to leverage AI to turn complex requirements into functional, user-friendly solutions.
You'll join a team that has already established an AI-first design system and modern ways of working. Rather than reinventing what's already in place, you'll build on these foundations, contributing to an evolving design system while helping us move towards faster, more iterative product development.
What You'll Do
Design, prototype and ship
- Translate complex business requirements and user needs into intuitive, functional product experiences.
- Rapidly prototype and iterate on new features using AI-powered tools, getting working solutions in front of users early.
- Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and domain experts to take ideas from concept through to implementation.
- Balance usability, technical feasibility and speed of delivery, knowing when to iterate and when a solution is good enough to ship.
- Design for complex, data-heavy workflows where clarity, efficiency and accuracy matter more than visual embellishment.
Build with an AI-first mindset
- Use AI tools such as Claude, Figma and MCP integrations as a core part of your design and development workflow.
- Experiment with emerging AI technologies, agents and workflows to continuously improve how we build products.
- Apply sound design and engineering judgement to AI-generated outputs, ensuring quality, usability and consistency.
Contribute to our design system
- Build on and contribute to our existing AI-first design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across the product.
- Understand and apply design system principles, including components, design tokens, spacing, layouts, accessibility and interaction patterns.
- Identify opportunities to improve components, documentation and AI-assisted design workflows.
Collaborate and validate
- Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to understand problems, validate ideas and gather feedback.
- Take a lean, iterative approach to product development, prioritising early validation over lengthy discovery cycles.
- Collaborate closely with Engineering to ensure designs are technically achievable and can be efficiently implemented.
- Continuously refine solutions based on user feedback, technical constraints and evolving business needs.
What We're Looking For
- A hybrid design and engineering background, with hands-on coding capabilities and a strong understanding of UX, UI and usability principles.
- Experience using modern AI tools as an integral part of your workflow, with a genuine interest in AI-assisted design, prototyping and development.
- Strong systems thinking, with an understanding of how scalable design systems, reusable components and technical frameworks work together.
- Experience contributing to design systems, with knowledge of design tokens, component libraries, accessibility and established UI patterns.
- Experience working directly with codebases, GitHub and modern frontend technologies, rather than operating solely within traditional design tools.
- Experience designing or building complex, data-dense B2B SaaS, enterprise or workflow-driven products.
- Experience working in a startup or scaleup environment, where priorities evolve, teams are lean and speed of execution matters.
- Strong product judgement and the ability to balance user needs, business requirements and technical constraints.
- A curious, adaptable mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with emerging technologies and new ways of working.
Nice to Have
- Experience in fintech, tax technology, compliance or other complex, regulated industries.
- Exposure to both early-stage startups and larger, more established software organisations.
Why Join Aibidia?
- Build the future of AI-first product development: Help shape how AI is embedded into the way we design, prototype and ship software.
- Solve genuinely complex problems: Work on sophisticated enterprise software where thoughtful design and usability have a meaningful impact.
- Make an impact: Join a lean, collaborative team where your ideas, technical judgement and contributions directly influence the product.
- Work with modern tools: Experiment with emerging AI technologies and continuously improve how products are built.
- Grow with us: Be part of a scaling international SaaS business that's challenging traditional approaches to tax technology.

- 💰 Share in Aibidia’s success – Enjoy a competitive compensation and incentive package that rewards your contribution.
- 🏡 Flexible, hybrid working – Flexible working hours and a hybrid policy designed to support how you work best.
- 🩺 Comprehensive healthcare – A healthcare package to support you and your wellbeing.
- 💚 Wellbeing that matters – A genuine focus on physical and mental wellbeing, supported by our internal Health & Wellbeing Committee.
- 🎉 Time to celebrate together – Regular team socials, including our much-loved summer and winter parties.
- 💻 The best tools for the job – Access to the latest technology to help you do your best work.
- 🚀 Invest in your growth – Performance-based development is part of our culture, with a dedicated learning budget for every employee.
- 🌍 Make an impact globally – Join a fast-growing global SaaS company using technology to transform a traditionally complex industry.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/benchling/ef652ae4-88a5.description_excerpt:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.
When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.
Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.
We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Head of Professional Services, EMEA is responsible for the growth and excellence of the professional services team in Europe. This individual will oversee an organization responsible for driving successful Benchling deployments, ensuring customer satisfaction, and maximizing the value clients derive from the company’s products. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution to align services with business objectives and client needs.
This role is instrumental in partnering across the entire Customer Experience organization as well as the broader Sales teams to further Benchling’s growth. This role needs to draw on an innovative vision based on best-in-class enterprise software implementation practices, with a focus on results and high standards. This is a demanding yet rewarding role that will allow the right individual to make a significant impact within our growing company and in the life sciences industry.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Delivery Leadership
- Own end-to-end delivery quality, timeline, and performance across EMEA Professional Services engagements
- Partner globally to set and enforce delivery standards for complex, validated, and regulated environments
- Serve as an escalation point for at-risk engagements, partnering with Customer Success and Support to resolve cross-functional customer issues
- Team & Org Building
- Lead, grow, and retain a distributed team across Europe, with a focus in Zurich and London/Cambridge
- Ensure that the team structure and incentive models hit utilization targets but also long-term relationship investments
- Build a strong bench through hiring, onboarding, and career pathing for implementation consultants and specialists
- Lead and develop managers to excellence
- Partner & Ecosystem Management
- Manage relationships with systems integrator and delivery partners supporting EMEA capacity, including performance oversight and quality accountability
- Determine where partner delivery capacity should be used vs. built in-house, and manage the transition points between the two
- Commercial Ownership
- Own SOW scoping, staffing forecasts, and financial performance for the EMEA PS book of business
- Partner with Sales on deal structuring for new implementations, expansions, and renewals with a services component
- Provide accurate capacity and revenue forecasting to leadership
- Customer & Executive Engagement
- Represent Professional Services in executive business reviews with enterprise pharma and biotech clients
- Build trusted relationships with technical and scientific stakeholders at customer organizations
- Champion the adoption of AI delivery practices within the PS team and with customers
QUALIFICATIONS
- 8+ years in professional services, implementation, or delivery leadership roles within enterprise software; life sciences, pharma, biotech, or scientific software strongly preferred.
- Ability to develop fluency with Biotech R&D processes and scientific concepts. Must be able to confidently interface and build trust with VP and C-Level Scientific & Research IT leaders in top Biotech and Pharma companies.
- Background developing a team that has proven technical, business or scientific, and consulting skills for delivery success.
- Proven experience leading distributed teams across multiple European countries, including navigating differing labor environments and travel/delivery cadences.
- Experience leading and developing a strong set of managers that own delivery quality and execution, as a second line leader.
- Direct experience managing delivery through third-party systems integrator partners, including holding partners accountable for quality.
- Strong commercial acumen: comfort owning SOW economics, margin, and forecasting
- Executive presence with technical and scientific buyers; ability to run high-stakes EBRs and escalations.
- Fluency in English required; additional European languages (German, French) a strong plus given the DACH and French-speaking customer base.
- Genuine enthusiasm for AI-enabled delivery models.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.
When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.
Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.
We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.
ROLE OVERVIEW
Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.
The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.
- Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.
- Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.
- Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.
- Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.
- Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.
QUALIFICATIONS
- Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.
- Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.
- Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.
- Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.
- Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.
- Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.
- Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.
- Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30%.

Why us?
🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.
🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.
Role Mission
The Data Solution Architect defines and owns the design of scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions that support customer and operational systems. This role is responsible for setting architectural direction, ensuring alignment with business needs, and guiding teams to deliver robust, production-grade solutions.
The Data Solution Architect works across engineering, product, and data teams to ensure solutions are well-designed, maintainable, and aligned with standards for performance, security, and governance.
Key Responsibilities
- Design and own end-to-end data solution architectures that meet defined requirements for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
- Translate complex business and product requirements into clear architectural designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and future scalability needs.
- Define and enforce technical standards for data architecture, including data modelling, integration patterns, and system design.
- Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams, supporting implementation and ensuring adherence to architectural principles.
- Review and approve solution designs, code, and implementations to ensure quality, consistency, and alignment with standards.
- Ensure solutions meet defined performance and reliability benchmarks (e.g. system throughput, latency, fault tolerance).
- Lead the identification and resolution of complex technical issues, including performance bottlenecks and architectural limitations.
- Drive improvements in system design, scalability, and maintainability through proactive refactoring and architectural evolution.
- Define and support implementation of CI/CD, testing, and deployment strategies to ensure reliable and efficient delivery.
- Ensure all solutions adhere to security, privacy, and compliance requirements, including secure data handling practices.
- Maintain clear architectural documentation, including system designs, decision records, and operational guidance.
- Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams to align on architecture, standards, and delivery priorities.
Skills & Competencies
- Data Architecture & System Design – Strong experience designing scalable, distributed data systems, including data models, storage, and processing layers.
- SQL & Data Processing – Deep understanding of SQL and data querying, with ability to design efficient data structures and transformations.
- Data Integration & Pipelines (ETL/ELT) – Expertise in designing and optimising data pipelines (e.g. SSIS or equivalent tools and frameworks).
- Programming (e.g. Python) – Experience using Python or similar languages for data processing, automation, or pipeline development.
- Cloud & Platform Technologies – Familiarity with modern data platforms and cloud-based architectures (desirable).
- Performance & Scalability Optimisation – Ability to design and tune systems to meet performance, reliability, and scalability requirements.
- Security & Compliance – Strong understanding of secure system design, data protection, and regulatory requirements.
- DevOps & CI/CD – Experience implementing automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to support reliable delivery.
- Technical Leadership – Provides architectural guidance, reviews work, and supports teams in delivering high-quality solutions.
- Cross-Team Influence – Works across teams and regions to align on standards, resolve dependencies, and drive consistency.
Required Experience & Qualifications
- Proven experience in a data architecture, software engineering, or technical leadership role (typically 7+ years).
- Strong experience designing and delivering scalable data solutions in production environments.
- Expertise in data modelling, system design, and integration patterns.
- Strong experience with SQL and data processing at scale.
- Experience working with data pipeline and ETL tools (e.g. SSIS or equivalent).
- Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) for data processing or automation.
- Experience defining or contributing to technical standards and architecture frameworks.
- Proven ability to lead technical design and guide delivery across teams.
- Strong communication skills, including translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
Interested?
If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.

- Engage C-suite and senior risk and compliance leaders across prospect accounts, positioning CUBE as a strategic partner rather than a point solution.

- Coordinate internal teams to progress deals efficiently and manage risks during the sales cycle.

- Problem Solving & Critical Thinking: Analyses complex problems, evaluates options, and implements effective solutions.
- Collaboration & Teamwork: Works effectively within teams, contributing to collective goals and supporting colleagues.
- Continuous Learning & Development: Actively pursues learning opportunities and develops skills to improve performance and adapt to change.

Required Experience & Qualifications

- Knowledge of, or having worked in a Compliance and or Risk function in financial services is essential alongside familiarity with key regulations.
- Demonstrated success in originating, progressing, and closing complex, high-value deals, including multiple seven-figure contracts
- Familiarity with RegTech, regulatory intelligence, or compliance workflow solutions; able to engage fluently on topics such as obligation mapping, regulatory change management, horizon scanning and operational risk.
- Experience selling across Northern European markets (UK & Ireland, Nordics, DACH, or Benelux); additional European languages are an advantage.

- Experience with using Claude and other AI tools to increase sales efficiency

jobs.ashbyhq.com/causaly/b197dd4a-dded-4.description_excerpt:
About us:
Causaly is redefining how humans acquire knowledge and develop insights in biomedicine. Our AI-powered platform enables researchers and decision-makers to discover and interpret evidence from millions of scientific publications, clinical trials, regulatory documents, and other complex data sources in minutes.
We are building the world’s most advanced biomedical knowledge platform, powered by a high-precision Knowledge Graph and GenAI capabilities. Our technology is already used by leading biopharmaceutical organizations to accelerate drug discovery, improve safety, and drive better decision-making.
Backed by top-tier investors including ICONIQ, Index Ventures, Pentech, and Marathon, we are scaling rapidly and expanding our product suite and market presence.
At a Glance
◆ What you'll build. The platform that runs our long-running orchestrated workflows in production. A single run can last hours, fan out across dozens of subagents, and has to produce evidence a scientist can audit.
◆ What you'll work in. Full-stack engineering, weighted towards backend and platform. TypeScript and Node.js, Restate for durable execution, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud and Azure.
◆ What we need from you. Significant backend depth in TypeScript, experience designing and operating distributed systems, and LLM-backed systems you have run in production.
What You'll Do
◆ Workflow orchestration. Design and evolve the workflow definition model: control flow, fan-out, conditional execution and data passing between steps, plus the static validation that rejects an invalid workflow before it runs.
◆ Durable execution. Build the engine that runs workflows, including checkpointing and resumption after failure, retry and abandonment policies, and idempotency guarantees.
◆ Monitoring, tracing and cost attribution. Instrument runs that cross several services and two languages, so that latency and token spend can be attributed to individual steps. These figures feed pricing decisions.
◆ LLM integration. Structured outputs, guardrails and retries, citation integrity across steps, and deciding where deterministic code should replace a model call.
◆ Architecture and technical leadership. Write the design proposal, break a large change into shippable increments, implement the hardest parts and own the result in production.
What We're Looking For
◆ Significant backend engineering experience in TypeScript and Node.js.
◆ Experience building LLM-backed systems that run in production, with informed views on how they fail.
◆ Experience designing and operating distributed systems.
◆ Practical experience of correctness under partial failure: idempotency, at-least-once delivery, safe retries, and backwards compatibility between services that deploy independently.
◆ Solid understanding of relational databases, including schema design and safe migration.
◆ Clear technical writing — you can produce a design document that a reviewer can act on.
◆ A product mindset. You are motivated by the outcome for the user, not only by the system.
◆ You measure before you optimise, and you revert a change that does not hold up.
Preferred Qualifications
◆ Durable execution or workflow engines (Restate, Temporal, Inngest), or a comparable system you have built yourself.
◆ Python and LLM application frameworks (FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph). Our GenAI service is written in Python and you will work in it.
◆ Observability and LLM instrumentation (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse).
◆ Multi-tenant SaaS where tenant isolation is a design constraint.
◆ Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes).
◆ Search and retrieval at scale (Elasticsearch, vector search, knowledge graphs).
◆ Functional programming, either in TypeScript (fp-ts) or in a functional language.
Not Required for This Role
◆ Machine learning research. This is a systems role built around models rather than a modelling role. No model training, fine-tuning or publication record is expected.
◆ Frontend specialism. You will work in React, but the role is weighted towards backend and platform and we are not looking for a frontend specialist.
Technology Stack
The list below is indicative and not exhaustive of the technologies we use at Causaly. We do not expect experience with all of it, but you should be comfortable learning the parts you have not used.
Languages: TypeScript, Node.js, Python
Backend: Apollo GraphQL, Zod, fp-ts, FastAPI
Frontend: React
Workflow & messaging: Restate, Redis Streams, Cloud Tasks
Data: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, MongoDB
GenAI: LangGraph, OpenAI
Observability: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Datadog
Cloud & infrastructure: Google Cloud, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Docker
Tooling: Git, GitHub Actions
BENEFITS
💰 Competitive compensation package
🩺 Private medical & dental insurance
📔 Life insurance (4 x salary)
🤓 Personal development budget
🧘 Individual wellbeing budget
🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
🥳 Your birthday off!
🚀 Potential to have real impact and accelerated career growth as a member of an international team that's building a transformative AI product.
We are on a mission to accelerate scientific breakthroughs for ALL humankind, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and fairly consider qualified candidates without regard to race, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, neurodiversity, genetics, age, religion or belief, marital/civil partnership status, domestic / family status, veteran status or any other difference.

ABOUT THE TEAM
We’re hiring AI engineers to help us transform research outcomes in biomedical sciences. We utilise generative AI and agents to help scientists find novel connections and insights from biomedical literature and datasets.
Delivering a faster research experience is not just a matter of picking the latest LLM model. Getting accurate, scientifically relevant, trustworthy and meaningful results relies on building trust with our users that comes from integrating proper levels of guardrails, biomedical curation, consistent update cycles and robust deployment practices that make our platform a one-stop shop for a researcher’s needs.
We’re looking for AI engineers who will champion this cause and help us apply AI to transform the way biomedical professionals carry out their research and day-to-day exploration.
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
· Design and implement ML/AI solutions end-to-end, from the idea and data exploration phase to deployment and monitoring, balancing cutting-edge techniques with pragmatism to deliver measurable impact.
· Apply strong software engineering principles, such as modularity, testing, code reviews, CI/CD and observability, to ensure AI systems are reliable, maintainable, production-ready and can be readily adapted to future developments.
· Choose the right approach for the problem at hand, evaluating classical ML and NLP techniques, LLM-based solutions, and agentic solutions to balance trade-offs between speed, cost, complexity, interpretability, and performance.
· Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to scope work, align on success metrics, and incrementally ship improvements in user-facing features powered by AI.
· Document system architectures and decision rationale early and clearly, enabling alignment across teams and accelerating onboarding and iteration.
· Champion model and data quality, including dataset versioning, robust evaluation, fairness/bias assessment, and real-world performance tracking.
· Mentor junior AI engineers and cross-functional teammates, sharing best practices in modelling, coding, maintaining and integrating product features, and helping grow a high-trust, high-performance team culture.
· Stay up-to-date with emerging research and tools, distilling key insights and bringing back relevant innovations to elevate team capabilities and product opportunities.
· Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, through company-wide Slack channels, Show and Tell presentations and technical deep-dives.
WHAT EXPERIENCE YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL
· A master's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
· 5+ years of experience building AI/ML systems in production environments, including ownership of key lifecycle stages: data collection, modeling, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
· Proficiency in Python and modern ML and agentic frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or LangChain, with experience packaging models into APIs or integrating them into applications.
· A solid understanding of LLMs for natural language processing applications, including topics such as embeddings, prompt engineering and fine-tuning.
· Strong software engineering foundations such as version control, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, containerization plus a mindset of building for reliability and scale.
· Experience working in product-focused teams, collaborating with designers, engineers, and PMs, to scope and ship AI features iteratively

· Clear, structured communicator, comfortable documenting and defending architectural decisions and engaging in thoughtful technical debate.
NOT REQUIRED, BUT IT’S A PLUS IF YOU ALSO HAVE:

jobs.ashbyhq.com/baseten/b7fad264-bfe7-4.description_excerpt:
ABOUT BASETEN
Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.
THE ROLE
Enterprise at Baseten means the companies with the most to gain from AI and the most complexity in getting there: large digital natives running products at massive scale, and category leaders in software, financial services, healthcare, and beyond. They have the data, the distribution, and the budget. Most are still deciding what to build, what to run themselves, and what it should cost.
That makes this a consultative sale. You'll spend as much time helping a VP of Engineering pressure-test their AI strategy as you will selling against an alternative, mapping use cases, framing build-vs-buy, and giving clear recommendations grounded in what you've seen work at the frontier. Then you'll do the enterprise work: multithreading across a buying committee, navigating security and procurement, and turning a first workload into an eight-figure relationship.
You'll work alongside our founders, forward-deployed engineers, and GTM leadership, in a seat where the playbook is still being written.
RESPONSIBILITIES
- Own a revenue target end to end, from prospecting and outbounding through closing Tier 1 accounts in your verticals
- Act as a strategic advisor on AI adoption: identify use cases, shape architecture decisions, and lead with clear, opinionated recommendations
- Multithread across large organizations, from the engineers running evals to the executives funding the program to security, legal, and procurement
- Win lighthouse customers that become references for their entire industry
- Partner with forward-deployed engineering on technical evaluations, POCs, and architecture reviews
- Feed signal back to product and engineering. What enterprises need next is a roadmap input we don't get anywhere else
REQUIREMENTS
- 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience in technology, ideally infrastructure, API/platform, or developer tooling
- A track record of closing seven- and eight-figure deals by navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees and long, complex cycles
- Demonstrated ability to run a consultative sale. You've helped customers define a strategy, not just evaluate a product
- Strong technical acumen: you can hold your own on model serving, GPU infrastructure, latency, and API architecture
- Experience selling into large digital natives or regulated industries (financial services, healthcare/life sciences, insurance, government)
- Excellent communication and comfort with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment
NICE TO HAVE
- Direct experience selling AI/ML infrastructure, cloud compute, or model deployment platforms
BENEFITS
- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)
- Paid parental leave
- Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot
- (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)
- Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.
Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.
At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

About CyberCube: https://www.cybcube.com/careers
CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk, helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.
- AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.
- Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.
- Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.
- Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry.
- A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.
- A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.
- People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.
The Role
CyberCube is hiring a first-line sales leader to own our largest revenue segment: the (re)insurance sales and account management team across UK/Europe and North America.
Context
CyberCube is the market-leading cyber risk analytics platform for the insurance industry, serving large global carriers, reinsurers and brokers. The (re)insurance segment is our largest and most established revenue base, spanning new business and renewals across the UK/Europe and North America.
The team, the territory, and the pipeline are in place. This is a senior leadership role, not a build from scratch role. The postholder leads the team, owns the number, and is personally credible in front of a CRO or Chief Underwriting Officer.
What You Will Do
- Lead the (re)insurance sales and account management team across UK/Europe and North America and deliver the segment number, with a forecast we can rely on quarter to quarter.
- Hire, coach, and performance manage the team. Retain and stretch top performers.
- Run the team off numbers. Pipeline coverage, conversion, activity, cycle time. Hold a forecast, evidence it, and be held to it, with weekly inspection and CRM discipline.
- Lead the renewal and expansion motion.
- Shorten the time from qualified opportunity to signature.
- Named account coverage and territory design fit for purpose across UK/Europe and North America.
- Coach in the deal rather than from the sidelines. In the room with the team on the meetings that matter.
- Hold the room with senior insurance buyers (CUO, CRO, Chief Actuary, Head of Cyber, Head of Exposure Management) and earn a second meeting on their agenda, not ours.
- Set the tempo for the team. Travel and be visibly in market rather than managing from a desk.
What We Look For
- Proven first-line sales leadership. Has managed a team of quota-carrying sellers and ideally account managers, and hit team targets over multiple cycles.
- Has sold complex software, data or analytics into large enterprise buyers, and has led a team doing the same. Long cycles, multiple stakeholders, technical evaluation, six- and seven-figure ACVs.
- Enterprise deal experience. Multi-stakeholder, procurement and legal heavy, six to twelve month cycles, subscription or licence commercial models.
- Metrics-oriented. Knows their pipeline coverage, conversion and cycle times without looking them up, and coaches the team against those measures.
- Executive credible. Can walk into a CRO or Chief Underwriting Officer and be taken seriously on the first meeting. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to represent CyberCube without supervision.
- Operates with urgency, treats a slow decision as a cost, and lifts the energy of the team.
- A demanding, high-accountability leader who sets a high bar. Direct with feedback, quick to address underperformance, and respected for it.
- Commercially creative on structure and pricing, disciplined on process and reporting.
- Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.
- Based in London or New York, with regular international client travel.
Strong Plus
- Has sold into the insurance or reinsurance industry. Carriers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs or the Lloyd's market. A major differentiator, but not a requirement.
- Experience across both new business and renewals/expansion, including usage-based or consumption pricing conversations.
- Exposure to reinsurance and broker channels as well as primary carriers.
- Has scaled a team through a step change in growth expectations.
- Cyber, catastrophe modelling, exposure management or InsurTech adjacency.
- Comfort in a fast-moving, AI-enabled commercial function. Agentic prospecting, automated reporting, no traditional SDR layer.
Not Required
- Deep technical cyber security or catastrophe modelling knowledge. We have that in the business.
- Underwriting or actuarial background.
- Direct competitor experience.

About CyberCube: https://www.cybcube.com/careers

- A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence.
- People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers.
The Impact You Will Make
- Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry
- Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:
- Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,
- Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and
- Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence
… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited
- Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios
- Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven
- Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)
- Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals
- Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence
The Skills and Experience You Will Bring
- Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field
- 5+ years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)
- Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel — enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams
- Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts
- Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward
- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills
- Executive-level communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders
- Experience working in and leading project teams
- Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment
- Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce
- Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner
The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop
- Experience with analytics and risk modeling
- Experience in a SaaS product development environment
- Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis
- Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure
- Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.
Why You'll Love it Here
- Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world
- Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely
- Opportunity to participate in a secondment program
- Company-supported mentorship program
- Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture
US specific
- Competitive salary and unlimited PTO
- Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage
- Monthly catered lunches and happy hours
- Company-paid learning and development assistance
- Dependant care assistance plan

- Competitive salary, pension and benefits
- Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage
- Extra vacation days during winter holidays
