job-boards.greenhouse.io/fosphamarketing.description_excerpt:
Fospha is the measurement system enterprise retail and ecommerce brands run their business on. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what's actually working — across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop — down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. It replaces guesswork and gut feel with a number marketing, finance and agencies can all trust and act on.

Brands including Dyson, Gymshark, and Lululemon use Fospha up to 25 times a day to decide where budget should move next. We've spent over a decade building this, with more than $40 billion in marketing spend now optimised through the platform — and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai and Austin.

 

The Role

As an Associate Account Manager you will play a critical role in ensuring Fospha’s customers see measurable value and business impact from our marketing measurement platform. Working within our Customer team, you’ll directly own relationships across a portfolio of mid-size customers, driving retention, adoption, and commercial readiness while helping shape the next generation of customer success at Fospha.

You will:

  • Drive renewals across your portfolio by understanding client objectives, monitoring account health, and ensuring value is demonstrated ahead of each renewal cycle.
  • Collaborate closely with the Head of Customer Accounts on your higher impact accounts, building the commercial skillset to secure long term and successful partnerships with Fospha customers
  • Turn data into impact stories. Helping different customer personas see how Fospha drives efficiency, growth, and smarter marketing decisions, through clear ROI and performance storytelling tailored to what they care about, from the CFO to the Marketing team to in house Data teams.
  • Identify signals of growth or risk early, working with the day to day customer teams to flag adoption challenges or expansion opportunities, and contribute to the proactive building of a tailored learning agenda with each of our customers.
  • Contribute to proactive strategic account plans, helping shape the roadmap for your accounts, ensuring every action ties back to measurable outcomes and maps out your stakeholder and activation plan across the account to get ahead of renewal conversations
  • Represent the voice of the customer internally, surfacing product feedback, feature requests, and insight that helps Fospha continuously improve our platform and delivery.

 

What are we looking for?

  • 2–3 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, or client-facing SaaS roles, ideally within D2C marketing, analytics, or eCommerce.
  • Strong relationship builder who enjoys helping customers achieve tangible results.
  • Comfortable with data, you can interpret dashboards, spot trends, and articulate the “so what” for the customer.
  • Confident communicator across email, video, and live meetings; able to build trust quickly with multiple stakeholders.
  • Organized and proactive. You take ownership of follow-ups, get creative with planning, and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Eager to drive the commercial side of SaaS, renewals, upsells, and business case storytelling.
  • Naturally curious and analytical, with a genuine interest in marketing performance and measurement.
  • (Bonus) Experience with eCommerce data, attribution, marketing platforms, marketing measurement or D2C ad platforms is a plus.

 

What we can offer you

  • A workplace pension, through Royal London, with Fospha matching your contributions up to 3%
  • A £1,000/year flexible benefits allowance to put towards private medical insurance, dental cover, a health cash plan, gym membership, extra holiday, or a pension top-up - whatever suits you!
  • Access to Wellhub, giving you one membership across gyms, boutique studios, and wellbeing apps
  • 25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays, an extra day off for your birthday! and more holiday the longer you stay (26 days after 3 years, 27 after 6)
  • Life assurance worth 4x your annual salary, from day one
  • Cycle to Work scheme, plus discounts on everyday spending through our benefits portal — Apple, Tesco, IKEA, M&S, Deliveroo, cinema tickets and more
  • Quarterly one-to-one sessions with a financial adviser, plus access to payroll-deducted loans through Salary Finance
  • Paid volunteering days each year
  • Regular socials, free weekly snacks, and Lunch & Learn events at our Scale Space office, plus access to the wider Blenheim Chalcot community
  • Opportunities to travel — including to our India and North America offices

 

Our Values & Principles

You will be able to demonstrate examples of our core principles:

  • Seek inclusion & diversity: We create an environment where everyone feels welcome, and people are encouraged to speak and be heard
  • Work Hard, Work Well, Work Together: We take responsibility for making things happen, independently and together; we help colleagues in need and close loops, making sure our work is complete and has lasting impact
  • Grow: We are proactive, curious and unafraid of failure
  • Customer at the heart: We care about the customer, feel their pain and love building product that solves their biggest problems
  • Candour with caring: We deliver candid feedback with kindness and receive it with gratitude

Above all, our people show a willingness to work together and get their hands dirty to deliver product success, which means our customers are successful!

The Customer Intelligence team are responsible for ensuring our customers take action on Fospha data: turning data into clear recommendations, guiding marketers through budgeting decisions and helping client teams become experts in the Fospha platform.

  • Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within our Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with your skills and interests
  • Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI hub, so you're building modern, AI-fluent ways of working rather than legacy processes

What are we looking for?

  • We hire for potential – you don’t need a technical degree or marketing background. We’re looking for:
  • Curious, proactive individuals who are keen to learn and grow
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong relationship-building ability, both internally and externally
  • Analytical mindset, comfortable interpreting data and creating insights – proficiency in Excel!
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Solving problems for customers
  • Interest in emerging technologies and excited by the potential and opportunity AI brings

 

Our Values and…

Fospha is the marketing measurement system for brands that sell everywhere. For over a decade, we've helped paid marketing teams see everything, sell anywhere and move instantly, so they can stop defending their budget and start growing it profitably.

Today's brands don't only sell on their own website. They sell through retailers like Sephora, Ulta and Amazon, and in physical stores. Fospha measures all of it, online and offline, from daily full-funnel attribution to planning, testing and AI-powered analysis. We've optimised over $40B in marketing spend, and we're scaling fast across London, Mumbai, and Austin.

 

The Role

This is a permanent, in-house role for a multi-disciplinary designer at the heart of Fospha's go-to-market motion. The work is deliberately varied: in a single week you might refine our website, design a sales asset for a major prospect, and extend our design system. We're looking for a versatile all-rounder with real depth across brand, web and presentation design, not a specialist in just one of them. You'll be the person who defines what "best in class" looks like for our brand, then makes it real: a dynamic, memorable website, standout sales and event materials, and a design system that lets the whole team move at pace without losing quality.

Your job is to make sure the imagery, motion and feel of Fospha land the pain points of our target enterprise brands as clearly as our words do, and to translate complex measurement concepts into visuals that are instantly easy to understand.

  • Keep raising the bar. Benchmark us against the best in B2B measurement and beyond, bring fresh ideas on what the best looks like, and keep improving how we show up against competitors.

  • Have an innovative, keen design eye and a portfolio that shows distinctive brand, web and illustration work

  • Have strong website design skills, ideally with a feel for interaction, motion and scroll-driven storytelling, and are comfortable working closely with front-end builds
  • Are agentically minded: you love experimenting with new tools for image generation and AI-assisted design, and know when to push them and when to take over
  • Thrive on ideation, constantly asking what the best looks like in marketing and how we can level up our brand against competitors
  • Enjoy a fast-paced, innovative startup environment, where you'll ship quickly, iterate often, and juggle several projects at once

VP/Director, FP&A 

Exclaimer is a ~100m ARR software business owned by Insight Partners. With our high velocity / low ACV, our business combines standard SaaS characteristics with a D2C dynamic. Reports to: CFO

Gram Games is the studio behind popular titles like 1010!, Six!, Merge Dragons!, and Merge Magic!, with more exciting projects in the pipeline. We are proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We do things differently here: we work in small self-managing teams, giving you an incredible amount of ownership, autonomy, and impact.

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and manage the yearly organic growth roadmap, including localization, seasonal, and launch strategies.
  • Set the studio's platform partnership strategy, aligning featuring and promotional opportunities with business priorities and release calendars.

Platform Partnerships

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with Google Play, Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, and Amazon Appstore partner teams.
  • Secure featuring, editorial placements, and promotional opportunities across launches, updates, and key seasonal moments.
  • Advocate for early access to platform betas, new store features, monetization tools, and APIs, and channel those opportunities back to Product and UA.

The Senior/Principal Statistical Programmer is responsible for serving as a technical and study programming lead across multiple compounds and/or studies within the Statistical Programming function, supporting Ipsen’s assets within a specific therapeutic area such as Oncology, Rare Disease, or Neuroscience.

The role requires strong hands-on statistical programming expertise, study leadership, and technical knowledge to ensure the quality, consistency, and timely delivery of statistical programming activities.   • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to other statistical programmers and contribute to the development of programming capabilities within the organization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve programming processes, adopt innovative and efficient approaches, and support evolving and complex study design methodologies.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in statistical programming and contribute to technical decision-making within assigned studies and therapeutic areas.

Galaxy also develops and operates data center infrastructure to power AI and HPC workloads. Anchored by its Helios campus in Texas, Galaxy is building a multi-gigawatt pipeline of more than 5.7 GW of potential capacity, positioning it among the largest and fastest-growing data center developers in North America.

The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Additional information about Galaxy's businesses and products is available on www.galaxy.com.

What We Value:

We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be.

  • Seek Excellence.
  • Be Selective To Be Effective.
  • Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled.
  • Disagree Transparently.
  • Encourage Independent Decision-Making.
  • Build Dream Teams.

Who You Are:

You'll design and build backend systems powering blockchain infrastructure and staking products across Galaxy — spanning Ethereum-based systems, staking infrastructure (native and liquid), and blockchain data systems and APIs. Liquid Collective is one of several key initiatives you'll contribute to. 

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership and influence. You'll play a key part in shaping architecture, development practices, and engineering culture — not just building features, but raising the bar on how the team works. You'll own systems end-to-end, from architecture through to observability, and you'll operate in a spec-first development environment that increasingly leverages AI-assisted workflows. 

Typical time allocation: roughly 60% building systems and features, 20% code review and mentorship, 20% design, architecture, and product collaboration. 

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and own backend systems
    • Design and build APIs, services, Ethereum data pipelines and indexers, staking and validator infrastructure integrations, and monitoring and operational tooling.
    • Own system design end-to-end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and observability. 
    • Work across the Ethereum stack, integrating with both execution layer and consensus layer clients. 
    • Contribute to Liquid Collective alongside other staking and blockchain infrastructure projects across Galaxy.
  • Define and uphold engineering standards
    • Set and maintain the bar on API design, testing strategies for distributed systems, reliability and fault tolerance, and security and key management practices.
    • Operate in a spec-first development environment — translate product and protocol requirements into clear technical specs before building. 
    • Leverage AI-assisted development workflows (e.g. Claude Code) and work with emerging paradigms like MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based tooling.
  • Collaborate and contribute to engineering culture
    • Work cross-functionally with protocol, product, and infrastructure teams. 
    • Mentor engineers through code review, design feedback, and raising the overall quality of what the team ships.

Acting on behalf of the Principal Designer under National Grid’s SR188 framework, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with CDM Regulations 2015, driving high standards of health, safety, and risk management throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the Principal Designer Representative (PD R) in accordance with National Grid’s SR188 requirements.
  • Support and advise clients, designers, and project teams on CDM compliance, including roles, duties, and documentation.
  • Coordinate and manage design risk management processes, ensuring hazards are identified, eliminated, or reduced through design.
  • Facilitate and lead design risk workshops, HAZID/HAZOP sessions, and design reviews.
  • Ensure production and maintenance of key CDM deliverables, including:
    • Design Risk Registers
    • Pre-Construction Information (PCI)
    • Health and Safety Files
  • Provide CDM and safety input, influencing safe-by-design principles early in the project lifecycle.
  • Support project teams through the design and construction phase, ensuring effective communication of residual risks to contractors.
  • Engage with stakeholders including National Grid, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Monitor and report on CDM compliance and performance, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Promote a strong health, safety, and wellbeing culture across all projects.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in a Principal Designer or CDM Advisor role, ideally within the utilities or infrastructure sectors.
  • Strong working knowledge of CDM Regulations 2015 and their practical application.
  • Experience working on National Grid projects and familiarity with SR188 requirements is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrable experience across both FEED/design and construction phases.
  • Ability to lead design risk management activities and influence multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Qualifications

  • Relevant degree or equivalent in engineering, construction, or a related discipline.
  • Professional membership (e.g., APS, IOSH, ICE, IET) desirable.
  • NEBOSH Construction Certificate (or equivalent) desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong leadership and facilitation skills.
  • High attention to detail with a commitment to safety excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on critical national infrastructure projects.
  • Exposure to a broad range of FEED and construction stage activities.

  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/pennylane/0c36dac8-2482.description_excerpt:
MÖCHTEST DU DAS LEBEN VON MILLIONEN UNTERNEHMER IN EUROPA VERÄNDERN?
Du möchtest echten Impact haben und die Zukunft von Finanzen und Buchhaltung in Europa mitgestalten? Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, das auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Geschwindigkeit setzt? Und unsere Design-Prinzipien entsprechen deiner Vorstellung von großartigen Nutzererlebnissen?
Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein – und du genau die richtige Person für diese Rolle.
UNSERE VISION
Wir bauen das beliebteste Financial Operating System für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen in Europa.
Unser Ziel ist es, Unternehmer von zeitaufwendigen Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu entlasten und ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu den wichtigsten Finanzinformationen zu geben, damit sie bessere Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen treffen können.
Gleichzeitig unterstützen wir Steuerkanzleien dabei, weniger Zeit für repetitive Aufgaben aufzuwenden und sich stärker auf die Beratung und Betreuung ihrer Mandant zu konzentrieren.
Bereits heute nutzen mehr als 1.000.000 kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen sowie über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien Pennylane in Frankreich.
ÜBER UNS
Pennylane gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs in Frankreich – und bald auch in Deutschland.
In nur fünf Jahren haben wir:
- uns als innovative Accounting- und Finanzplattform für Unternehmen und Steuerkanzleien etabliert,
- insgesamt 150 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – unter anderem von Sequoia, dem renommierten Silicon-Valley-Investor hinter Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe und PayPal,
- unser Team von 7 Gründer auf über 1.100 Pennylaners ausgebaut,
- eine internationale Unternehmenskultur mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten geschaffen,
- eine starke Remote-First-Kultur etabliert, in der bereits rund 30 % unserer Mitarbeitenden von überall in Europa arbeiten,
- das Vertrauen tausender Kund und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.
Heute gelten wir mit einer Glassdoor-Bewertung von 4,6/5 als einer der attraktivsten Arbeitgeber Europas.
PENNYLANE DEUTSCHLAND
Innerhalb von nur 1,5 Jahren ist unser Deutschland-Team von einer einzelnen Squad auf über 40 Mitarbeitende in den Bereichen Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success und Marketing gewachsen.
Unser Ziel ist es, Pennylane als festen Bestandteil des deutschen Marktes zu etablieren. Gemeinsam mit innovativen Steuerberater und Unternehmen entwickeln wir unser Produkt für die Anforderungen des deutschen Marktes weiter und verändern nachhaltig die Art und Weise, wie Buchhaltung und Finanzen in Deutschland funktionieren.
Als eigenständiger Markt profitieren wir von der Unterstützung unserer französischen Teams und genießen gleichzeitig große Freiheiten bei der Gestaltung unserer Ziele, Strukturen, Prozesse und Produkte.
DESIGN BEI PENNYLANE
Design steht im Zentrum unserer Mission. Unser Anspruch ist es, Nutzer ein nahtloses, zugängliches und begeisterndes Produkterlebnis zu bieten.
Unser Design-Team besteht aus über 40 Product Designer, die in interdisziplinären Squads eng mit Product und Engineering zusammenarbeiten.
Autonomie, Vertrauen und Transparenz bilden das Fundament unserer Unternehmenskultur und prägen den Arbeitsalltag unserer Designer.
Bei Pennylane beschränkt sich Design nicht auf die Gestaltung von Interfaces. Designer begleiten den gesamten Prozess – von der Definition des Problems über Research und Testing bis hin zur Umsetzung der Lösung.
DEINE ROLLE
Wir suchen eine Product Designer mit fundierter Erfahrung im B2B-Produktdesign, um die Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts in Deutschland aktiv mitzugestalten.
Wenn du gerne reale Nutzerprobleme löst, in einem kollaborativen Umfeld arbeitest und ein echtes Interesse daran hast, Nutzerverhalten und Geschäftsziele zu verstehen, wirst du bei Pennylane viele Gleichgesinnte finden.
DAS BRINGST DU MIT
- Du verstehst sowohl Nutzerbedürfnisse als auch Business-Anforderungen und kannst Erkenntnisse aus User Research, Marktanalysen und Daten in pragmatische Lösungen übersetzen.
- Du hast Erfahrung mit komplexen digitalen Produkten und Systemen, beispielsweise mit mehreren Modulen, umfangreichen Funktionen oder komplexen Datenstrukturen.
- Du arbeitest eng mit Entwickler, Product Manager und weiteren Stakeholdern wie Sales oder Support zusammen und kannst technische Rahmenbedingungen sowie Business-Ziele in deine Arbeit integrieren.
- Du kommunizierst klar, hinterfragst bestehende Annahmen konstruktiv und kannst deine Lösungsansätze überzeugend vertreten.
- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. User Interviews werden regelmäßig auf Deutsch durchgeführt.
WAS DICH BEI PENNYLANE ERWARTET
INNERHALB DES ERSTEN MONATS
- Du lernst unser Unternehmen, unsere Teams und unsere Vision während des Onboardings kennen.
- Du erhältst einen tiefen Einblick in unser Produkt sowie die Welt der Buchhaltung und Finanzen.
- Du machst dich mit unserer Product- und Design-Organisation, unseren Methoden und unserer Kultur vertraut.
- Du lernst die Menschen kennen, mit denen du täglich zusammenarbeiten wirst – sowohl innerhalb des Deutschland-Teams als auch im internationalen Umfeld.
INNERHALB DER ERSTEN DREI MONATE
- Du führst Discovery-Workshops und User Research durch und analysierst Daten, Nutzerfeedback und Business-Anforderungen.
- Gemeinsam mit deinem Product Manager verantwortest du die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung deines Produktbereichs.
- Du entwickelst Lösungen in der passenden Detailtiefe – von ersten Konzepten bis hin zu High-Fidelity-Prototypen.
- Du bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv ins Team ein, gibst Feedback an Kolleg und arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Themen mit.
INNERHALB DER ERSTEN SECHS MONATE
- Du unterstützt aktiv beim Ausbau unseres Teams und wirkst im Recruiting-Prozess mit.
- Du beobachtest aktuelle UX- und UI-Trends und bringst Best Practices aus der internationalen Tech-Welt ein.
UND DARÜBER HINAUS
Sowohl unser Design-Team als auch unsere Aktivitäten in Deutschland werden weiter wachsen.
Das bedeutet für dich:
- Möglichkeiten, neue Designer einzustellen, zu coachen und perspektivisch zu führen.
- Mehr Verantwortung für strategische Projekte.
- Die Chance, Prozesse, Tools und Best Practices aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.
DAS BIETEN WIR DIR
- Arbeite aus unserem Büro im Herzen Berlins, aus unserem Standort in Hamburg, aus unseren Büros in Paris oder aus jedem WeWork-Standort in Europa.
- Bei einem Full-Remote-Vertrag erhältst du ein Budget für dein Home Office sowie einen monatlichen Zuschuss für Coworking-Spaces.
- Zusätzlich zu 25 Urlaubstagen erhältst du jährlich zwischen 8 und 13 weitere freie Tage.
- Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch zu verbessern oder eine neue Sprache zu lernen.
- Modernste Apple-Hardware für deinen Arbeitsalltag.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are always seeking talented and motivated Enterprise Business Development Representatives to join our Client Sales team in London.

Please Note: By submitting your application to our talent pool, you are expressing interest in a future career with our company and will be considered for new positions as they become available.

This role is perfect for a highly motivated hunter who thrives on outbound prospecting, uncovering new business opportunities, and setting the stage for successful sales conversations. If you're passionate about sales and eager to grow into an Account Executive (AE) role, this is your opportunity to develop the foundational skills needed to excel in B2B sales. This role would be targeting the Irish market, you would be the first BDR to be focussed solely on this market.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Identify and engage complex Enterprise prospects based in Ireland from a defined Book of Business (BoB) via email, phone, LinkedIn, Video, etc.
  • Strategic outbound prospecting (listening to podcasts, reading the news, reviewing 10ks, etc).
  • Uncovering complex enterprise opportunities (multiple stakeholders, various buying committees).
  • Setting the stage for successful high-value sales conversations (building ROI, challenger mindset).
  • Close collaboration with AEs for smooth handoff of qualified leads.
  • Build strong relationships through consultative selling, nurturing long sales cycles, and establishing yourself as a thought leader.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Develop industry expertise to act as a trusted consultant on HR, wellness, and people trends across different sectors and geographies.
  • Possess strong business acumen and the ability to effectively communicate with senior-level stakeholders.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 1-3 years of professional experience (not necessarily in sales)
  • Previous experience within the Irish Market is a plus
  • Familiar with or certified in: Salesforce, Salesloft, Outreach, Gong, Sales Navigator, LinkedIn 
  • Tenacious and goal-driven, you bring a proactive mindset and a passion for driving success.
  • Adaptable: You enjoy learning and embrace change, and are eager to evolve in a dynamic work environment

job-boards.greenhouse.io/mixpanel/jobs/8.description_excerpt:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Delivery Engineer Team

As a member of the Delivery Engineer team, you will own the post-sales onboarding and data health for customers. Your goal will be to drive data trust, help embed Mixpanel into our customers’ data stack, and deliver on emerging AI integrations — delivering on the full value of Mixpanel as a self-serve analytics platform. You will work and consult with GTM team members and a diverse array of customers to successfully roll out product analytics to their organization and execute on technical projects and services that delight our customers.

About the Role

As a Delivery Engineer, you will be on the front lines with our clients as they integrate Mixpanel into their core product development processes. You will lay the foundation for customers to adopt product analytics and get value from Mixpanel by delivering a world-class, on-time, and value-oriented onboarding experience. With your comprehensive project management knowledge, consultative approach, expertise in the analytics space, and technical knowledge of the modern data stack, you will lead our clients' first experience with Mixpanel as they incorporate product analytics into their data ecosystem as a foundational element. With your deep technical breadth and expertise in the analytics space, you’ll be the expert consultant on all things data and ecosystem. As Mixpanel and our customers continue to iterate on agentic integrations, you’ll own ensuring customers are able to build, assemble context, and integrate AI workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Own onboarding and data health for our strategic and high-value clients, including ongoing enhancements to their data quality and overall tech stack integration
  • Align with pre-sales teams and consult with prospects/clients to define business goals and metrics to guide data architecture and project outcomes
  • Engage with customers’ engineering, product management, and marketing teams to handle technical onboarding, optimize Mixpanel deployments, and improve data trust
  • Deliver a variety of technical services ranging from data architecture consultations to adoption and change management best practices
  • Leverage modern data architecture expertise to create scalable data governance practices and data trust for our customers, including data optimization and re-implementation projects
  • Successfully execute on deliverables whilst balancing project timelines, scope creep, and unanticipated issues
  • Collaborate with our technical and solutions partners as needed on data optimization and onboarding projects
  • Be a technical sponsor for internal engagements with product and engineering teams to prioritize product and systems tasks from clients
  • Build AI automations to help customers manage their data at scale
  • Consult with customers on integrating their agentic workflows with Mixpanel data.

We're Looking For Someone Who Is:

  • Comfortable with data querying, modeling, and transforming in at least one core tool, including SQL / dbt / Python / Business Intelligence tools / Product Analytics tools, etc.
  • Familiar with databases and cloud data warehouses like Google Cloud, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Azure, etc.
  • Familiar with product analytics implementation methods like SDKs, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Event Streaming, Reverse ETL, etc.
  • Familiar with analytics best practices across business segments and verticals
  • Can manage complex projects with assorted client stakeholders, working across teams and departments to execute real change while managing scope and timelines
  • Has embedded AI into their workflows and is familiar with using MCP servers, building new skills, setting context, and can credibly consult with our customers about their AI/data strategy
  • Has experience in customer success, client-facing professional services, consulting, or technical project management role
  • Excellent written, analytical, and communication skills
  • Strong process and/or project delivery discipline
  • Eager to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving customer needs

About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About the Sales Team

Our EMEA Sales team helps organizations see clearly what's working in their products and turn that into faster, smarter decisions. We're growing our enterprise footprint across key EMEA markets by bringing on people who know how to build trust with customers and close complex deals.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to lead Mixpanel's largest, most complex deals across key EMEA markets. You'll own strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end — building multi-threaded relationships with senior stakeholders, running complex sales cycles, and closing new business that shapes how the region grows. You'll work closely with GTM leadership as a strategic partner, anticipating market shifts and proactively shaping the regional approach rather than just executing within it. You'll also influence peers, sharing what's working across accounts to raise the bar for the wider team. This role suits someone who navigates ambiguity with confidence, builds trust quickly at the C-level, and thinks several steps ahead of the deal in front of them.

Responsibilities

  • Own and lead a portfolio of the region's largest, most strategic enterprise accounts
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles — from discovery to close — building tailored, ROI-based proposals for sophisticated buying committees
  • Build and maintain a well-qualified pipeline and forecast for high-value, longer-cycle deals
  • Build and influence relationships across the C-suite and other senior stakeholders, establishing yourself as a trusted, strategic partner
  • Anticipate risks and shifts in your accounts and the broader market, and communicate proactively to keep deals and forecasts on track
  • Partner with GTM leadership to shape regional strategy, bringing account-level insight into broader planning conversations
  • Represent Mixpanel at industry events and regional forums as a senior voice for the business
  • Track the competitive landscape and shape how Mixpanel's differentiation is positioned within the partner ecosystem
  • Mentor and influence peers by sharing what's working in your accounts and adopting better ways of working across the team

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

  • A strong track record of success in enterprise SaaS sales, including leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with large organizations
  • Experience building and closing strategic accounts through outbound prospecting, account planning, and long-term relationship building
  • A demonstrated ability to build and influence relationships at the C-suite and other senior levels

Business Development Representative (London)

Hybrid work schedule — 2 days per week in our London office.

 

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether its engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Business Development Representative to join us.

 

About the Role

As a Business Development Representative at Reachdesk, you’ll join our high-performing team in a role that blends research, strategy, and creativity to map complex organizations and engage key decision-makers effectively.

You’ll leverage our own innovative gifting platform as a powerful prospecting tool — giving you a unique advantage that every BDR wants.

This role offers clear, merit-based growth within the Business Development team, where you “promote yourself” automatically by consistently meeting or exceeding targets. Plus, Reachdesk provides multiple pathways across the company for further career advancement. If you’re smart, ambitious, resourceful, and ready to make an impact, this is the opportunity for you.

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute outbound lead generation strategies, effectively communicating Reachdesk’s SaaS platform value proposition to target markets.
  • Identify, engage, and qualify leads to create active, sales-ready opportunities within complex B2B organizations.
  • Monitor and analyze buying signals and product usage data to tailor outreach and respond quickly to prospects’ needs.
  • Plan and implement Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns through detailed research, organizational mapping, and personalized content aligned with SaaS buyer journeys.
  • Maintain and update CRM systems (Salesforce and Salesloft) to ensure accurate tracking of pipeline and campaign effectiveness.
  • Execute multi-touch outreach campaigns using email, phone, social, and other channels to nurture leads through the sales funnel.
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline, prioritizing high-potential SaaS prospects for the sales team.
  • Represent Reachdesk at SaaS industry events, webinars, and partner gatherings to expand networks and generate new business opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth lead handoff, alignment on messaging, and customer insights.
  • Continuously analyze outreach results and iterate tactics to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates in a SaaS environment.

 

About You

  • Previous experience as a Business Development Representative (BDR), ideally with a proven track record of prospecting at mid-market or enterprise levels.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills — able to tailor messaging to different audiences, handle objections confidently, and build rapport quickly.
  • A demonstrable interest or track record in creative outreach strategies — such as personalized messaging, multi-channel campaigns, and leveraging social insights — to break through to prospects.

  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Product Manager

Location: UK (remote)

Job Description

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Product Manager to join us.

 

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

 

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

 

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

 

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

 

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Remote (UK-based)

About Sayari: 

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

 

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same. 
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

 

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

 

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

 

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is £59,000 - £95,000 plus variable bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience-levels and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

This is not a traditional engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.

You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.

You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.

You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.

 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Embed and Build: Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.
  • Own the Outcome: Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.
  • Be the Tip of the Spear: Serve as the primary technical authority for our clients. You'll lead deep-dive technical workshops, debug complex systems, and act as a trusted, hands-on advisor on how to best leverage Sayari's platform to achieve their objectives in real-world investigations and missions.
  • Engineer Solutions for the Mission: Deconstruct ambiguous, high-level mission requirements into concrete technical solutions. Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).
  • Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.
  • Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.
  • A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred

Desired:

  • Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).
  • Knowledge of graph data technologies (Neo4j, TigerGraph) and their corresponding query languages.
  • Exposure to machine learning applications, particularly in NLP or entity resolution.
  • Experience in, or a demonstrated passion for, high-stakes domains such as AML/Financial Crime, Supply Chain Risk, or National Security.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

 

The target base salary for this position is £100,000 to £110,000 plus commission and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions

As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities.

This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow “AI seller” title.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Build and execute a territory strategy for net-new customer acquisition.
  • Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account-based, partner, and market-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity.
  • Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer.
  • Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders.
  • Lead great business-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Build and develop champions, multi-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome.
  • Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close.
  • Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload.
  • Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new-logo performance.
  • Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses.
  • Travel within the assigned territory as required. 

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus.
  • Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new-logo wins and self-sourced pipeline.
  • Experience closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners.
  • Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational-impact cases.
  • Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open-source software.
  • Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal-management skills.
  • Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences.
  • Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills.
  • B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience with Fortune 500 or security-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open-source or consumption-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

Super Payments

Super Payments is the only global fintech platform providing 0% processing fees for merchants. Our mission is to use data and AI to make payments free for businesses, so that everyone wins. 

At Super, we are disrupting payments, like Spotify did to music and Robinhood did to trading. We don't make money from transaction fees;  instead, we monetise through value-added services such as lender commissions and FX. Our platform supports multiple payment methods — from traditional cards to direct bank transfers via open banking, as well as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and our own Buy Now Pay Later solution. 

Super has raised $66M from leading investors including Accel, Union Square Ventures and Local Globe (the same investors behind Spotify, Stripe, Monzo) and founded by Samir Desai CBE, co-founder of Funding Circle. 

Already trusted by thousands of businesses and more than 4 million customers, Super is processing at a run rate of £1.5B and growing 4x YOY

Our Values

  • Customer obsessed: We only succeed when our customers do.
  • Move fast: Build, test and improve quickly. Progress matters more than perfection.
  • Own it: Be accountable, solve problems, and make it happen.
  • Be open: Act with honesty and respect. Transparency builds trust.
  • Win together: Collaboration beats ego every time.

Product Manager - Consumer Experience

The Product team sits at the centre of that mission. We move fast, challenge everything, and build experiences that make people wonder why the old way ever existed. We're not here to iterate on the status quo — we're here to blow it up and replace it with something better.

This is a rare opportunity to build with AI-native tools and cutting-edge technology from day one. Our PMs don't just spec features — they shape how millions of people interact with their money. That means thinking bigger, moving faster, and refusing to accept "that's just how it works" as an answer.

We need someone who thrives on ambiguity, picks fights with convention, and brings a relentless hunger to solve problems that actually matter. You'll shape the roadmap  working across Commercial, Operations, Design, Engineering, and Data to ship world-class web and mobile experiences, including the checkout and payment flows that sit at the very core of what we do.

The playbook for the future of payments hasn't been written yet. Come help us write it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Shaping the roadmap — obsessing over the right problems, defining audacious success metrics, and making sure decisions are commercial and made with the customer in mind 
  • Driving impact that's measurable, meaningful, and repeatable based on data, market research, customer insight and conviction 
  • Taking products from zero to one and beyond — ideation, development, launch, growth, and the relentless optimisation that follows
  • Pushing Engineering to move fast and build right — leading on technical approach, requirements, and delivery without ever losing sight of the bigger picture
  • Partnering with Design and UX to create web and mobile experiences that are simple yet transformative
  • Obsessing over checkout and conversion flows — running bold experiments, letting go of what doesn't work, and doubling down on what does
  • Cutting through complexity with stakeholders across Marketing, Legal, Financial Crime, and Strategy — aligning fast and moving faster

Requirements 

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • 10+ years of product management experience working on consumer focused features with a track record of taking features from zero to one 
  • Direct experience working on consumer features, e.g. consumer checkout, apps, consumer fintech,  — you understand how conversion and  drop-off can trade off against each other, and you've moved the needle on them. This is a consumer product role, not a back end payments / infrastructure or B2B platform position. 
  • Experience working with Engineering: you can write a clear spec, argue technical trade-offs, and make the call when there's no clean answer
  • Sharp with data — you define success metrics and are able to analyse all data related to your features 
  • A bias for shipping: an 80%-right version this week beats a 100%-right version next quarter
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, able to bring engineers, designers, and non-technical stakeholders onto the same page
  • Genuine curiosity about your product with real opinions on how to continually improve it
  • You’ve shipped and grown a product used by tens/hundreds of thousands of consumers (E-commerce, retail marketplaces, subscription, fintech gaming, or media) 
  • Credit experience is a plus.

*The stated experience and background is a guide and does not preclude applications from candidates with more or less experience, provided the requisite skills can be demonstrated.

Our Benefits - here’s a few and more to come ….

  • Tax advantage Share Options
  • Flexible working model
  • Work from home set up
  • Learning & Development opportunities
  • Contributory Pension Scheme
  • Free Team lunch (Tues & Thurs) and social evenings
  • Comprehensive PMI & x4 Life Insurance
  • Your birthday off, plus one Revival day

If you are excited about sharing the adventure, joining a growing team with big ambitions and you are really great at what you do, then apply now!

Senior Data Engineer

Role Overview

We run an event-driven data platform on AWS and Snowflake. Events flow from our product services through EventBridge, Kinesis Firehose, S3, and are auto-ingested into Snowflake via Snowpipe; batch and third-party data lands through Snowpark-deployed Python procedures. All infrastructure is defined in Terraform/Terragrunt. Python (Poetry, Pydantic, pytest) is our pipeline language; GitHub Actions runs CI/CD. Datadog gives us end-to-end pipeline observability.

Key Responsibilities

Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering

  • Event Pipeline Ownership: Build and evolve the EventBridge → Firehose → S3 → Snowpipe ingestion path, including partitioning and throughput tuning as event volumes grow across streams like fraud, payments and merchant.
  • Batch & Third-Party Integrations: Design and deploy Snowpark-based Python procedures for file-based and third-party data loads, scheduled and monitored as Snowflake Tasks.
  • Schema Evolution: Work with product engineers to manage upstream schema changes and late-arriving data without breaking downstream consumers.

Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Infrastructure as Code: Own and extend Terraform/Terragrunt modules for ingestion infrastructure across multiple environments.
  • Pipeline Observability: Design Datadog monitors and alerting for Firehose, EventBridge, DLQs and Snowpipe; triage and resolve ingestion failures.
  • Security & Compliance: Manage PII handling (hashing, secure deletion), masking, data governance and access in Snowflake. Support audit-ready, reconciled data for Finance and Compliance.

Data Pipelines & Data Quality

  • Dbt: Build privacy-first data pipelines using dbt and Snowflake Dynamic Tables to safely expose sensitive data for downstream analytics and reporting.
  • Data Quality: Build testing and monitoring for ingestion and transformation logic to catch issues before they reach the business or the Analytics Engineering team.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with the wider Engineering team and Analytics Engineering team as a downstream consumer, to ensure pipelines deliver accurate, audit-ready data.

Requirements

We'd love it if you have

  • AWS & Event-Driven Architecture: Hands-on experience with streaming/event ingestion (Kinesis, EventBridge or equivalents), S3 partitioning, and queue/DLQ patterns.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform experience required; Terragrunt a plus. Comfortable owning modules across environments, not just consuming them.
  • Snowflake & Warehouse Engineering: Strong SQL for Snowflake, including Snowpipe, Tasks and Snowpark.
  • Dbt: Proven experience in building well tested SQL and python models in dbt.
  • CI/CD & Data Security: Experience with GitHub Actions (or equivalent), and secrets/key management, PII and sensitive data handling in Snowflake.
  • Python Coding: Python skills for pipeline and infrastructure code (typed models, testing, CI-deployed services),  not just scripting or analysis.

Engineering Ownership

Technical Communication: A pragmatic, systems-level mindset with the ability to explain pipeline failures, infrastructure trade-offs, or data-flow issues clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ownership & Initiative: A strong willingness to work independently, take initiative, and take full ownership of the pipelines and infrastructure you build, from design and implementation through to production reliability.
  • Production Mindset: Proactively monitoring, debugging, and improving pipelines and infrastructure in production, not just building them and moving on.

CORPORATE INTELLIGENCE EXPERIENCED CASE MANAGER - FORMER SOVIET UNION, LONDON

S-RM is seeking an experienced Case Manager to join the Former Soviet Union team within our Corporate Intelligence division, based in our London offices.

 

WHO ARE WE

S-RM is a global intelligence and cyber security consultancy. Since 2005, we’ve helped companies, governments and private individuals solve some of their most complex challenges.

We’ve been able to do this because of our outstanding people. We’re committed to developing sharp, curious, enthusiastic people who want to think critically, solve complex problems, and achieve success.

But we also know that work isn’t everything. It’s about the lives and careers it helps us build. We’re immensely proud of this culture and we invest in our people’s wellbeing, learning, and ideas every day. 

We’re excited you’re thinking about joining us.

 

THE ROLE

The successful candidate will play a leading role in the management and delivery of a range of complex corporate intelligence matters relating to the Former Soviet Union region. They will combine strong investigative expertise, project management, and client relationship skills to deliver high-quality project work for our clients.

 

The key areas of responsibility will be:

  • Manage a broad range of complex investigative engagements from initial scoping through to delivery, ensuring projects are complete to a high standard and within agreed timelines.
  • Analyse information from a wide range of sources to produce accurate and well supported findings. 
  • Conduct human source enquiries across the Former Soviet Union, consistently building the team’s regional network.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with our clients, including presenting findings via verbal briefings and presentations to senior stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for additional project work and contribute to the growth if existing client relationships.
  • Play a key role in developing S-RM’s research capabilities, knowledge base, and professional network across the Former Soviet Union region.
  • Mentor and support analysts, sharing expertise and promoting high-quality investigative standards across the team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of investigative best practice.

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We nurture a culture of equality, diversity and inclusion and we are dedicated to developing a workforce that displays a variety of talents, experiences and perspectives. Candidates with the following qualifications and experience are likely to succeed in our Former Soviet Union team at S-RM.

 

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in the Corporate Intelligence/Strategic Intelligence industry.
  • Proven ability to read and research to a high-standard in Russian is required.
  • Proficiency in further foreign languages is also desirable.
  • Experience leading on complex engagements, including in-depth due diligence assignments, high-stakes investigations, and market entry analyses, with a strong focus on jurisdictions in the Former Soviet Union/Central Eastern Europe.
  • Deep understanding of political, economic, commercial and legal dynamics across the Former Soviet Union region.
  • Excellent open source research skills and confidence in conducting regional human source enquiries.
  • Proven ability to effectively plan, staff, and manage Corporate Intelligence projects of varying complexities within budget and timelines, as well as being accountable for the work of other team members, quality assurance, and client deliverables.
  • Demonstrable experience in client communication and relationship building, including request scoping, project proposals, day-to-day client management.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including experience providing clear and constructive feedback to team members. 
  • Experience in mentoring and managing junior colleagues, sharing best practice, and upholding quality standards.

All candidates must have permission to work in the UK by the start of their employment. The role will be based in our London office, with a hybrid working arrangement requiring two days per week in the office.

 

OUR BENEFITS

We offer thoughtful, balanced rewards and support to help our people do their best work and live their lives outside it, this includes but is not exhaustive of:

  • 25 days holiday per year increasing to 30 days (+1 day for every year you worked at S-RM, up to a maximum of 5 days) in addition to bank holidays
  • Private medical insurance with Vitality (taxable benefit, tax is taken from monthly pay)  - access to private healthcare, as well as to a great range of various discounts and rewards
  • Virtual GP and Second Medical Opinion services – timely access to medical advice 24/7, 365 days a year, open to you and your family members that live in the same household
  • Various gym discounts for you and your partner , including 50% of with Virgin Active, Pure Gym and Nuffield Health Gyms
  • Dental insurance with BUPA (taxable benefit, tax is taken from monthly pay) 
  • Life insurance – 4x annual salary
  • Pension – up to 7% contribution matched by the company. Contribution is taken from gross pay – tax relief is applied automatically
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) for employees and immediate family, including counselling sessions
  • Free access to the world-famous mindfulness app Headspace 
  • Free mortgage support services
  • Access to online discount hub, saving on shopping, insurance, dining and more 
  • Seasonal flu vaccination
  • Eye tests and glasses reimbursement up to certain cost on an annual basis
  • Formalised Recognition programme 
  • Hybrid working and flexible working hours
  • Fertility treatment leave – 5 days of leave per cycle of treatment per year

After successful probation period:

  • Season ticket loan – deducted from payroll over 12 months
  • Cycle to work scheme – up to £4,000 salary sacrifice deducted over 12 months 

At a later stage:

  • Maternity leave – 26 weeks of full pay followed by 13 weeks of half pay (after 1 year at the company on the “qualifying week” = 15 weeks before a due date)
  • Paternity leave – 6 weeks of full pay (after 1 year at the company on the “qualifying week” = 15 weeks before a due date)

At The Brattle Group, we bridge the gap between economic theory and real-world application, helping clients make informed decisions in areas such as corporate finance, energy, competition, and regulatory economics.

WHAT IS ECONOMIC CONSULTING?

Economic consulting involves using economic theories, quantitative methods, and data analysis to address legal and business challenges. Consultants work on high-stakes projects, providing advice to law firms, corporations, and government agencies. Our work influences major decisions and outcomes in legal cases and business strategies worldwide.

RESEARCH ANALYST – INTERNATIONAL ARBITRATION  

We are looking for intellectually curious, collaborative individuals with strong quantitative skills to join our International Arbitration practice in London, starting as soon as possible. As a Research Analyst (RA), you will contribute to complex and challenging projects from the start, working alongside senior consultants, leading industry experts, and global law firms.

Brattle offers a diverse, stimulating, and collegial environment, where you will have opportunities to develop your analytical and technical skills. Your career will begin with structured training in Brattle’s best practices for economic and financial modelling, coding, and analytical problem-solving. You will continue to develop your expertise through hands-on project experience and ongoing professional training.

Typical Responsibilities

  • Analysing complex datasets to identify trends and insights
  • Constructing economic and financial models
  • Researching economic and financial issues relevant to international disputes
  • Understanding the debate around key economic developments
  • Analysing companies and markets
  • Presenting findings in a compelling way

WHY BRATTLE? 

  • Work in a collaborative, intellectually stimulating environment alongside experts in the field.
  • Benefit from ongoing professional development and training opportunities.
  • Be part of a diverse and dynamic team within a globally recognised firm.

RA CAREER DEVELOPMENT

At The Brattle Group, your career growth is a priority. As an RA, you will gain valuable skills in applied economics and finance. You'll discover your strengths and interests, and how to best apply your skills. You will be paired with a peer-level buddy and a manager-level career advisor to help you make the most of your time at Brattle. You will develop practical experience in conducting economic research, writing and revising code, collaborating on analytical projects, and communicating findings clearly and concisely.   • A master’s degree in economics or another quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.

  • Intellectual curiosity and creativity. We are looking for candidates who consistently want to learn more and approach problems with creativity.

Additionally, we look for candidates who:

  • Demonstrate creative problem-solving skills and can communicate complex concepts effectively
