• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You…

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

 

The Role

We're building local Enterprise Sales Pods across global markets — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in the UK and Ireland. This is not a remote overlay on an existing territory. You will own a named-account list of 30–40 enterprise accounts across the UK and Ireland, and your job is to turn those accounts into production Telnyx customers.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated FDE — not a demo resource, but a technical partner who designs architectures, builds POCs, and gets the first workload live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

This is a founding role. You'll help define how Telnyx sells into enterprise accounts in the UK and Ireland, set the playbook, and build the references that the next wave of hires will follow.

The Pod Model

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do

• Own a territory of 30–40 named enterprise accounts across the UK and Ireland, narrowing to ~10 Tier 1 accounts worth $1M+ in annual potential
• Build executive relationships — get in the room with CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering, and line-of-business owners
• Run the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, design the commercial architecture with your FDE, negotiate, and close
• Sell production outcomes, not individual products — lead with "let's deploy an AI agent that operates your SOC or NOC workflow," not "which Telnyx products do you want?"
• Agree the commercial destination before any custom work begins — no free discovery or free development
• Maintain disciplined POC management: every POC has a named executive sponsor, written success criteria, production pricing discussed, a decision date, and a signed commercial document. POCs end in production or they end
• Expand the account — one workload becomes three, one $500K customer becomes a $2M customer
• Build local references and case studies across London and Dublin
• Provide accurate pipeline reporting and forecasting — no surprises

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of enterprise sales experience selling into the UK and/or Irish market — CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecom, AI/ML, or similarly technical infrastructure
• Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota ($1M+ deals)
• Experience selling to both executive and technical buyers — you can hold your own in the boardroom and in the architecture review
• Hunter mentality — you build your own pipeline and thrive on outbound, in-person selling
• Strong consultative selling skills: can build a clear, compelling ROI story for both technical and business buyers
• Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, etc.)
• Comfortable with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, etc.)
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You listen before you pitch.
• Willingness to be in the field — visiting customers in person is a core part of this role
• Based in London, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across the UK and Ireland

Bonus Points For

• Fortune 500 or large enterprise new business sales experience in the UK or Ireland
• Complex sales cycles including RFPs, POCs, and competitive bake-offs
• C-Level selling experience — you can navigate procurement, security, and legal complexity, including UK enterprises (BT Group, Vodafone UK, Lloyds Banking Group, HSBC, Barclays, Tesco, Unilever, BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce) and Irish enterprises (Eir, Ryanair, Kerry Group, Smurfit Kappa, AIB, CRH)
• Understanding of SIP trunking, phone number provisioning, carrier networks, or AI/ML platforms
• Established relationships in the London enterprise ecosystem — fintech, telecom, media, healthcare, insurance, or SaaS
• Experience with UK public sector and government procurement frameworks (G-Cloud, Crown Commercial Service)
• Irish language skills or existing relationships in the Dublin enterprise ecosystem

Milton Keynes (Hybrid) | Comms365

Comms365 is a UK-based provider of resilient, always-on business connectivity — 4G/5G, fixed-line, bonded Internet, SD-WAN, and network security — for organisations that simply can't afford downtime. The New Business Development Manager will play a key role in the growth of Comms365. The primary objective will be to identify and engage with prospective new logo direct customers in our target markets and on-board these successfully as new customers.

The role will involve developing a sustainable pipeline of new business sales opportunities for our core services of cellular and satellite connectivity solutions, by various means including: following up campaign activity, pursuing leads generated by an internal SDR team, identifying and engaging with target accounts who meet our ideal customer profile, attending industry and networking events.

Ultimately the role is responsible for achieving a sales target that will allow the business to meet its financial year budget and growth plans year on year.

The role will involve hybrid working from the Comms365 Milton Keynes office, meeting with prospects and customers at their office locations, attending industry events, as well as some home/remote working.

  • Build Direct Customer Base: Identify and engage with target clients who meet our ICP to create and qualify new opportunity, complete win plans, and close new business.
  • Account Development: Once a new customer is on-boarded in some instances where additional opportunities for growth are identified, it may be appropriate for some customers to be retained. In such cases account plans will be completed in full and a clear strategy for developing strong relationships to win more business
  • Data Capture: Ensure all systems are kept updated (ConnectWise, Hubspot etc) in real time with pipeline, account and campaign information.

Join the Wireless Logic Adventure!

Introduction to the Team & Role
What if your team was the one that got to show how an AI-native company runs — and tried it on itself first?
GTM Systems team owns the tools that sales, marketing, customer success and services run on (Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment) and the AI agents, automations and knowledge layer built on top of them. Our mission: take repetitive work off GTM teams so they can spend their time on customers and decisions.
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. An AI and Systems Architect, who sits in the team, owns the technical foundations of our AI stack and Salesforce. Now we need a hands-on leader who turns business needs into shipped AI use cases on top of them.
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams, engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of AI, operations, systems and go-to-market strategy.
Key Responsibility Areas
Build and own the portfolio of AI use cases for the whole GTM with your team, from identifying the business case to building, adoption and ROI, in partnership with Data and Enablement.
Own one functional scope end to end, such as Customer Success or Professional Services: learn how the team works, map its processes, design the solution and build the agents and automations yourself
Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy. Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
Lead and coach 3 senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems
Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
Work hand in hand with the AI and Systems Architect, who owns the technical design, tool choices and standards: bring the business needs, challenge the design and build within those standards.
Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

job-boards.greenhouse.io/viralnation/job.description_excerpt:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

Position Overview:

The Account Manager plays a pivotal role in the day-to-day execution of client programs, working in partnership with the Client Services teams and our COE (Center of Excellence) to execute social-first marketing strategies built to deliver on client goals. Account Managers are stewards of the VN process and proactively manage the campaign execution. They display exceptional time management and organizational skills and thrive on adaptability, assignments, and tight deadlines. The Account Manager is responsible for successful project delivery and coordinates with junior staff from project initiation to successful campaign execution and delivery. 

Please Note: This role would be a 3-month contract. Must be located in United Kingdom.

Responsibilities:

  • Own day-to-day creator and client communication across assigned workstreams, driving tactical execution and ensuring all deliverables, reporting, and touchpoints are proactive, accurate, and on time
  • Support and execute end-to-end influencer marketing campaigns, primarily focused on Micro and Mid-Tier talent, including influencer activation, content/social execution, and community management from kickoff through wrap.
  • Support production and on-site or remote shoots as needed, including coordination with creators, vendors, and internal teams to ensure smooth execution
  • Maintain and manage data entry & collection for assigned creators, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and on-time submission
  • Support the development of wrap reports, performance summaries, and post-campaign insights
  • Proactively identify and escalate risks, issues, or dependencies to the manager with recommended solutions
  • Support growth and upsell initiatives, including drafting pitch materials, decks, and value-add messaging
  • Prepare client-facing materials such as meeting agendas and recaps, weekly status reports, and performance insights
  • Contribute to quarterly and annual planning, renewals, and year-in-review documentation
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders to support effective execution
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve execution efficiency, reporting accuracy, creator communication, and workflow management

Qualifications and Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience in advertising, influencer marketing, social media, or related services roles
  • Bachelor’s degree required, with a background in marketing, communications, or a related discipline strongly preferred
  • Experience working within inter-agency teams (IATs) and cross-functional environments
  • Hands-on experience with social media platforms and tools, paired with a strong understanding of influencer marketing best practices
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tactical workstreams, delegate effectively, and review junior team members’ work with accuracy and accountability
  • Proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable managing up to ensure alignment and progress

Privacy Policy: 

By submitting your application, you acknowledge your data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. 

Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.
 
AI in Recruitment:
 
Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/thequalitygr.description_excerpt:
Start: Immediately | Level: Head of | Location: remote | Working hours: Full-time (40h/week)

Take ownership of the category strategy for Hydration for a leading brand in functional nutrition.
We are looking for an experienced product marketing professional to take end-to-end responsibility for our Hydration products and strategy. The focus is on growth in the Ready-to-Drink segment and in food retail. Start as soon as possible, on a remote contract with monthly on-site days at our office in Germany.

 

Your mission with us

  • You take full ownership of the Hydration category. You manage the existing portfolio and innovation pipeline and define the strategy for further growth – particularly in the Ready-to-Drink segment and in food retail
  • You develop go-to-market strategies and marketing campaigns across relevant channels, ensuring smooth execution and continuous performance monitoring
  • You work closely with cross-functional teams – particularly Product Development and Sales – to bring new products to market in line with brand positioning
  • You keep track of market trends, consumer insights, and competitive developments, translating data into actionable growth opportunities
  • You drive excellent product launches by creating comprehensive rollout plans and coordinating all related activities across departments
  • You are responsible for product-related budgets, develop pricing and forecast models, and analyze performance metrics to support strategic decisions

 

Your experience & skills

  • You hold a degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus
  • You bring 6+ years of experience in product marketing management in the FMCG industry
  • You have experience working for a hydration / beverage brand
  • You have a proven track record of managing products across the full lifecycle – from idea to launch and beyond
  • You are skilled in portfolio strategy, consumer segmentation, and product positioning
  • You know how to plan and implement impactful go-to-market and activation strategies – including pricing and distribution
  • You think analytically, enjoy working with data, and are confident in market research, financial analysis, and planning
  • You communicate clearly, present ideas persuasively, and work effectively with different teams and levels of hierarchy
  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced, agile environment and take ownership to deliver strong results

 

Why choose us?

Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,200 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.

You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, Amsterdam, London, and Elsdorf, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • 50% on our product portfolio at ESN & More Nutrition
  • Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass
  • Up to 60 Workation days per year
  • Corporate benefits
  • 28 days vacation/year
  • and much more

 

About Us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.

This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!
We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!

Take ownership of the category strategy for Protein Powders for a leading brand in functional nutrition.
We are looking for an experienced product marketing professional to take end-to-end responsibility for our protein powder products and strategy. The focus is on growth in the protein powders segment and in food retail. Start as soon as possible, on a remote contract with monthly on-site days at our office in Germany.

 

Your mission with us

WorldQuant develops and deploys systematic financial strategies across a broad range of asset classes and global markets. We seek to produce high-quality predictive signals (alphas) through our proprietary research platform to employ financial strategies focused on market inefficiencies. Our teams work collaboratively to drive the production of alphas and financial strategies – the foundation of a balanced, global investment platform.

WorldQuant is built on a culture that pairs academic sensibility with accountability for results. Employees are encouraged to think openly about problems, balancing intellectualism and practicality. Excellent ideas come from anyone, anywhere. Employees are encouraged to challenge conventional thinking and possess an attitude of continuous improvement.

Our goal is to hire the best and the brightest. We value intellectual horsepower first and foremost, and people who demonstrate an outstanding talent. There is no roadmap to future success, so we need people who can help us build it.

Technologists at WorldQuant research, design, code, test and deploy firmwide platforms and tooling while working collaboratively with researchers and portfolio managers. Our environment is relaxed yet intellectually driven. We seek people who think in code and are motivated by being around like-minded people.

The Role: Our group is responsible for building software enabling both the large-scale quantitative research operations that drive WorldQuant’s platform and the production of our portfolio. The team is currently embarking on a multi-year journey to provide a powerful, scalable, and efficient platform to drive the firm’s next decade of growth. We are looking for someone who can own some of the unique technical challenges inherent in the problem and who can bring solid experience and perspective to the team.

What You’ll Bring:

A successful candidate will possess:

  • A minimum of 5 years of writing production-quality code in C++ on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Python language with development experience 
  • Strong understanding and experience with Linux system programming fundamentals
  • Ability to develop large-scale, distributed systems
  • Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, high-performance application design, and concurrency patterns.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal direction
  • Proficiency in English

An outstanding candidate will also have experience with one or more of:

  • Developing systems for managing and performing computation on large-scale graph data
  • Streaming / dataflow systems
  • Candidates need not have prior experience in financial services.

jobs.lever.co/global-cxm/32dba860-4e76-4.description_excerpt:
As our Regional Operations Manager, you’ll be responsible for leading, coordinating, and delivering commissioning and technical operations across multiple projects within their assigned regions in mainland Europe.
You will ensure that all technical, operational, and delivery activities are executed safely, efficiently, consistently, and in line with company standards, contractual requirements, and client expectations.
You will provide technical authority, operational leadership, and oversight of site-based teams, acting as the primary link between regional project delivery and senior management.
It is essential that you have the flexibility to travel into Europe every week or ideally you will be already based in Europe with the flexibility to travel around EU without restrictions.
Key Areas of Responsibility
Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership, direction, and oversight to all site-based commissioning and operations teams within the region.
Act as the senior technical authority for commissioning activities on assigned projects.
Set and enforce technical standards, methodologies, and best practices across all sites.
Lead by example through active participation in technical discussions, troubleshooting, and decision-making.
Support site teams in resolving complex commissioning, integration, and performance issues.
Project and Operational Management
Work closely with Project Managers and key stakeholders to define project scope, milestones, and deliverables.
Develop, monitor, and maintain regional delivery plans, schedules, and resource forecasts.
Ensure projects are delivered in line with contractual, technical, and commercial requirements.
Oversee progress, risks, and constraints, implementing corrective actions where required.
Ensure consistency of execution and reporting across all projects in the region.
Technical Governance and Quality
Ensure that all commissioning activities comply with company procedures, industry standards, and client requirements.
Review, approve, and contribute to technical documentation, including test procedures, commissioning plans, reports, and handover documentation.
Ensure technical risks are identified, managed, and mitigated.
Support audits, quality reviews, and lessons-learned activities across the region.
Client and Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a senior technical and operational point of contact for clients within the region.
Understand client technical requirements and ensure they are incorporated into project delivery.
Provide clear, accurate, and timely communication on progress, risks, and technical matters.
Manage client expectations and contribute to maintaining high levels of client satisfaction.
Support the resolution of client issues and escalation of major concerns.
Continuous Improvement and Industry Awareness
Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, and commissioning best practices.
Drive improvements in tools, processes, and methodologies across the region.
Support the development and refinement of company technical and operational standards
Health, Safety and Compliance
Ensure that all operations are carried out in compliance with health, safety, environmental, and company policies.
Promote a strong safety culture across all sites.
Ensure that risks are assessed and controlled before and during all site activities.
This outlines the principal responsibilities and accountabilities of the role. It is not intended to be exhaustive, and the post holder may be required to undertake other duties commensurate with the level of responsibility and within their competence to support the wider organisation.
Education
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services, or related engineering discipline.
Postgraduate qualification in Engineering or Project / Operations Management is desirable.
Formal training or certification in data centre or mission-critical commissioning, project management, and health & safety is desirable.
Skills and Experience (Data Centre Commissioning)
Strong technical knowledge of mission-critical data centre systems, including electrical power, mechanical cooling, controls, and integrated systems.
Proven experience leading data centre commissioning activities, including Level 1–5 commissioning and Integrated Systems Testing (IST).
Sound understanding of redundancy, resilience, and maintainability concepts (N, N+1, 2N).
Ability to review, approve, and author commissioning plans, test procedures, and handover documentation.
Experience managing commissioning activities in live or operational data centre environments.
Knowledge of relevant data centre standards and frameworks (e.g. Tier concepts, EN 50600, TIA-942).
Strong leadership and coordination skills across multi-disciplinary teams and multiple sites.
Effective communication skills with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
Structured approach to risk management, technical problem-solving, and decision making.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/certa/9c72f633-6543-43c.description_excerpt:
Certa (certa.ai http://certa.ai) is an AI-native third-party risk management platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle, from onboarding through continuous monitoring and offboarding. Enterprises from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups use our no-code platform to manage vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. Trusted by Honeywell, Uber, MARS, and Boeing, we've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries.
We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software implementations. This is a client-facing role at the center of every engagement: you'll translate what a customer needs into a plan, drive a cross-functional team to build it, and keep both sides aligned from kickoff to go-live and beyond. You won't just track tasks, you'll understand the product deeply, engage in technical conversations with solution architects and engineers, lead the business requirement sessions, and make the decisions that keep delivery on track. The best person for this role thinks like an owner of the account, not a coordinator of it.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own delivery end to end: Run enterprise implementation projects from kickoff through go-live and stabilization, accountable for scope, timeline, budget, quality, and client satisfaction on every engagement you lead.
- Build & manage the plan: Break down complex, ambiguous requirements into a clear project plan with phases, milestones, dependencies, and owners, keeping it current and making trade-offs visible when reality shifts.
- Lead requirements gathering: Own the business requirement sessions end to end, facilitating discovery workshops that surface what the client actually needs, documenting requirements in a structured, unambiguous format, managing sign-off, and keeping them traceable through design, build, and testing.
- Run the cross-functional team: Coordinate solution architects, engineers, QA, and client stakeholders toward a shared outcome, removing blockers, resolving conflicts, and making sure everyone knows what they own and by when.
- Own the client relationship: Be the client's primary point of contact, leading status meetings, steering committee updates, and escalations, setting expectations early, and protecting the relationship even during hard conversations.
- Manage scope, risk & change: Hold the line on scope creep, documenting and quantifying changes before work starts, and manage risks and issues proactively with a live view of mitigation plans and early escalation.
- Stay technical, report & improve: Understand the architecture, integrations, and configuration decisions well enough to challenge estimates and speak credibly with engineers and technical buyers, produce honest, easy-to-read status reports and executive updates, and feed lessons learned back into delivery methodology.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- On-target delivery: Projects land on time, on budget, and within scope, with a clear plan stakeholders trust.
- Trusted clients: Clients feel informed and in control throughout the engagement, and would take your call for the next one.
- Managed risk: Risks surface early and get managed, so escalations are rare and never a surprise.
- Aligned team & clean handoffs: The delivery team is aligned, unblocked, and clear on priorities, and handoffs to support and account teams are clean, with nothing left undocumented.
WHAT YOU'LL NEED
- Experience: 5+ years managing technical or software implementation projects, ideally in enterprise SaaS, professional services, or a client-facing delivery environment, with a track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within budget as the primary delivery owner for enterprise clients.
- Technical fluency: You can read a solution design, understand integrations and data flows, and hold your own in a technical discussion without being the engineer.
- Requirements & delivery craft: Proven ability to run requirements and discovery sessions and translate them into clear, documented business requirements, plus solid command of project management fundamentals (planning, estimation, dependency management, risk and issue tracking, and change control).
- Stakeholder management: Excellent communication, comfort presenting to senior and executive audiences, and the ability to manage scope, timelines, and difficult conversations without losing the relationship.
- Ways of working: Organized and calm under pressure, you over-communicate rather than under-communicate, you're direct when a project needs a hard truth and diplomatic when a relationship needs care, and you own outcomes rather than pointing to a process.
- Preferred: An earlier technical role (engineering, solution architecture, or implementation consulting); experience delivering configurable enterprise platforms or workflow/automation software; fluency in both agile and traditional delivery and the judgment to know when to use which; experience in a regulated or risk-sensitive domain; PMP, PRINCE2, PSM, or equivalent certification; and exposure to AI-assisted or modern delivery tooling.
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
- Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity
- Time off: 49 days paid time off
- Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans
- Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus
- Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world
LOCATION
Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:
- London
- San Francisco
- Jaipur
The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.
WHY CERTA
- Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.
- Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.
- A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.
- Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.
We're excited to meet you!

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions.
You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.
Join us and make an impact!
About the Role
3E is growing, and with the recent acquisition of the Yordas Group, we have an exciting opportunity to shape how our UK teams come together and work as part of a broader global organization. We’re looking for an experienced HR Manager who can play a key role in integration today while helping build the strong, scalable HR practices that will support our teams well beyond the transition.
As a trusted, hands-on partner to employees and leaders, you’ll help people navigate change while ensuring day-to-day HR operations run effectively. Looking beyond the integration, you’ll work closely with colleagues across our global HR organization to strengthen people practices, improve processes and systems, and contribute to regional and global initiatives as the role evolves.
This role requires a regular presence in our Lancaster office, with a minimum of three days onsite each week. Being close to the teams you support will help you build strong relationships, understand the local organization and culture, and provide responsive, effective HR support.
If you enjoy building relationships, improving how things work, and helping people navigate change, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution during an important transition and help shape the future of HR operations at 3E.
What You’ll Do
- Serve as a trusted HR advisor to UK employees, managers, and leaders on employee relations, performance management, absence, grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace investigations.
- Help employees and managers navigate organizational changes, including integration activities, new HR processes, benefits changes, communications, and culture initiatives.
- Manage complex employee relations matters with appropriate judgment, documentation, and alignment with UK employment law and company policies.
- Oversee key HR operations across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, leave administration, benefits, and employee records.
- Serve as a UK subject matter resource for payroll-related legislation and statutory requirements, partnering with Finance, the regional HR team, and external payroll providers.
- Manage regional HR and benefits vendors, resolving issues and helping ensure employees receive responsive, high-quality support.
- Maintain and improve HR policies, procedures, employee resources, and documentation in line with employment legislation and business needs.
- Monitor changes in employment legislation and help ensure HR practices remain compliant.
- Maintain accurate HRIS data and employee records and support HR reporting and analysis.
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, local leadership, and regional HR colleagues on employment, compliance, recruitment, payroll, and people initiatives.
- Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes, systems, and workflows.
- Create and maintain SOPs and share knowledge across the HR team to strengthen consistency and business continuity.
- Contribute to regional and global HR projects as the organization continues to grow and evolve.
What Makes You a Great Fit
Required
- 10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 2–3 years of HR Manager-level experience supporting regional or multi-country HR operations.
- Strong knowledge of UK employment law and HR practices, with the ability to translate requirements into practical guidance for employees and managers.
- Significant hands-on employee relations experience, including managing complex or sensitive employee matters.
- Experience independently managing complex HR processes with strong attention to accuracy and compliance.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience advising and supporting managers.
- Comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment and collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies.
- Able to navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and organizational change while exercising sound judgment.
- A continuous-improvement mindset with experience identifying and implementing improvements to HR processes.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential information.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Copilot to improve the efficiency or quality of your work.
- Fluency in written and spoken English.
- Ability to work from our Lancaster office a minimum of three days per week.
Preferred
- CIPD or equivalent qualification.
- Additional language skills, such as Turkish, German, or French.
- Experience supporting HR operations in a high-growth, matrixed organization.
- Experience contributing to or leading HR projects and initiatives in a dynamic, global environment.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/adaption/3acd56ba-3085-.description_excerpt:
ABOUT US
Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.
Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.
HOW WE WORK
- Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate.
- Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.
- Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.
THE ROLE
Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.
A modelling residency puts you in the center of a frontier lab. You'll be embedded in real work: placed on key production and research projects and mentored directly by our modelling team. We're building our frontier innovation around efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. By the end of this 8-month residency, our hope is that you leave with a track record you're proud to put on your resume and experiences that meaningfully upskill you.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Innovation: Build the future of adaptive algorithms that continuously learn. Co-design algorithms that react in real-time to product signal and feedback, and explore new ways of capturing feedback that make those algorithms better
- Cross-stack optimization: Collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to drive system-wide efficiency gains
- Measure what matters: We believe the ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. The smartest algorithm is one capable of interacting with the world — that's why product signal matters so much to how we work.
SKILLS YOU'LL BRING
We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:
- A degree or equivalent research/engineering experience in a computer science field.
- Genuine interest in, and at least one project touching: model efficiency, synthetic data, interfaces, real-time alignment, or algorithmic optimization
- Systems thinking — the ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack
- Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)
- Familiarity with model optimization techniques such as RLHF and fine-tuning
- Strong communication and self-awareness — you know how to collaborate in a remote environment and you're open to feedback
- You care about technical excellence and last mile impact. We value impact more than effort, and about owning outcomes end to end.
We value impact over credentials. Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to check every box - but you do need to be adaptable.
WHAT WE OFFER
- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
- Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.
- Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.
- Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.
- Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.
- Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

- Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.
- Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.
THE ROLE
Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.
This is a research role focused on building models that continuously evolve with the world. Our frontier work centers on efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. The most intelligent systems will increasingly be defined not just by what they know, but by how well they can interact with the world. For the first time, researchers who care deeply about intelligence and efficiency must also be obsessed with the interface through which a model acts. If any of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.
Our Research Principles
Sweat the details. Technical excellence requires obsessing over every detail. We co-design serving, algorithms, and interface as one system to maximize efficiency and enable real-time adaptation.
Move with conviction. Extraordinary results require extraordinary effort. We operate with urgency as a unified team, concentrating resources on a few high-conviction bets where research and impact intersect.
Metrics that matter. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. Research ideas are tested through working products. If it doesn't improve what users can do, we question whether it matters. We share what moves the field; we don't optimize for paper count.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Innovation: You have ideas and you move fast. You care about impact, not just effort.
- Cross-stack optimization: You collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to unlock system-wide efficiency gains.
- Measure what matters: The ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. Our current algorithms are capable of interacting with the world which is why product thinking is inseparable from research.
SKILLS YOU'LL BRING
We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:
- A PhD or equivalent research experience in a computer science field
- 4-5+ years of industry experience
- Publishing record at ICML, NeurIPS, ACL, ICLR, EMNLP.
- Deep expertise in at least one area: model efficiency, real time alignment or algorithmic optimization
- Systems thinking ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack
- Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)
- Knowledge of model optimization techniques (RLHF, finetuning)
- Experience in an industry lab with computing at scale
Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box.
WHAT WE OFFER
- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
- Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.
- Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.
- Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.
- Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.
- Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

About Adexis
Adexis is a London-based frontier research lab solving dexterous manipulation. Our mission is to bring machines the power of touch on the path to physical general intelligence, bringing about a future of abundance.
We are building a lean, talent dense organisation, inspired by history's great groups — the Manhattan Project, Apollo, Bell Labs, Skunkworks — where aggregating outlier individuals drove collective output that changed history.
We are backed by leading investors, and researchers from Anthropic, ElevenLabs, Google Deepmind and more.
Member of Technical Staff — Research
As a founding research hire, you could work across pre or post-training for our visuo-tactile foundation model. This might include:
- Own the model architecture end to end: how visual and tactile signals are tokenized, fused or kept separate, and learned jointly.
- Make the hard representational calls: what a contact signal is at the token level, how it aligns in time with vision, and how the two modalities trade off when they disagree.
- Own the post-training stack: how we adapt a pretrained model into a control policy using teleoperated demonstration data.
- Design the recipe: demonstration collection strategy, imitation and any reinforcement or self-improvement stages, and the full sequence from foundation model to deployable policy.
- Close the sim-to-real and human-to-robot gaps: make a policy learned from human demonstration survive contact with the real world.
- Define what good behaviour is and build the evaluation that catches a policy that looks good offline and fails on hardware.
You might be a fit if you
- Have trained large multimodal or sequence models from scratch and owned the recipe — the data mix, curricula, ablations, debugging silent failures.
- Have strong instincts for multimodal fusion.
- Have trained manipulation policies and put them on real hardware — you know the specific pain of a policy that demos well and dies on contact.
- Know imitation learning deeply and know when reinforcement is worth the instability.
- Have a point of view on learning dexterous, contact-rich skills rather than pick-and-place.
- Bonus: teleoperation systems, learning from human demonstration, real-world RL.
We seek a high ownership individual up to the task of defining this vision. This is a founding research role and will be compensated accordingly with equity.
Compensation & benefits
- Salary: £150–225k
- Equity: 0.5-2.5%
- Private healthcare with AXA
- Top of the line equipment

About Augur
Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.
Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.
Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.
We are looking for an ML Researcher to join our Machine Learning team in London.
This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge research and mission-critical deployment. You will own research directions end-to-end, developing novel algorithms at the intersection of computer vision, deep learning, metric learning, 3D geometry, and vision-language modelling.
You will formulate problems, design experiments, and drive your work from prototype through to production-grade systems that power real-time spatial intelligence across complex environments. We aim to publish at top venues and deploy at scale, and we're looking for researchers who want to do both.
The role includes opportunities to shape Augur's research roadmap, mentor junior researchers and interns, and strengthen our presence in the research community. Work on-site at least two days weekly, specifically one day being a Thursday.
Key Skills
- Academic Track Record: PhD (or Master's with equivalent research experience) in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, or a related discipline. Published work at leading journals or conferences is considered a strong plus.
- Core CV & Spatial AI: Deep expertise in areas such as metric learning, multi-view geometry, depth estimation, 3D scene understanding, rendering techniques, feature-based tracking, self-supervised learning, or learning-based mapping and localisation.
- Engineering Rigor: Strong Python and PyTorch skills; ability to write testable, production-quality code and participate actively in code reviews.
- Autonomy: Capable of independently formulating research problems, defining technical direction, and communicating findings clearly in both writing and discussion.
Accessibility and inclusivity
At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently.
Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you.

At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.
We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.
The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.
The Role
We are looking for a Staff Engineer to own the full-stack development of algo1’s retailer- and brand-facing product suite.
You will be the primary engineering partner to our Head of B2B Product, James, turning ambitious and sometimes ambiguous product ideas into software that retailers and consumer brands rely on to create, launch, and measure campaigns.
This is a product engineering role, not an infrastructure or platform architecture role. You will be responsible for building the core B2B experience that enables retailers and brands to bring their campaigns onto algo1’s in-store product.
The quality of this software directly impacts the shopper experience. It is the layer through which offers and campaigns move from retailers and brands onto the in-store product. Getting this right means helping shoppers discover more relevant content while giving retailers and brands the tools to understand what works.
You will own the customer-facing web application and the backend systems that power it, including campaign creation, offer management, retailer onboarding, permissions, reporting, performance measurement, and the integrations that allow promotional and EPOS data to flow into and out of the platform.
You will work closely with product, design, and platform engineering teams, but you will be accountable for taking the B2B product from early concepts through to customer adoption, continuously improving it as we scale with retailers and brands.
What You'll Own
The most important requirement is clear evidence that you have personally built and shipped complex, customer-facing B2B software used by real customers.
- Own the B2B product area end to end, from early product definition and technical design through implementation, release, and iteration.
- Build intuitive retailer- and brand-facing web experiences using React and TypeScript.
- Develop the backend services and APIs that power campaign creation, management, reporting, and customer administration.
- Act as the senior engineering counterpart to the Head of B2B Product, helping shape scope, resolve ambiguity, set delivery cadence, and make effective product and technical trade-offs.
- Integrate with platform services built by our Platform team, extending them where needed rather than duplicating platform capabilities within the B2B product.
- Own retailer-facing integration touchpoints, including the flow of promotional and EPOS data into the system and campaign or performance data back out to customers.
- Design reliable integrations using APIs, webhooks, authentication, and data synchronisation patterns.
- Build responsive product experiences, including asynchronous and bi-directional interactions where they create meaningful customer value.
- Establish strong engineering standards within the B2B product area while remaining pragmatic about what needs to be built now and what can evolve over time.
- Use modern AI development tools to accelerate prototyping, implementation, testing, and iteration while maintaining strong engineering judgement and quality.

- Product mindset. You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership for what your team puts in front of them, not just the part you wrote.
- API design and evolution. You've designed APIs that other teams and clients depend on, and you understand the trade-offs between clean design, backwards compatibility, and speed.
- Database and schema fluency. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation. Working knowledge of at least one non-relational store.
- Distributed systems experience. You've designed or meaningfully contributed to distributed backend systems, and understand event-driven patterns, asynchronous messaging, and the trade-offs at scale.
- Shipping complex, customer-facing products at pace. Evidence that you can move real software into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.
- Growth and ambition. A career that has moved fast, where you've taken on more scope sooner than the timeline would suggest.
- AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.

- Containers and orchestration. Docker and Kubernetes in production.

Delivering a great platform means product engineers can ship quality, scalable solutions; product, design, and non-technical colleagues can prototype ideas quickly using our application code and production data as a baseline; shoppers have responsive, personalised in-store experiences; and retailers and brands can configure, monitor, and analyse their campaigns across potentially billions of data points.
We're agentic-first. Every engineer has access to frontier AI tooling and our own coding harness, and we expect you to use them to move faster, attempt more ambitious work, and stay fully accountable for what you ship.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, though Staff engineers and ambitious early-career engineers with strong platform instincts will also be considered.
What You'll Own
- Product security. Own authentication across algo1, retailer and brand employees, shoppers, devices, agents, and third-party services, alongside authorisation covering RBAC and ReBAC.
- Release engineering. Develop and maintain reliable, consistent automated release cycles that get changes to production safely and quickly.
- Cloud environments. Manage the environments that support prototyping features across our Android and web applications alongside changes to one or more of our backend microservices.
- API and event-driven architecture. Gatekeep the quality of our APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architecture in an open contributor model.
- Agentic enablement. Continually improve our internal agentic harnesses (skills, context, and tooling) that allow other engineers and less technical colleagues to develop and prototype on our platform.
- Agentic automation. Add agentic automation to all appropriate areas of the platform stack without compromising on quality.
About You
Must Have
- Distributed systems experience. You've designed or meaningfully contributed to distributed backend systems, and understand event-driven patterns, asynchronous messaging, and the trade-offs at scale.
- API design and evolution. You've designed APIs that other teams and clients depend on, and you understand the trade-offs between clean design, backwards compatibility, and speed.
- Database and schema fluency. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimisation. Working knowledge of at least one non-relational store.
- Real-time data. Experience processing or analysing real-time data streams at scale.
- Cloud infrastructure. Experience deploying and operating distributed services on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
- Shipping complex, customer-facing products at pace. Evidence that you can move real software into production quickly, making pragmatic decisions without letting perfection become a blocker.
- Growth and ambition. A career that has moved fast, where you've taken on more scope sooner than the timeline would suggest.
- AI-native engineering. You've shipped production code with frontier AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) and push further into agentic workflows rather than push back on them.
Nice to Have (or We Can Teach)
- Polyglot engineer. Professional software engineering experience across the stack, with your strongest work in the platform, and a portfolio of production systems you've owned end-to-end.
- B2B or enterprise product experience. Background building for business or enterprise customers, where reliability, integrations, and data pipelines matter as much as the interface.
- Product mindset. You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership for what your team puts in front of them, not just the part you wrote.
- Containers and orchestration. Docker and Kubernetes in production.
- Retail or personalisation. Familiarity with retail technology, commerce platforms, or customer personalisation systems.
- Startup experience. Background working at an early-stage startup.
How We Work
We're a startup, so this is a high-intensity environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and love building. If you're happiest when you're creating, experimenting, and moving fast, you'll love it here.
We draw our energy from being together, so this is an office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from building together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it's easy to get to and a great place to build.
What We Offer
- Direct access to our founders and a real voice in the calls that shape the product and the company.
- Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Team offsites.
- Cycle to work scheme

About Abound
We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.
And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.
Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.
About the role
We are hiring a Chief of Staff to act as the CTO’s right hand, responsible for building the operating discipline and execution leverage required to scale the technology organisation.
This is a high-impact leadership role focused on execution, clarity and accountability. You will ensure the organisation is working on the right priorities, making clear commitments, and delivering at pace without introducing unnecessary process or bureaucracy.
Your mission is simple: build a high-performing engineering organisation that consistently delivers.
What you'll be doing
Execution & Delivery Discipline
- Ensure engineering teams are aligned to the company’s most important priorities
- Drive clear commitments, realistic timelines and predictable delivery
- Surface risks early and ensure fast, decisive resolution
Operating Cadence
- Run the core operating rhythm of the technology organisation
- Own planning cycles, delivery reviews, leadership forums and executive reporting
- Improve decision-making clarity and ensure follow-through
Roadmap & Visibility
- Create end-to-end visibility of the technology roadmap across product and central teams
- Provide clear insight into progress, risks, dependencies and trade-offs
- Enable leadership to focus attention where it matters most
Cross-Team Execution
- Manage dependencies across engineering, product, risk, compliance and commercial teams
- Remove bottlenecks and ensure coordinated delivery across a complex organisation
Organisation & Performance
- Strengthen accountability, performance management and leadership discipline
- Help scale hiring, onboarding and organisational capacity
- Act as a visible driver of a high-performance culture
Operating Model
- Improve how central teams (Platform, FinOps, AI, Security, IT) support product teams
- Establish clear ownership, interfaces and expectations to increase speed and clarity
CTO Leverage
- Reduce the CTO’s overhead on coordination, planning and follow-up
- Create space for focus on technology strategy, architecture and innovation
Who you are
- Proven experience scaling engineering or product organisations in high-growth environments
- Strong track record driving execution, delivery discipline and operational clarity
- Experience running planning cadences, portfolio visibility and cross-team coordination at scale
- Ability to work credibly with senior engineers and technology leaders
- Commercial mindset: understands how technology drives growth, customer outcomes and risk management
- High standards, strong judgement and a bias for action
You are structured but pragmatic, demanding but focused on outcomes. You know how to raise performance without slowing teams down.
What we offer
- Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity
- Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office
- 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays
- 2 paid volunteering days per year
- One month paid sabbatical after 4 years
- Employee loan
- Free gym membership
- Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

jobs.ashbyhq.com/abound/27c3af73-4041-4f.description_excerpt:
About Abound
We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.
And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.
Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.
The role
We are formalising our security assurance function. We have technical controls and the engineering culture; what we need now is the governance layer that proves it - to our auditors, to our funders, and to our regulator.
You will be the delivery engine behind that. You will own the recurring assurance cycle end to end, run our third-party security programme, and be the person who turns evidence into something a due diligence team or a certification auditor can be satisfied by.
You will be responsible for building controls, gathering evidence, and challenging suppliers.
What you will own:
1. Third-party security assurance
- Run security due diligence on new suppliers, maintain initial questionnaire to risk sign-off, working with Procurement and Legal on security and data protection schedules.
- Maintain a supplier tiering model based on criticality and run the periodic re-assessment cycle for tiered suppliers: certification expiry, subprocessor changes, breach notifications, SLA performance.
- Maintain the supplier and outsourcing registers, including preparation for the FCA's material third party register under PS26/2 (rules in force 18 March 2027).
- Track concentration risk and exit plans for critical suppliers.
2. Inbound due diligence and customer assurance
- Own our response to security due diligence from funders, banking partners, institutional investors, commercial partners and prospects.
- Build and maintain a reusable trust pack: answer library, security whitepaper, current certifications, pen test attestations, standard questionnaire pre-fills (SIG, CAIQ).
- Turn a 40-hour bespoke questionnaire response into a 4-hour one.
3. The assurance calendar
- Maintain the annual calendar of security activities and make sure each one happens, produces evidence, and closes its actions: penetration tests, access reviews, disaster recovery tests, tabletop exercises, policy reviews, supplier re-assessments, awareness training.
- Coordinate external penetration tests: scoping, vendor selection, scheduling, findings triage, remediation tracking, retest.
- Facilitate tabletop exercises, including scenario design and post-exercise action tracking.
4. Risk and control administration
- Maintain the information security risk register: run the assessment cycle, record treatment plans with named owners and dates, chase closure.
- Administer the policy exception and risk acceptance process, ensuring every exception is owned, time-bound and reviewed on expiry.
- Perform first-line control testing: sample-test where key controls operate as designed and retain the evidence.
- Produce security MI for the Head of Security to take to ExCo and the Risk Committee.
5. Vulnerability and findings management
- Consolidate findings across sources — EDR, cloud security posture, SAST/DAST/SCA, secrets scanning, penetration tests — into a single view with agreed severity definitions and remediation SLAs.
- Triage, route and chase remediation with engineering teams; escalate ageing findings.
- Own the reporting on remediation performance.
6. Security awareness
- Run the awareness programme: induction, annual refresher, phishing simulation, role-based training for engineers, completion tracking.
- Coordinate pre-employment screening with People.
What you will contribute to:
- The ISO 27001 ISMS, which we are building towards certification. You will draft and maintain control documentation, populate the Statement of Applicability, gather evidence, coordinate the internal audit programme and be a primary point of contact for our external auditor. The Head of Security owns the framework, scope, and risk appetite.
- Policies and standards: you will draft, review and shepherd policies through approval, and track the review cycle.
- Incident response: you will maintain the IR plan and playbooks, facilitate post-incident reviews, track remediation actions, and support regulatory notification (ICO personal data breach reporting within 72 hours; FCA notification under Principle 11 / SUP 15.3).
- Business continuity and DR: you will maintain the documentation and the testing evidence.
- Secure development: you will help embed security requirements into the SDLC and support threat modelling sessions.
- Data protection: you will support RoPA maintenance, DPIA completion and DSAR handling alongside Legal.
What success looks like:
First 90 days: you know our supplier estate and have tiered it; the assurance calendar for the next 12 months is published and owned; inbound due diligence requests come to you and go out without the Head of Security rewriting them.
Six months: the trust pack exists and is being used; the risk register is live with owned treatment plans; ISO 27001 evidence collection is systematic rather than a scramble; the exception register exists.
Twelve months: supplier re-assessment runs on a cadence without prompting; the material third party register is ready ahead of the March 2027 deadline; MI to the Risk Committee is trusted.
Essential experience:
- Three or more years in an information security assurance, GRC or security compliance role, at least some of it in a regulated financial services environment or another environment with real external audit pressure.
- Hands-on experience of ISO 27001, whether operating an ISMS or taking one through certification.
- Demonstrable experience running third-party or vendor security assessments, and of responding to inbound security due diligence.
- Comfortable reading technical findings — an EDR vulnerability report, a penetration test finding, a cloud misconfiguration — and forming your own view on severity and real-world exploitability rather than passing the vendor's rating through unchanged.
- Clear, concise written English. Much of this role is writing things that external parties will judge us on.
- The confidence to chase a busy engineer, challenge a supplier's assertion, and tell us when an answer is not good enough.
