jobs.ashbyhq.com/greenlight-workforce-so.description_excerpt:
Employment type: Fixed-term contract
ABOUT OPENAI
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company committed to ensuring that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of AI capabilities while prioritising safety, responsible use, and human needs. Our mission requires a team that represents a diversity of perspectives, voices, and experiences.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.
The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programmes that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Developer Marketing and Relations, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Creative, Media, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring an FTC B2B Influencer Marketing Lead, EMEA to build and scale OpenAI’s influencer marketing capability across knowledge workers (KW), business decision-makers (BDMs), and developer audiences.
You will own the strategy and hands-on delivery across multiple European markets (working closely with in-market comms & marketing team), with the UK, France, and Germany as the first priorities. You will develop local creator networks, translate regional and global priorities into market-relevant programmes, and build a portfolio that balances sustained creator relationships with high-impact moments around products, campaigns, and events.
This is a zero-to-one builder role as much as an ecosystem and operating-model role. You will create the capability from the ground up: building on the early foundations we have in place, you will be responsible for defining the strategy, securing internal alignment, building the creator and agency network, establishing the operating model, and proving what works before scaling it. You will work with existing agencies, identify and onboard new specialist partners where we have capability or market gaps, partner with PHD to amplify the strongest influencer content, and create the goals, processes, reporting, and success measures needed to run the programme with speed, quality, and accountability. You will partner closely with the B2C influencer lead to define and evolve the measurement framework.
IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL
- Own the EMEA B2B influencer marketing strategy across KW, BDM, and developer audiences, setting clear audience, market, channel, investment, and outcome priorities.
- Build a credible bench of developer creators, technical educators, open-source voices, AI builders, and community leaders across Europe, and design programmes that genuinely help developers learn, evaluate, and build.
- Develop differentiated creator plans for the UK, France, and Germany, balancing regional consistency with local language, culture, platform behaviour, regulation, and audience expectations.
- Source, evaluate, and build durable relationships with creators who have genuine authority with our priority audiences. Own outreach, briefing, negotiation, contracting, content development, activation, and relationship management.
- Design curated creator programmes and high-value experiences that deepen relationships over time—such as briefings, product access, learning sessions, roundtables, community moments, and co-created formats—turning the strongest creators into long-term strategic partners rather than one-off campaign participants.
- Build an always-on creator portfolio alongside launch, event, and campaign activations, choosing the right mix of tutorials, product demonstrations, thought leadership, executive content, social posts, newsletters, podcasts, video, and community formats.
- Work with existing influencer and marketing agencies to raise the quality and pace of delivery. Identify capability gaps and lead the selection, onboarding, and management of new specialist agencies, including developer-native and market-specific partners.
- Partner closely with our media agency to build paid amplification strategies for high-performing creator content, including audience targeting, usage rights, creator whitelisting where appropriate, testing, optimisation, and clear organic-versus-paid performance readouts.
- Partner with our Performance Marketing and Growth teams to develop bespoke influencer content that drives measurable performance and business growth.
- Operationalise the end-to-end influencer process across intake, creator discovery, due diligence, brand-safety review, scopes of work, contracting, approvals, disclosure and compliance, content calendars, asset management, localisation, paid rights, and post-campaign learning.
- Set programme and campaign goals upfront. Build a measurement framework that connects creator activity to meaningful audience and business outcomes rather than relying on vanity metrics.
- Define and report a balanced scorecard by audience and objective, including qualified reach, audience relevance, engagement quality, content completion and saves, traffic, product education, developer activation, adoption signals, and pipeline influence where measurement is appropriate.
- Establish regular reporting and performance reviews with clear recommendations on which creators, formats, platforms, markets, and investments to scale, improve, or stop.
- Manage budgets, agency scopes, creator fees, usage rights, and production investment, making disciplined trade-offs and improving efficiency over time.
- Partner with Product Marketing, Developer Marketing and Relations, Comms, Creative, Legal, Privacy, Brand, Media, regional marketers, and GTM teams to ensure content is technically accurate, locally relevant, compliant, and useful to the audience.
- Bring creator and community insight back into OpenAI, helping teams understand emerging voices, platform shifts, audience questions, content opportunities, and risks across the European influencer ecosystem.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- OpenAI has a strong, trusted network of B2B and developer creators across Europe, with meaningful depth in the UK, France, and Germany.
- Priority creators progress from individual activations into sustained, mutually valuable partnerships, supported by curated programmes and experiences that increase trust, product understanding, and advocacy over time.
- Developer influencer marketing becomes a repeatable growth and education channel, supported by a healthy pipeline of credible creators and technically valuable content.
- Teams and agencies use a clear, efficient operating model with defined ownership, faster approvals, strong compliance, reusable tools, and fewer one-off processes.
- Organic creator programmes and PHD-led paid amplification work as one system, with transparent performance, learning, and investment decisions.
- Leadership has a reliable view of goals, spend, creator health,…

We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.
We’ve raised ~$60M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.
Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for growing the customer base and closing net-new logos for Infisical’s platform. We are building the #1 open-source security infrastructure stack, and you will play a defining role in growing it as the first AE in the DACH region!
You will be working closely with our CEO and the rest of the team on:
- Understanding and demonstrating our products to prospects.
- Developing, managing, and closing business within accounts in our enterprise accounts segment.
- Driving the sales cycle from prospect to close and ensuring adoption and consumption of our products.
- Collaborating with the engineering team to define customer requirements and communicate timelines.
- Identifying current customers with upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
- Using innovative sales tools to map, prospect, follow and close your accounts.
Overall, you’re going to be one of the defining pieces of our team as we scale to thousands of customers over the next 18 months.
Requirements
- Experience selling software to a technical audience (bonus: knowledge and experience with open source, security, and/or infrastructure sales).
- Demonstrated experience in scaling sales operations from the ground up, including setting up sales processes, CRM systems, and building a sales team.
- Credibility, and ability to craft compelling cases for change.
- Experience in navigating multi-stakeholder sales (e.g., IC engineer, director, executive leadership).
- Must be fluent in English and German.
Team, values & benefits
Our team brings experience from companies like Figma, Databricks, Wiz, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.
At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page https://infisical.com/careers.

jobs.ashbyhq.com/ineffable/224b677d-a130.description_excerpt:
We are recruiting technical contributors to join us in our London office.
Our mission is to make first contact with superintelligence.
We are creating a superlearner that discovers all knowledge from its own experience, from elementary motor skills through to profound intellectual breakthroughs. This superlearning capability - the ability to endlessly discover knowledge and skills, without relying on human data - will be driven by the world’s most powerful reinforcement learning algorithms.
The superlearner is expected to rediscover and then transcend the greatest inventions in human history, such as language, science, mathematics and technology. If successful, this will represent a scientific breakthrough of comparable magnitude to Darwin: where his law explained all life, our law will explain and build all intelligence.

You'll own the infrastructure that the mission depends on; keeping large-scale GPU compute reliable, developer environments fast and the whole platform humming.
This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be a part of defining a new paradigm in AI and wants their work to directly speed up the experimentation and progress of our ambitious research.
This is a broad role, and the list below is non-exhaustive. You’ll be empowered to shape the role how you’d like in order to best enable our mission.
- Kubernetes and containers: manage clusters and deploy internal tools
- GPU scheduling at scale: hands-on with tools like KAI scheduler and Kueue to keep thousands of GPUs busy and productive
- Making large-scale infrastructure resilient: get to the root of hardware failures and cluster-scale chaos, building the systems that prevent them from recurring
- Cloud infrastructure: experience on Google Cloud and other major providers
- Observability that actually helps: log management and monitoring with tools like QuickWit, Grafana or Datadog
- Developer environments people love: tooling like Tailscale, Workbrew and dev containers that make everyone's day-to-day faster
- Clean, well-crafted code: e.g. Python and Rust for tools and infrastructure that are a joy to build on

If you're interested in joining Ineffable and think your skills would be better suited to a different position please explore the careers page for other opportunities.

The superlearner is expected to rediscover and then transcend the greatest inventions in human history, such as language, science, mathematics and technology. If successful, this will represent a scientific breakthrough of comparable magnitude to Darwin: where his law explained all life, our law will explain and build all intelligence.
Role brief
Intelligence cannot emerge in a void. It needs a place to grow and flourish. As a Simulated Universes Engineer, you’ll help us craft, shape and maintain the worlds in which superlearners can emerge and thrive. That means making those worlds accurate, reliable and intricate, and scaling them to unprecedented highs in terms of both parallelism and speed. It’s a challenging quest and one that’s critical to our mission. In this role, you will:
- Build the engineering foundations of our new environments; designing, implementing and maintaining them as they grow
- Partner closely with the team creating the blueprints for the worlds we need to build
- Close the loop between blueprint and build, enabling fast, iterative research cycles
- Scale the environments up, while utilising state-of-the-art hardware
About you

- Bring industry experience with large-scale simulations, whether in demanding scientific domains or in the games industry
- Know how to build systems like huge distributed MMOs that rely on world parallelism, large-scale physics engines, or logic that preserves consistency despite decentralised computation
- Turn ambitious research visions into reality by designing, building and maintaining codebases that support fast research iteration and efficient execution
- Enjoy working closely with researchers and/or "designers", taking their blueprints and turning them into worlds that agents can explore and learn
On the pure engineering side, you’ll likely have experience with the following:
- Physics engines
- GPU-accelerated physics and simulation frameworks, such as NVIDIA Warp
- Lower level languages such as Rust, C or C++
- Implementation of distributed server-client architectures
- Writing efficient GPU code
We move fast, give people real ownership and trust engineers to make good judgment calls. We are a team that cares as much about doing this well as doing it fast.

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment.
You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests.
- Own deployments end-to-end—design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing.
- Hold the senior relationships—be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations.
- Find the value nobody has scoped—go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next.
- Define best practice for AI deployment—set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale.
- Shape our roadmap—bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build.
YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU
- Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role
- Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted
- Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue
- Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information
- Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague
Bonus Points
- Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations
- Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:
- Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside
- A salary of £100-110k
- Enhanced parental leave
- 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown
- In-office lunches provided
- Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes
- Hybrid London HQ (4 days per week onsite, with flex if you have appointments etc)
- Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build
OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS
We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.
1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.
2. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.
3. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.
Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement
At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.
Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

ABOUT LIVEKIT
LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.
ABOUT THIS ROLE
This isn't one of those situations where we tack "engineer" onto the back of every role at LiveKit. No. We're actually looking for an engineer*. A rare type of engineer that cares about talking to and advocating for customers, helping unblock them by fixing bugs or writing up sample code, and providing customers with guidance, pointers and support.
We say rare because in our experience, most engineers aspire to architect large-scale systems or tackle deeply technical problems. Said differently, most engineers want to have influence over the technology they work on or with. There's nothing wrong with that — we love hardcore engineers, and there are many at LiveKit. But this time, we're looking for a new teammate that wants to have influence over our product and business.
If you'd be energized by seeing a developer or team flip a LiveKit integration from staging to production — secretly satisfied in knowing you helped make it possible — you are perfect for this.
YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:
- are an engineer at heart, and don't mind reading more code than you write
- are a natural teacher who finds joy in helping others learn and succeed
- can break down complex technical concepts in a way that's easily understood by others
- enjoy learning new programming languages quickly and prototyping
- care deeply about the developer experience and the success of the people building on our platform
- have excellent spoken and written English
WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Support and work directly with developers, teams, and companies building with LiveKit, both commercially and in the community
- Triage, file, and fix bugs, respond to support tickets, write sample and production-quality code, and update documentation and technical guides in service of customers
- Collaborate and support community efforts, specifically around technical issues
- Regularly meet with and follow up with LiveKit customers to ensure their continued success on the platform
- Partner closely with Sales, BD, and Partnerships teams on strategy and support them in customer conversations
WHO YOU ARE
- A practicing engineer with demonstrated ability to build, ship, and debug production software
- Comfortable working across an unfamiliar codebase to diagnose and resolve customer issues
- A clear written and verbal communicator who can adapt your message to technical and non-technical audiences
- Curious, fast-learning, and energized by ambiguity
- Customer-focused — you feel the difference between solving a ticket and solving the underlying problem
NICE TO HAVE
- You've literally done this role before
- Experience working with a community of developers
- Contributions to open source
- You've built something with LiveKit
- You're multilingual — LiveKit has users around the world
OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU
- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world
- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers
- Competitive salary and equity package
- Health, dental, and vision benefits
- Flexible vacation policy

MyEdSpace is an education technology platform that connects the best teachers on the planet with the students who need them the most - wherever they are, whatever their means.
Backed by $15m in Series A funding from some of the leading investors in the space, we're ready to scale - and we want you to help us build and scale MyEdSpace as part of a collaborative and ambitious team.
We're on a mission to make a world-class education accessible to all.
We believe that every child deserves access to quality education, regardless of geography or socioeconomic background, to achieve their dreams and build a brighter future.
If you’re motivated by solving meaningful problems and creating real impact through your work on a societal level and make a real impact on the world - we’d love to hear from you!
Step into the future of education as MyEdSpace's dedicated Economics Teacher for Key Stages 3, 4 and 5. This position is a full-time role with ~6-12 lessons delivered per week.
Differences vs. A Traditional Teaching Role?
Like a normal teaching role, you will be responsible for designing and delivering your subject’s curriculum via interactive lessons, multiple times per week. We just do this via online live streams instead of in person.
Here’s the twist… We turn you into an educational influencer on social media. For context, our Maths teacher currently has over 2.4 million social media followers. As such, you will be a leading face of the company and need to be comfortable building this online presence. You will partake in marketing efforts, including building social media content and being featured in adverts to promote MyEdSpace and your course. You will report directly to our Founding Team.
If you’re excited to change from a traditional school environment to a startup, where you can use technology to make a larger-scale impact, we want to hear from you!
Your Responsibilities:
- Plan and deliver engaging online lessons via live streams - interact with your class and answer questions as they arise
- Prepare all course materials including full curriculum plans, lesson plans, presentations and homeworks etc
- Create engaging educational content for social media (we will help at every step of the way, don’t worry)
- Collaborate with our Marketing Team on innovative ad campaigns
- Communicate with students and parents to refine our services
- Support our Co-Founders in various other company initiatives
Ideally, You:
- Hold a degree (or higher) in Economics or a related field, achieving a 2:1 or above
- Achieved top grades at A-level, achieving A/A* in your subject at A-level
- Are willing to work in London (we are willing to consider a hybrid working model for outstanding candidates)
- Are a dedicated and hardworking individual
- Have a minimum of 5 years teaching experience and QTS.
- Have experience teaching OCR/ AQA Economics at A-level
- Authorised to work in the United Kingdom
- Are willing to develop your personal brand on social media - we will help and give you all the tools needed to succeed but you have to be comfortable with the idea of becoming an influencer
- Possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Is driven to develop personally, contributing to a transformative educational venture
✨ Our values
PUT INTEGRITY FIRST Honesty matters. Tell the truth, and be straight-up. Be transparent and do the right thing. This builds respect and reliability for our students, families and team members.
KNOW YOUR COORDINATES Understand where you are and where you want to get to. Know your strengths and acknowledge your gaps. Think from first principles. Question things, and never pretend to know what you don't.
RAISE THE BAR Own it and get it done. Do better. Iterate quickly and seek feedback. Deliver real value. Be excellent and lift others up. Share learnings and help your teammates improve.
LOVE TO BE WRONG Push boundaries. Be outside your comfort zone. Naturally you'll get some things wrong and that's okay. Embrace feedback. Learn from it and get closer to excellence.
WIN TOGETHER To achieve our mission, we have to work together. We all have a role to play, so help each other get there. We’re stronger as a team so inspire, support and respect each other.
🙋 Why you’ll love working here
We’re a team on a mission to transform education for the better. Joining MES means you’ll be part of something ambitious, fast-moving, and full of purpose. Here’s what you can expect:
- The chance to make a real impact: your work directly shapes the future of education.
- A fast-paced and high-growth environment where ideas move quickly and careers accelerate.
- A collaborative, supportive culture: we’re head quartered in the UK, but we’re a global team with colleagues in 15+ countries, bringing a rich mix of perspectives and energy.
We are committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and help us build a better product for students around the world.

Meter’s ambition is to evolve internet infrastructure into a utility by building a product that caters to stakeholders from Customers, ISPs, Partners, and Technicians. Every utility starts with a network design – and that’s where you come in.
To achieve our mission, we must ensure our network deployments are designed for performance and scale, as well as executed flawlessly. As a Deployment Engineer, you will be responsible for translating customer requirements to fully designed wireless networks using Meter’s in-house tooling. You’ll lead all technical decisions throughout the design and deployment phases, and support our customers through network turn-up and validation. Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency of our deployments and the satisfaction of our customers, enabling Meter to scale and meet the growing demand for reliable internet infrastructure.
YOU WILL HAVE AN IMPACT BY
- Designing performant and resilient networks: You will create wireless network designs using Meter’s in-house toolkit.
- Leading critical technical decisions: You will lead technical network decisions during design and deployment phases until network go-live and validation are complete.
- Supporting network turn-up: You will troubleshoot and support critical devices and network functionality during the network turn-up phase, ensuring a seamless experience for customers.
- Supporting On-site Installation: You will visit complex customer sites as needed to support installation and validation, ensuring successful deployment.
- Providing real-time wireless escalation support: troubleshooting RF issues, power settings, SSID configuration, and AP placement during live installs (this is SLA-bound and reactive)
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams: You will work closely with Deployment Project Managers, Sales Engineers, and Product Engineering to design the next generation of Meter’s deployment and networking products.
WHO YOU ARE
You thrive on the complexity of enterprise wireless deployments, balancing RF design, customer environments, security requirements, and the diverse devices that rely on the network. You have the project management discipline to produce multiple wireless designs at once without dropping the ball. Clear communication, disciplined documentation, and a builder’s mindset enable you to bridge teams, create structure, and translate frontline insights into scalable tools and product improvements.
WHY METER?
The internet runs the world. Every email you send, purchase you make, video call you join—it’s all packets flowing through networks. But those networks haven’t changed for decades. They’re brittle, complex, and surprisingly hard to set up in an enterprise space.
We started Meter to build better networks. We had to build everything from the ground-up: designing and building our own enterprise hardware, intuitive software, and streamlined operations to deliver great outcomes for our customers. Today, we build and deploy these networks at scale. Ambitious companies and enduring institutions like Bridgewater, Lyft, Reddit, rely on Meter to keep their thousands of employees and locations online and productive.
Our bet with Meter is simple: we will all use the internet more than we do today. We believe we have the definitive networking stack in place to enable business to do so as seamlessly and reliably as any modern utility.

Meter’s ambition is to evolve internet infrastructure into a utility by building a product that caters to stakeholders from Customers, ISPs, Partners, and Technicians. Every utility starts with an installation – and that’s where you come in. The Technician Operations team is the live backbone of Meter’s deployment engine, ensuring that we deliver critical infrastructure on time, to standard, and with zero friction for our partners and customers.
A Network is most vulnerable during deployment - and each stakeholder plays an essential role to ensure it’s built as performance and resilient critical infrastructure. Meter dedicates a team to each stakeholder, ensuring our product and work empowers stakeholders to do operationally and technically sound work at scale. In this role, you'll own the live technical execution of enterprise network deployments. By partnering directly with field technicians in real time, troubleshooting issues as they happen, and building the systems and tools that make installations effortless, you'll ensure every customer network is successfully brought online.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Your fingerprints will be on every installation, shaping the technician experience and driving the scale Meter needs to reach utility status. In your first six months, you will:
- Become the technical escalation point: Independently resolve the majority of live deployment networking issues, reducing escalations to Deployment Engineering and keeping installations on schedule.
- Keep projects on track: Deliver >90% of installations on time by partnering with field technicians, unblocking issues in real time, and ensuring customer networks are successfully brought online.
- Raise quality standards: Reduce rework rates <5% and ensure compliance with installation artifacts and validation checks.
- Accelerate installs: Partner with Operations Engineering to roll out automated technician tooling that cuts install validation times by 30%.
WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL LOOK LIKE
From day one, you'll own the live technical execution of enterprise network deployments. A typical week might include:
- Acting as the technical lead on the live install thread: Running pre-install prep calls with technicians, deciding what gets resolved on the call vs. escalated to Wired or Wireless Deployment Engineering, and owning the shift handoff so context never drops.
- Real-time troubleshooting of issues mid-install: ISP circuit turn-up, native VLAN mismatches, trunk vs. access port config on AP uplinks, DHCP reservations and inter-VLAN routing, IPSec tunnel failures, HA firewall failover, DAC cable issues on backup uplinks, and more.
- Owning sign-off as the final technical gate before a customer network goes live: Clearing the Dashboard Issues page, confirming all hardware (firewalls, switches, APs, PDUs) is online and on the current NOS, validating ISP quality and HA failover, executing VLAN auto-config, and signing off in the deployment thread. No network activates without you.
- Keeping installs moving: Documenting progress across active deployments, pushing updates to technical project managers and stakeholders, and proactively surfacing blockers before they slip.
- Closing the feedback loop: Identifying recurring failure patterns and partnering with Operations Engineering to ship new playbooks, tooling, or product fixes.
- Building for the field: Translating technician insights into hardware and software improvements so our product is purpose-built for how installs actually happen.
WHERE THIS ROLE CAN TAKE YOU
In year two, you could design automated validation tools that remove manual install steps, lead the rollout of new technician onboarding programs that cut ramp time in half, and shape product improvements that fundamentally change how installations are done in the industry. Through all this, you’ll continue to provide a great experience with Meter for our Installation Partner Technicians. Your work will directly define how Meter scales installation quality and speed worldwide.
WHO YOU ARE
You thrive on solving complex networking problems in real time and making order out of chaos. You have strong Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting skills and excel in fast-moving environments where every deployment is different. You enjoy owning technical decisions during live deployments and keeping installations moving when unexpected challenges arise. You're comfortable partnering directly with field technicians, translating technical concepts into clear guidance, and making sound decisions when the path forward isn't immediately obvious. Beyond troubleshooting, you think systematically, identifying recurring operational pain points and building scalable processes, tooling, and documentation that make future deployments more reliable.
We are building towards 24/7 coverage. To that end, we are hiring across four shifts: Monday-Friday, Tuesday-Saturday, Sunday-Thursday, and Thursday-Monday. In your application, please note your preferences across these shifts.

ABOUT FLUIDSTACK
We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.
We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.
We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!
HOW WE OPERATE
- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.
THE SECURITY TEAM
- Examples of key problems the team is working on
- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.
- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.
- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.
ROLE SCOPE
- Lead incident response end to end across corporate, cloud, and data center environments, from detection and containment through eradication and post-incident review.
- Build the detection logic, response playbooks, and forensic tooling for an environment where the assets under threat are the most targeted model weights in technology.
- Run investigations across a threat surface measured in gigawatts, correlating signals from cloud, endpoint, network, and physical systems into a single picture of an attack.
- Stand up the incident response function from the ground up, defining severity models, on-call rotations, and the escalation path to leadership.
- Turn each incident into a permanent improvement by partnering with the security and IT teams to close the gaps your investigations surface.
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
- The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.
- You've personally led major security incidents from first alert to resolution, making containment calls under pressure with the business watching.
- You've built detection logic and response playbooks that caught real intrusions, not just theoretical ones.
- You've run digital forensics across cloud, endpoint, and network evidence and reconstructed what an attacker actually did.
- You've stood up or substantially rebuilt an incident response program rather than only operating inside someone else's.
- You've hunted for threats proactively and found activity that existing tooling missed.
- You write incident reports and postmortems clear enough that both engineers and executives act on them.
- Bonus: Experience defending high-value targets such as AI labs, financial infrastructure, or critical infrastructure against nation-state threat models. Cloud-native forensics (AWS, GCP). Detection engineering and SIEM or SOAR tooling. Malware analysis or reverse engineering.

We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.
We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!
HOW WE OPERATE
- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.
- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.
- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.
- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.
- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.
THE SOFTWARE ENGINEERING TEAM
EXAMPLES OF KEY EXCITING PROBLEMS THE TEAM IS WORKING ON:
- We're building the pipeline that processes thousand-page vendor unstructured material against our own DC design to automate the generation of an end to end site design and schedule.
- We're building the live model of a AI infrastructure project’s entire delivery schedule, durable workflows handing off across every team, to replace static Gantt charts with a plan that updates itself as reality changes.
- We're building the agent platform that wraps AI in real authorization, audit, and guardrails, to let agents accelerate the development of infrastructure instead of just advising report on it.
ROLE SCOPE
- Build core primitives end to end. Entity ownership, audit, authorization, orchestration. You make the right thing the default and the wrong thing hard.
- Own the domain model. Turn Fluidstack's world of power, datacenters, and chips into composable entities that still hold up years from now.
- Define interactions with the outside. Interface with vendor systems and ingest the formats our domain actually speaks: KMZ, BIM, Revit, vendor docs.
- Make AI agents first-class operators of our systems. Give them the tools, guardrails, and audit trails to act safely, not just advise.
